overview: Two close friends, along with their girlfriends, venture deep into a dense forest for a getaway. They spend the night in an isolated forest bungalow. As the night unfolds, one of the girlfriends dies under mysterious circumstances while alone with her boyfriend. Panic and confusion grip the group no one knows how or why she died. with the body still with them and no one to turn to, fear begins to take over. One by one, they make decisions to cover up the incident choices that spiral into something far more terrifying than they ever imagined.

title: Shape of Momo
overview: Bishnu returns to her Himalayan village after quitting her job, only to face mounting family pressures and societal expectations. As tensions rise with her pregnant sister's arrival and a budding relationship with a "suitable" boy from her community, Bishnu must choose between conforming to tradition or claiming her independence.

title: Addiction
overview: Sudden deterioration of a brother and sister due to a social evil.

title: Vaanaran
overview: Vaanaran is a Tamil movie starring Bijesh Naghesh, A. Akshya, Baby Varshini, Jeeva Thangavel and Aadeshbala in prominent roles. It is directed by Sriram Padmanabhan.

title: Veeraaraju 1991
overview: A brave fisherman fights a corrupt politician to defend his village on Nellore Sea Shore after coastal displacement. His rebellion ignites a revolution that spreads beyond Krishna Lanka, showcasing courage and sacrifice.

title: Iridiyam
overview: Baddies threaten to steal a radioactive temple artefact to control and brainwash young women to do their bidding. How do they get stopped?

title: Second Chance
overview: After experiencing the first major trauma of her young life, Nia retreats to her family summer home in the Himalayas where time, nature and unlikely friendships help her heal.

title: The Show Man
overview: Stranded en route to a film festival, cynical Junior and the inscrutable Senior encounter the Stranger spinning a dramatic tale of woe. While Junior sees an obvious con, Senior sees the veil and its beauty. "The Show Man" delves into the ambiguous lines between performance, reality, and perception in the most unexpected of scenery, unravelling between highly conflicted characters.

title: The Coffin
overview: In a home suffocating under the weight of a shared trauma, Alwin and Priya’s marriage has slipped into a bitter cycle of anger and avoidance. When Priya’s torment suddenly gives way to an eerie change, Alwin’s unease turns to fear; her change feels unnatural, almost inhuman. His search for answers leads him to a secret buried beneath. To understand the stranger his wife has become, Alwin must confront that same void and risk losing himself to it.

title: Bardensra
overview: In the reality of this film, there is a curse that calls itself Bardensra, a curse that feeds off of spreading across realities. It's attached itself to the apartment in which the protagonist is a new tenant. All's well and good, until the the borders between the different worlds start becoming illusions and the protagonist starts suspecting that in a parallel universe, there's a serial killer who lives in his apartment

title: What is Your Name?
overview: A government job brings Seema Valmiki to Mumbai. On her first day, she hears two remarks: a casteist comment from a female officer and a loud “Jai Bhim” from the liftman.Trying to fit in, Seema hides her surname and avoids the liftman's greetings. But Seema is changed when the liftman is fired for wanting to celebrate Dr. Ambedkar’s birth anniversary.

title: Mana Che Shlok
overview: Two independent minds, Manva and Shlok, find themselves navigating modern love, family pressure, and the age-old idea of marriage

title: Songs of Forgotten Trees
overview: Migrant and aspiring actress Thooya navigates Mumbai by leveraging beauty and wit, occasionally trading intimacy for opportunity. When she sublets her sugar daddy’s upscale apartment to Swetha, a fellow migrant working a corporate job, the two women from seemingly different worlds begin sharing more than just living space. Amid Mumbai’s relentless pulse, they discover silent empathy, though personal histories and wounds test their delicate connection in a strange and tender unfolding – of selfhood, of survival, of unexpected kinship.

title: Xtreme
overview: Her Clothes! Her Right!  a Feminism is Talking About the Heroine Who Wears Clothes in an Exceedingly Attractive Style! What Happened to a Girl Who Wanted to Be Like Her, What Happened to That Girl's Condition, When the Police Find Out Who is Responsible for Her Condition, They Find That She Has Been Brutally Murdered. How Do the Police Find the Killer Responsible for the Murder by Intensive Investigation! This Story.

title: Ei Raat Tomar Amaar
overview: An elderly couple in their 70s revisit the regrets, heartbreaks, longing and acceptance in their five-decade-long marriage, all in one poignant night at their hillside retreat.

title: Turuper Tass
overview: Debjit Hazra's directorial debut.

title: Andhela Ravamidhi
overview: In this heartwarming and thought-provoking drama,Pavani,a talented Indian classical dancer,navigates the complexities of marriage,identity,and ambition. Her seemingly perfect life with Ramesh,an American-based entrepreneur,unravels as his traditional values clash with her artistic dreams. As Pavani confronts infertility,societal pressures,

overview: In the fictional town of sanna koppa ,the story begins with santhosh's murder.as the investigation unfolds ,Rippan swamy dives into a gripping psychological rural thriller set amidst estate workers ,town homes and hidden conflicts.

title: Danny Goes Aum
overview: Sandeep Mohan's upcoming independent feature film, coming soon!

title: Lopaliki ra chepta
overview: A delivery worker meets a mysterious woman at a traffic light. She turns out to be a secret admirer and invites him to visit, leading to unexpected life changes.

title: Interrogation
overview: When a retired judge is found dead in his house, the cops find 4 suspects who visited him on the day of the murder. Soon, each confess to their reasons for hating the man. Who is the real killer?

title: Ek Anchaahi Jalan
overview: A perfect marriage, a hidden storm. Aakash's quest for validation leads him to his wife's best friend, sparking a web of emotions that threatens to destroy everything. Will love prevail or will jealousy consume them?

title: Dexter
overview: Aadi and Yamini's love story takes a tragic turn when Yamini is kidnapped and brutally murdered, plunging Aadi into despair. Struggling with PTSD, he undergoes a memory-erasing treatment and starts anew, reuniting with his childhood friend Bhuvi. However, their lives are upended when Bhuvi's family is taken hostage by a dangerous man named Sadhik. In a tense showdown, Sadhik traps Aadi, Bhuvi, and others in a deadly game, revealing the dark motives behind a string of murders, including Yamini's. Will Aadi uncover the truth and find redemption amidst the chaos?

title: Wanderers
overview: Banjara is a Marathi movie directed by Sneh Ponkshe. The movie features Sharad Ponkshe, Sunil Barve, Bharat Jadhav and others.

title: Jagala
overview: Jagala is a story of a young Muslim man named Chekku who lived in Eranad during the Mappila Rebellion era of 1920s.

title: Cherukkanum Pennum
overview: Two IT professionals, Balu and Ritha, face unforeseen challenges that test their relationship after their recent marriage.

title: Manada Kadalu
overview: "Manada Kadalu" is a coming-of-age love story. Sumukha, an MBBS dropout, pursues love interest Rashika. However, friend Anjali's influence leads him to self-discovery and reevaluating life's value.

title: MRITYORMUKSHI
overview: Single father Raghu is pulled into a deadly conspiracy when his child  is taken hostage, forcing him into a violent game of crime and  fate.Hunted by a mysterious masked figure, he must confront the  consequences of his past choices. Mrityormukshi is a gripping thriller  about guilt,morality, and the price of one’s actions.  “Mrityormukshi” is a a gripping thriller that explores guilt,morality,  and the inescapable grasp of destiny.

title: The Great Pre-Wedding Show
overview: A young couple navigates the chaotic world of pre-wedding photography, facing unexpected hurdles and family drama as they try to capture their perfect moments before tying the knot.

title: Jasmine That Blooms in Autumn
overview: Love blossoms secretly between two old women at an elderly care home while the specter of patriarchy looms large overhead.

title: Seeing Red
overview: A quiet morning in a 1980s traditional household in Tamil Nadu spirals into slapstick chaos when three women claim to see a ghost that no one else can. In this sharp satire, the family’s frantic attempts—relying on a stranger’s advice and a ghost hunter—only escalate the confusion, as the lines between possession and protest begin to blur.

title: All The Living
overview: A writer's old age is marked by loneliness, where only his characters keep him company. His entire living world becomes his relatives. The film explores this journey through three famous short stories: T. Padmanabhan's "Poocchakkuttikalude Veedu" (The House of Kittens) and "Naykkalukalum Manushyarum" (Dogs and Humans), and Rene Basin's French story, "Thapal Pettiyile Kuruvikal" ( Birds in the Postbox).

title: The Banquet Of Primal Love
overview: Deepak and Devika, a seemingly perfect IT couple, celebrate their 4th wedding anniversary with close friends. However, the evening takes an unexpected turn when Deepak's girlfriend arrives, exposing his infidelity. The revelation sparks a heated confrontation, revealing extramarital affairs of Devika and other friends.Yet, as they come to terms with their own hypocrisy, they share a moment of raw honesty.

title: Yolo
overview: Shiva finds himself mysteriously wedded to Deekshitha, a stranger. As they seek answers about their unexpected union, they unwittingly stumble into a chilling mystery that defies explanation.

title: Smart Sunbai
overview: The film carries a strong element of suspense, and through the clash between urban and rural female characters, it delivers both chaos and entertainment.

title: Rekkai Mulaithen
overview: A son of Tamil Nadu's biggest garment owner goes missing. The police are secretly involved in the search for him. The police investigation is moving towards one goal, but things are different. The police officer is shocked when the investigation takes unexpected turns. Whether the abducted person is alive or not, what happened in his life, why was he kidnapped, is the story of the movie Rekkai Mulaithen.

title: Batt Koch
overview: In the heart of a bustling city of Jammu, far from their ancestral homeland, Kashmir, a Kashmiri Pandit family juggles the complexities of modern life while caring for an elderly grandfather who struggles with a memory condition.

title: Nuvvu Nenu
overview: Shiva (Kalyan Ram) and Vennela (Spurthi) fall in love during their college years, but life after graduation pulls them apart. Misunderstandings, career choices, and circumstances lead to a painful separation. Nuvvu Nenu follows their bittersweet journey of love, heartbreak, and the question of whether fate will bring them back together.

title: Auntypreneur
overview: Supriya Pathak Kapur helms a titular role in a comic tale of 65-year-old Jasuben, who teams up with fellow homemakers to claim their financial independence, proving, as she says, "Why should boys have all the funds?"

title: Dalit Subbaiah: Voice of the Rebels
overview: Dalit Subbaiah, directed by Giridharan MKP and produced by Yaazhi Films in collaboration with Pa. Ranjith's Neelam Productions, won the Best Longform Documentary Award at the 17th International Documentary and Short Film Festival of Kerala (IDSFFK). The film traces Subbaiah's life and struggles, celebrating his legacy in revolutionary music and activism

title: Eighty-Four
overview: In the aftermath of Indira Gandhi's assassination, the spectre of retaliatory violence looms over the Sikh community of an Old Delhi neighbourhood.

title: Jija Sala Jija
overview: Family relationships get hilariously complicated when three connected brothers-in-law find themselves in increasingly absurd situations.

title: The Strange Life of Dhrubo
overview: A man's desperate choice to protect his loved ones unravel across four parallel realities, blurring the lines between crime, fate, and morality.

title: Hills Don't Dance Alone
overview: At a school in the Himalayas, fifteen-year-old Sachin is bullied for cross-dressing in a folk dance performance. Anju, the middle-aged vice principal of the school, steps in, but it unravels more than she anticipated. As both quietly navigate their secret struggles, their lives begin to intertwine, forming a bond that neither can name but both of them need.

title: In the Shade of Strands
overview: A rift forms between Goldy, a Sikh teenager, and his family when he announces that he wants to cut off his hair, an act forbidden by the tenets of their faith.

title: Udaipur Files: Kanhaiya Lal Tailor Murder
overview: In June 2022, Kanhaiya Lal Sahu, a tailor in Udaipur, India, was brutally murdered. The events surrounding the murder are explored, delving into the conspiracy and the deeper issues of religious extremism, digital radicalization, and intelligence failures that led to the tragic event.

title: Jalso: A Family Invitation
overview: Aastha return to her roots for a wedding, only to face love, judgment, and a shadow from her past. Amidst family, tradition, and turmoil, she find strength in bonds and faith in Dwarkadishji. Tale of heart, truth, finding one's voice-this is Jalso.

title: Jhor
overview: Jhor follows Michael, a suspended officer, on a mission to find two missing girls after his student Jane is mysteriously injured. As he uncovers hidden truths, the search reveals a dark side of society masked by light.

title: Scenes from a Situationship
overview: A contemporary couple drift through a situationship where intimacy comes easily but commitment is endlessly postponed, revealing how modern love survives on closeness while quietly eroding under unspoken expectations.

title: Celebration of Death
overview: In the quiet, parched summer of rural Kerala, the death of Korappan, the aged patriarch of a sprawling joint family, becomes the catalyst for a poignant reckoning. As family members rejoins for the death ceremonies for 16 days, several tension arises between them regarding property, consumption of water from a family well, love relationships and social tensions.

title: Automagic
overview: On his return home, androgynous-looking Madhu attempts to seduce Ratnakar, his rickshaw driver, who is practicing celibacy in preparation for a religious pilgrimage.

title: FRIDAY
overview: A relationship drama revolving around a couple’s past, present and future, and ultimately a movie, all unfolding through a series of flashbacks.  The third short film from the makers of BITCH, made with tonnes of passion and love for cinema.

title: Messenger
overview: After a heartbreak, engineer Sakthi attempts suicide but is saved by messages from Anandhi, a deceased Facebook friend. He falls in love with her spirit and marries her, until she threatens to leave, testing their supernatural bond.

title: Ouroboros
overview: This is a story about a very beautiful ring that invokes greed in people by hypnotizing  them into thinking that the ring is made to be on their fingers but it holds a dark curse for its  wielder.

title: Barobabu
overview: Barobabu is inspired by the life and work of Shishirkumar Bhaduri, the towering figure of Bengali theatre. Rather than a chronological biopic, the film delves into his emotional world — a complex weave of love, art, and personal turmoil. It explores his deep connections with two actresses, Prabha Debi and Kankabati, both significant in his professional and personal life.

title: Aaro
overview: Someone explores the quiet spaces between memory, longing and silence. Crafted with restraint and emotional depth, the film reflects on the moments we hold close and the words that remain unspoken.

title: Ali Ali
overview: In a quiet Rajasthani village, young Ali clings to his cricket bat as his friends chase it. What starts as playful mischief reveals a film crew struggling to finish their shoot, blurring childhood and the fragile magic of cinema.

title: Mannu Kya? Karegga
overview: In a campus filled with music, masti, and first love, Mannu's biggest exam is not just finding Jiya's heart but also his own purpose.

title: Hind Di Chadar-guru Ladho Re
overview: n 1664, Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji was anointed as the Ninth Light of Guru Nanak. At that time, Emperor Aurangzeb’s rule cast a shadow across India — his mission was to turn the land into Dar-ul-Islam. When the oppressed Brahmins, led by Pandit Kripa Ram, came to the Guru seeking protection, he was deeply moved by their suffering. In an act of divine grace Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji chose to stand as their voice — not with armies or weapons, but with truth. He journeyed to Delhi, accompanied by his beloved disciples, Bhai Mati Das, Bhai Dayal Das, and Bhai Sati Das. What followed was not merely a confrontation but a defining moment in India’s moral history — the supreme sacrifice that echoes through eternity A timeless symbol to dharma, truth, the courage the defence of religious feedon and human rights.

title: Men will be Men
overview: Protagonist, meets his school friend unexpectedly after a long time at a local cafe. Where they chit chat about protagonist's rough college past.

title: Meghalu Cheppina Prema Katha
overview: Varun, an aspiring musician, falls for Meghana, a tech-savvy person. Subsequently, their contrasting personalities brings them closer to nature, music, and each other.

title: ECHO
overview: A delivery executive comes across a laptop that is controlled by an Artificial Intelligence named ECHO at a strange delivery drop location. What unfolds is a series of mysterious events that alter the executive's perception of reality

title: Gangland: The City of Crime
overview: A deadly feud emerges between a powerful gangster and his former friend.

title: Coffee With A Killer
overview: In 'Coffee with a Killer', a ruthless man receives a contract for an illegal activity. On this mission, he enters a coffee shop and observes his surroundings. Each table is filled with many stories. Who is the hitman's target? How does he do the job?

title: The Place Once Known as Earth and We, Homo Sapiens
overview: A daring exploration of the intersection of religion, patriarchy, and gender oppression in India, unearthing how rituals, customs, and cultural double standards—often sanctified in the name of faith—perpetuate misogyny across generations.

title: Deda
overview: Akhil's world turns upside down when his wife Khushi is hospitalised for a high-risk delivery that demands urgent medical attention and a large sum of money. Struggling to arrange even a few thousand rupees, Akhil finds himself in a desperate situation. The film explores his emotional and financial turmoil and the events that led him to this breaking point.

title: Jangar
overview: A man arrives on an island to escape a troubled past and battles a vengeful antagonist who follows him there.

title: Krishna Leela
overview: A yoga expert named Vihari returns to India, where he encounters Brundha and discovers they were lovers in a past life. Bound by a centuries-old curse, their journey explores destiny, reincarnation, and the eternal quest for love.

title: Finte
overview: On a rainy afternoon, three adolescent girls rehearse a dance that takes on a life of its own, somewhere between innocence and awareness.

title: Mukkam Post Devach Ghar
overview: Jija is on a unique mission-to send a letter addressed to "Mukkam Post Devach Ghar" (God`s Home). Her journey, filled with humorous twists, emotional moments, and heartfelt connections, brings her family and the community together in unexpected ways.

title: Ashok
overview: Ashok, a strict Hindu man, raised his son Yash in a Western world while maintaining his Hindu beliefs. They never had a normal relationship; Ashok was respectful and proper, while Yash, influenced by a modern environment, outgrew his father's religious and cultural teachings. Although they respected each other, they couldn't express their emotions. Yash thought his whole life that he was wrong until he realized he wasn't.

title: Four on Eleven : The Fading Glory Of Parsi Cricket
overview: The Parsi Community has inked an incredible mark in Cricket, with a rich and storied legacy  dating back to the early days of Cricket in India. Parsi Cricketers played a pioneering role in  nurturing and popularising the game, producing some iconic cricketers. However, over time,  the Parsi Community's influence on the sport has gradually declined, reflecting broader  changes. While their contributions remain essential to the history of Indian cricket, the  community's active participation on the field has diminished. But, is there still hope left?

title: Notes From The Bunker
overview: Punit Pania's third standup special 'Notes From The Bunker' has been years in the making. Covering everything from the mundane to the profound and back to Kandivali.

title: Aasma
overview: At the pinnacle of the splendor of the Himalayas sits the Kashmir valley, one of the most stunningly picturesque places on earth. But today, its grandeur has also become ubiquitous with the ravages of terrorism and counter terrorism operations. Under these circumstances, anyone roaming these hills would tell you the shocking truth: that combat soldiers are statistically safer than women.

title: Apoorva Puthranmar
overview: When two brothers attempt to honour their father's dying wish, their actions cause widespread chaos.

title: Zora
overview: A cop pursues his father's killer after 20 years, guided by a perfume bottle marked "Scent By The Devil." His quest for vengeance uncovers hidden truths.

title: Srishti
overview: Lured to the forbidden forests of the Himalayas, a photojournalist unearths secrets that unravel his mind and challenge the very nature of reality.

title: Omor Shongi
overview: Anurag and Joyee, two deeply connected childhood friends, are set to marry. Then?

title: Thampachi
overview: In a village where Thampachi and Komaras are believed to be the counterparts of God, everyone respects Shiva Thampachi and his daughter Shivani. Unexpectedly, a job offer comes in search of Shivani.

title: Spirit of the Flesh
overview: A new film by Sheik Althaf Hussain. The plot is unknown at this moment; currently in private screenings and festival submissions.

title: VHAALL || Konkani Short Film
overview: 2 Neighbours in a remote village argue over a common tap.

title: Welcome to Punjab
overview: Two strangers fall in love, but their romance causes friction in their respective families.

title: The Ice Builders
overview: An  urgent  portrait  of  the  people  of  the  Zanskar  valley  and  their  struggle  to  survive  extreme  living  conditions aggravated by climate change.

title: REM:RESTRICTED
overview: 18-year-old boy,Yash agrees to participate in a sleep deprivation study for money. The goal: stay awake for 10 days. But as the days pass, reality begins to blur.

title: Racharikam
overview: Racharikam is a political action thriller set in the crime-infested Rachakonda. The film delves into intense village politics and societal struggles. The movie directed by Suresh Lankalapalli, and features Vijay Shankar, Apsara Rani, and Varun Sandesh in their pivotal roles.

title: Jigel
overview: Jigel is a romantic comedy thriller. The hero Nandu is an expert 'locker technician' who cracks anylocker or safe in his own inimitable style. His character is very stylishly mountedwith all new and old gimmicks.

title: Rehna Nahi Bin Tere
overview: The film "Rehna Nahi Bin Tere" intimately explores his life, his experiences with love, and his evolution into the responsible man his industrialist father always envisioned, as he rises to lead the family business.

title: Gandhi Tatha Chettu
overview: A young girl's non-violent campaign to protect her grandfather's beloved tree from demolition, is inspired by Gandhi's philosophy of peaceful resistance.

title: Bumblinga
overview: ‘Bumblinga’, a modern matchmaking tale, is a coming of age romantic comedy short film that revolves around two youngsters in Kochi, Prahaladhan and Bhagya, and how they connect with each other through a dating app.

title: Meta: The Dazzling Girl
overview: In this single character-driven movie, we follow the life of meta, an archaeologist. In her excavation she comes across an old ruin and unknowingly falls trap to a curse. This curse later leads her head to get stuck in a mystical pot. It is the nature’s payback to her unknown karmic cycle.

title: The Call
overview: A man wakes up to a dead body in his room… but that’s just the beginning.  As reality begins to distort, a mysterious phone call pulls him deeper into a psychological nightmare where nothing is as it seems.

title: Sorry
overview: Aravind Babu, a struggling actor starts his quest for apologies from the people who bullied him in the past in order to find his lost confidence to reignite his passion for acting. It is then he realised that there are two types of people ; the apologetic and the unapologetic.

title: Porshi
overview: Porshi captures the lives of everyday Kolkatans, each navigating their own struggles in a bustling, grey city. Though strangers, they are unknowingly connected — neighbours in spirit and circumstance. Like a palette of distinct, independent colours, none of them realize they could form a rainbow if they came together.

title: Yaazhi
overview: Yaazhi, a mythical creature once sworn to protect its land and people, fails and abandons the battlefield. As it flees, the real war begins.

title: Usurae
overview: In the culturally rich town of Chittoor, Raghava, a simple young man, falls for Ranjana, a spirited MBA student. But winning her heart isn’t easy—her overprotective mother Anusuya, known for her fierce and intimidating nature, stands as a formidable barrier. What begins as a dare between friends soon turns into true love, forcing Raghava to navigate emotional trials and confront Anusuya's dominance. Will love triumph, or will it end in heartbreak?

title: Tiger's Pond
overview: In the sleepy hamlet of Vaghachipani, an under-aged sheperdess is discovered to be pregnant. Her employer who is hellbent on becoming the chairman of the village-council is making every effort to cover it up, resulting in more cover-ups threatening to be exposed. Mentally-deficient, the young sheperdess has no idea what a pregnancy is.

title: Mugamoodi
overview: A schoolboy feels out of place, unsure, and increasingly disconnected from a world where no one shows their true face. As he searches for answers, the reality he knows begins to unravel.

title: Premistunnaa
overview: A boy struggles to express his love to a girl he loves deeply, but she fails to understand his mental state. The burning flame in a loving heart seeks solitude and comfort, making it difficult to express emotions through words.

title: Metro Kadhal
overview: A boy and a girl meet unexpectedly in metro, going forward unknowingly they develop feelings for each other, how will their inner self make them realise they are in love, will they confess their feelings.

title: Main Tere Qurbaan
overview: A tale of boundless love and ultimate sacrifice, showing how people will give up everything when driven by genuine devotion.

title: Lovedale
overview: Isha, an air hostess and model, joins photographer Ruben for a shoot at his iconic spot, Lovedale. A night in a remote forest bungalow takes a terrifying turn as unexpected dangers arise. Will they survive the horrors that await?

title: The Split
overview: A group of friends discover that there is a class difference among them, where some cannot afford the activities others enjoy, when spending time together. They sit around a table that quickly turns into a battleground, where they bluntly argue it out.

title: Della Bella Badlegi Kahaani
overview: A 'pre-love story' of a changing India. Changes that are taking place across society and psyche, where a small-town girl, Dollu, popular as DELLA BELLA becomes a beacon of women's self-exploration through a journey of her own.

title: Dear Uma
overview: "Dear Uma" is a film that narrates the story of Dev, a rock star who falls in love with Uma, a medical student. As the plot unfolds, Dev realizes that he is enamored with Uma's soul rather than Uma herself. The central mystery revolves around why Dev is the only one who can perceive the soul of Uma, who had passed away long ago.

title: Ik Tere Kar K
overview: A young Punjabi couple's move to Canada puts their relationship under unexpected pressure.

title: Mario
overview: A rootless young man grappling with his past faces a pivotal moment where goals, memories, and relationships intersect. New encounters challenge his perspective, pushing him to examine his identity and future path.

title: JAI
overview: The protagonist Sathya from Simhabettu finds himself in a dilemma after he finds out the truth behind the people he trusted the most.

title: Middle Class Family
overview: A middle-class builder's son charts his own path in the construction world, finding love unexpectedly. As success nears, a family secret emerges that could demolish his carefully laid plans.

title: Uduppu
overview: Uduppu follows the emotional and turbulent journey of a young woman whose life takes unexpected turns after marriage.

title: Pechi
overview: A polio-stricken shepherd, Mariyappan, learns of his mother’s death and undertakes a harsh journey home with only a goat for support. Blocked by caste discrimination and crushed by poverty, he pushes through heat and humiliation

title: Pei Kathai
overview: A gang of friends from the Chennai area want to find a ground to practice and play cricket as their regularly playing ground has some issues, hence plans to go to a prohibited factory ground to play. An unfortunate situation arises and where they get trapped inside a prohibited VR Research factory where there are rumors and talk that this place is haunted with Evil and spirits. What happens next is the film.Pei Kathai is a different dimension of ghost storytelling experience to the audience. A first attempt of Unreal Engine Animation plot segmented in the film in form of Virtual Reality Experience.Film Engage audience from the Hero perspective point with lots of suspense and thriller elements overflowed with humor and dark comedy. This film is appropriate to watch by any segment of audience and it’s a complete family entertainer.

title: Divya Drushti
overview: When tragedy strikes twice, Bhavya refuses to remain a victim. Visually impaired, she is drawn into a perilous hunt for the truth behind the mysterious deaths of her husband & twin sister - uncovering a dark world where nothing is as it seems.

title: Kadaisi Dhum
overview: A man desperately searching for cigarettes encounters a trio that's plotting to kill a hen.

title: LAJJPAL -  The Endless Journey
overview: "Lajjpal" is a compelling narrative following the journey of an ordinary individual seeking divine empowerment to combat the malevolence of evil forces. Fueled by a deep sense of purpose, our protagonist embarks on a transformative quest, delving into the realms of spirituality and courage. As he navigates through trials and tribulations, he discovers the latent strength within himself, bestowed by the benevolence of the divine. With newfound powers, he confronts the darkness that threatens to engulf humanity, embodying the timeless struggle between good and evil. "Lajjpal" is a poignant tale of resilience, faith, and the triumph of righteousness over adversity.

title: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion
overview: Arjun Chakravarthy: Journey of an Unsung Champion is an inspiring sports drama that chronicles the extraordinary life of Arjun Chakravarthy, a determined kabaddi player who represented India in the 1980s.

title: Dear Jeeva: An Unconditional Love Story
overview: Jeeva,a next-door guy who is seeking a job and living alone and Ms Jeeva is a focused workaholic. When they met for an interview, they began to like each other and fell in love.After a lot of emotional journey, both got married and started their lives happily. However, after a few months of marriage, Jeeva lost his job. Mrs. Jeeva received an onsite opportunity simultaneously.Ego starts to build between them and at one point Mrs. Jeeva wants to distance herself from him, but The news of Covid-lockdown has left them with no choice but to stay together.The rest of the story is about how situations during the lockdown helped them understand each other, whether they separated or accepted each other.

title: Oka Pathakam Prakaaram
overview: After losing everything and his wife's disappearance, Siddharth faces arrest. While investigating, he uncovers widespread societal crimes and vulnerabilities.

title: Naalai Namadhe
overview: Naalai Namadhe, a village ruled by the wealthy where no elections have been held for years, a young woman dares to contest, challenging power and awakening change. Inspired by Lenin`s words, the film is a bold take on reclaiming political voice and justice.

title: Gopi Galla Goa Trip
overview: Two boys from rural Telangana travel to Goa to get some ‘girlfriend experience’.

title: Tree Roots Through Concrete
overview: As Samay nears his thirtieth birthday, he and his girlfriend Meenakshi embark on a road trip to a tranquil hill spot on a Saturday afternoon. Between winding roads and quiet moments, their conversations unravel reflections on life’s twists and turns—career choices, societal expectations, relationships, and the delicate balance between personal aspirations and external pressures. A journey filled with warmth, scenic beauty, and unfiltered thoughts, Tree Roots Through Concrete captures the essence of love, change, and the pursuit of meaning.

title: Niratar
overview: A young woman struggles to balances her life as a tailor with being a daughter to a bedridden mother.

title: Policy
overview: Pali plans to kidnap his rude boss Hardev but backs out after Sonia’s heartfelt plea. Just when things settle a mysterious message shakes it all.

title: Forever (Telugu)
overview: Set against a backdrop of heartfelt emotions and relatable relationships, *FOREVER* explores  the intertwining stories of love, family, and enduring bonds.

title: Kanya
overview: Two sisters Sudipa and Sukanya are reunited after 10 years due to their father's illness. The reunion takes a shocking turn when Sudipa discovers her younger sister, Sukanya, is now married to her ex-husband, Surojit.

title: Close Shave
overview: As torrential rain lashes the city, a barber shop provides brief shelter from the chaos outside. But with a serial killer on the loose, marked by a distinct  tattoo, even this small little salon is gripped in tension.

title: BHRAM
overview: Our protagonist is lonely and has no friends. In order to make a few, he tries a "revolutionary" product, with hopes to get what everyone wants: relevance. What follows is a descent into the dark and lethal side of technology, which our protagonist discovers by becoming the very experiment he always wanted to be a part of.  An abstract thriller showing the horrors of the contemporary world whose puppeteer is technology.  Directed and Written by : Raunak Chatterjee

title: Enough
overview: Enough follows a person trapped in mobile addiction, leading to laziness and lost productivity. Struggling to break free, they turn to music as a way to regain focus and reclaim control over their life. The film explores the journey of overcoming digital dependency and finding motivation.

title: Nee Bandinaipoyya
overview: The story is all about Janaki, an independent girl who wants to move away from her friends and start a new life. But Vishnu, a suspended police officer, formed an alliance with Janaki and learns the truth about her leaving for Australia

title: Leech
overview: The Story of This Cinema is About an Accident That Can Happen to Any Traveling Couple. The Title Leech Refers to the Fact That Some Humans Are Like Leeches That Feeds on Their Prey Without Them Being Aware.

title: Kolahalam
overview: A robber's attempt to steal from a dead man's house goes wrong. Trapped in funeral activities, he learns surprising things about people and life while trying to get away.

title: Who’s Watching Who?
overview: On a night out with his friends, a lovesick protagonist discovers a hilarious and frustrating new companion: the audience, who offers unsolicited advice and commentary on his every move.

title: Kaafir - The Movie
overview: Kainaaz, a woman from Pakistan, accidentally crosses the border and is presumed to be a militant. A few years later, Vedant, an Indian journalist, seeks justice for her.

title: Good Day
overview: Shanthakumar, a textile employee,  humiliated and beaten on his birthday, driven by rage and a need for justice,  decides to throw himself a very different kind of birthday party. Intoxicated and aimless, He embarks on a darkly comic walk through the night towards redemption.

title: Thiruk Kural
overview: This film traces the culturally rich history of the Tamils through unique characters, offering a feel-good glimpse into the Sangam Era that flourished 2000 years ago.

title: AVADHI THE TALE OF LOVE
overview: When found at the cross roads of love and separation a youngster named Aditya meets an elderly man called Balu, whose perspective on love influences Aditya to pursue his love. Who's Balu? what connection does Aditya and Balu share, did Aditya reconcile with his lover or not forms the rest.

title: Sahakutumbaanam
overview: An orphan discovers her neighbor's seemingly perfect life is a lie.

title: Pei Kottu
overview: Kavya, a reporter, unknowingly picks up a haunted button camera. Soon, she is mistaken for Shruti, a missing musician whose music was stolen by a film crew. Shruti’s spirit possesses Kavya, seeking justice for her murder. The spirit kills those responsible, and evidence from the button camera exposes the truth. Shruti’s spirit finally departs after gaining her rightful recognition.

title: Rambo
overview: A ruthless education empire heir and a compassionate orphanage worker clash when a woman reveals the heir's hidden past, leading to a violent confrontation.

title: Jarnail: The Warrior
overview: After a horrific event strikes a girl, her family and the police race to find the culprits. As secrets unravel, will justice be served or slip away?

title: Marasim
overview: An uncommon story, of a common man.

title: Vaaname Ellai
overview: A deeply introspective film that follows a man in his late 20s as he navigates a turbulent night filled with emotional triggers and personal revelations. Haunted by feelings of inadequacy, loneliness, and suppressed trauma, he finds himself spiralling into a state of inner chaos. The film delicately explores the fine line between giving up and reaching out, posing the question: When life overwhelms you, do you let it consume you, or do you gather the courage to seek help?

title: Yaksha
overview: "Yaksha" tells the story of a spirit that haunts the remote areas of Jammu and Kashmir, protecting its own mysterious boundary. Many people have entered its territory, only to disappear without a trace, their stories lost forever.  The spirit, filled with anger and sorrow, keeps anyone from crossing the line it has set, claiming the lives of those who dare to approach. As more secrets are uncovered, the truth behind the unexplained deaths begins to unfold.

title: Shaktidasan
overview: A Poet's Quest for Truth: A Documenraey on the spiritual life and journey of the renowned Tamil poet, Mahakavi C. Subramania Bharathiar. Unlike a conventional biopic, the film primarily explores the poet's spiritual quest, his inner transformation, and his devotion to the divine feminine energy, which he revered as Shakti

title: Do you know about the Warrior with a Sword
overview: When Father Choma's dream of securing farmland fails, his son Kaala, from a marginalised community, vows to overcome all odds to honour his father's legacy.

title: Sa La Te Sa La Na Te
overview: A commentary about the state of journalism on the backdrop of environmental exploitation of the ecologically sensitive Tadoba Tiger Reserve, the film explores the consequences of modern profiteering-driven news on the world, and on personal relationships.

title: Jigris
overview: The story revolves around four friends embarking on an unexpected road trip in a rusty Maruti 800.

title: Sidlingu 2
overview: Sidlingu 2 continues the journey of its beloved characters, starring Loose Madha Yogi and Sonugowda. Directed by Vijayaprasad, this sequel promises more drama, humour, and adventure.

title: Neela Mudi
overview: In today's tech-driven world, new media has become an integral part of contemporary life. This has enabled people to misuse media for mockery and humiliation, lacking sense of responsibility. 'Blue hair' delves in to the vlogs from 4 young men, whose humor rooted in insensitive comments on caste, color and class leads to unsettling events.

title: Nodidavaru Enanthare
overview: Siddharth is an existentialist who leaves his home in pursuit of the unknown and his quest to find himself.

title: Working Girls
overview: A humorous yet raw and authentic study of women’s reproductive labour across the marriage-market continuum, including, sex work, erotic dancing, surrogacy and egg donation, paid domestic work and unpaid domestic/care work across India, while also offering a comparison of the law’s highly differential regulation of these apparently disparate forms of female reproductive labour.

title: Ayna
overview: Wazim, Nathan, and Karthik are just 3 roommates enjoying the tail end of their college life,filled with internships, placements, and a whole lot of FIFA. But what seems to add a little bit of spice to this humdrum, everyday life of theirs is the arrival of a new mysterious golden haired tenant in their flat called Ayna. Wazim seems to think that this peaceful existence of theirs is under danger because of the girl. Is he overthinking, or is there something more to her than what meets the eye?

title: Saaraa
overview: A Thriller Sentimental Story dealing with a son's love to a single mother. An unimaginable sacrifice done between friendship and love in this decade.

title: Jaaiye Aap Kahan Jaayenge
overview: Two couples navigate modern relationships while a woman pioneers installing public toilets for females across rural India, breaking taboos.

title: Inn Galiyon Mein
overview: A romantic drama that intertwines themes of love, society, and the impact of social media

title: Zapuk Zupuk
overview: Suraj falls in love with a minister's daughter and tries to win her heart. However, his plan leads him on an unexpected adventure of love and friendship.

title: Melting Man
overview: Weighed down by familial expectations and personal despair, Sonu battles inner struggles while trying to find meaning in his fractured life.

title: Kingpin
overview: Two medical college hostel wardens raise a secret complaint about an uncommon drug abuse in their hostel to the police not knowing of Das, a notorious petty drug runner is the one behind it.

title: Khilre Hoye Warke Kudrat
overview: Kudrat, a schoolgirl with dreams, loves a drug addict. But as his addiction grows, will love save him or destroy them both?

title: Malik Ni Varta
overview: In a fearful town, whispers of Malik, a mysterious and intimidating figure, spread like wildfire. As the community grapples with fear, individuals speculate about Malik's true identity.

title: Wife peke Husband Theke
overview: Wife Peke Husband Theke is a Punjabi-language situational comedy-drama centered around Harjeet, a struggling insurance agent, and his never-ending domestic squabbles with his wife Parm. Their daily routine is filled with hilarious banter, sarcastic jabs, and the relatable chaos of a middle-class married couple.

title: Lost Songs of Sundari
overview: In Mumbai, once an island city linked by the sea, modern bridges and land reclamation have reshaped the landscape, disrupting the lives of its original communities.

title: Good Bye Mountain
overview: Two souls reunite after 22 years and slip into a quiet rhythm, as if they had never been apart, living peacefully in a serene mountain bungalow. But their calm is short-lived. The man has some secret, and soon, the woman's husband arrives, disrupting the fragile balance.

title: One at a Time
overview: A man wakes up in a car beside his own dead body, with no memory of what happened—only a cryptic voice guiding him. As he tries to dispose of the corpse, he spirals into a twisted cycle of identity, memory, and horror.

title: BunnyBoo Live
overview: Two radical villagers try to overthrow a fascist government one brick at a time.

title: Blink
overview: Blink is a micro horror film created in under 24 hours.  Made with minimal resources, this short leans on pure tension, timing, and fear.

title: neram, kaalam; koodum
overview: A man meets his college crush after years.

title: Kutram Thavir
overview: Kutram Thavir is about Rudra, whose elder sister dies due to a fraudulent medical insurance scheme, leading him to discover a conspiracy that exploits the poor. Driven by grief and anger, Rudra seeks revenge and exposes the truth behind his sister's death.

title: Mufti Police
overview: When writer Jeba is murdered at midnight, the calm of an upscale apartment complex shatters. Inspector Magudapathi, known for his unorthodox methods, delves into the residents' secrets to uncover the truth. Amid the chaos, Adhi`s growing bond with his mother's therapist, Meera, complicates everything. Mufti Police is a tense thriller where every neighbor hides a motive and the truth is darker than anyone expects.

title: All Is Well
overview: Mumbai-the city of dreams. Three strangers, one wild ride. Scams, an ATM robbery, and a gangster with taste. Chaos turns into comedy as Amar, Akbar and Anthony take on the city. Unfiltered fun, unstoppable laughter-its all here.

title: Red Balloon and a Peacock's Feather
overview: On his daughter’s birthday, Das chooses not to return home. Instead, he visits Yakob—an elderly man slowly losing his memory. Introducing himself as Yakob’s long-lost son, Yusuf, Das spends the day with him, carefully nurturing conversations and reliving borrowed memories. As they walk, talk, and share quiet moments, a fragile bond begins to form—tender, unexpected, and deeply human.

title: Her
overview: Ten years ago, Arjun Singh and Tara Kapoor were inseparable-two young souls lost in love, dreaming of a future together. Their days were filled with laughter, stolen moments, and whispered promises of forever. But forever never came. Now, a decade later, Arjun finds himself in the dead of night, at an almost desolate five-star hotel room, a far cry from the life he once imagined. He is no longer the boy who believed in love-he is a man hardened by crime, preparing for the biggest drug deal of his life, one that could set him free. As the clock strikes 3:33 AM, shadows of the past begin to creep in. He sees glimpses of Tara-her laughter, her touch, her presence-as if time itself is mocking him.

title: Baida
overview: Three film makers, going for documentary film shoot about uncertain deaths in a rural village of Odisha. But what they found out is something bigger than they ever imagined.

title: Khalnigranaaya
overview: A committed ACP faces his toughest challenge as his newly born child is kidnapped by anonymous culprits. Racing against them, he strives to reclaim his baby safely.

title: Ahana
overview: Ahana is a powerful story of a young author who challenges patriarchal norms and breaks free from societal expectations. As the film boldly addresses male infertility, Ahana's journey becomes one of self-discovery, courage, and reclaiming her identity.

title: Lament
overview: Born a girl but raised as a boy, Aravan is groomed by her father to play Duryodhana in their village therukoothu. Torn between the role imposed upon her and the identity she longs to embrace, Aravan's inner world begins to unravel. Drawing from both Sanskrit and Tamil epics, Lament is a poignant exploration of gender, tradition, and the cost of silencing one's true self.

title: Titanic Modhiya Iceberg Ivan
overview: In a hilariously chaotic bid for independence, a submissive boyfriend stages a series of absurd escape attempts from his overbearing girlfriend’s clutches, only to find himself tangled in increasingly ridiculous situations that blur the line between love and captivity.

title: Ashi Hi Jamva Jamvi
overview: Marriage is not just a union of two hearts but also of two families. To achieve this union, elders Mohan and Vandana take their respective young grandchildren on a trip to Goa...

title: Mr. Zoo Keeper
overview: A zookeeper dedicated to taking care of wild animals finds himself in a difficult situation with law enforcement officials.

title: Delhi is Choking - One Percent
overview: In the smog-choked slums of New Delhi, a desperate young boy risks everything to steal a portable air purifier for his asthmatic mother, only to face the harsh realities of survival, greed, and fleeting hope in a world where even clean air is a luxury.

title: Kanhaiya Vastavaiya
overview: Kanhaiya, loyal to village chief Gop Ji, must choose between duty and conscience when "Pandubbi" returns, unearthing old secrets and shaking the soul of the village.

title: Beyond the Board
overview: Beyond the Board draws parallels between life and chess, showing how life is like a game where every move we make can lead to a win, a loss, or a lesson. Through quiet moments and daily struggles, the film connects the strategy of the game to the choices we face in real life.

title: Burden of Doubt
overview: Burden of Doubt tells the story of a solo traveler attempting his most challenging climb yet, up a majestic mountain peak. Battling the harsh terrain and his own inner doubts, he experiences moments of exhaustion and uncertainty. Along the way, an unexpected ally helps him rediscover his resilience and determination. It's a story of perseverance and self-belief, exploring the strength that resides in the most unexpected places.

title: Baby & Baby
overview: Two couples traveling to introduce their newborns to grandparents accidentally switch babies along the way.

title: Amruthamathi
overview: Amruthamathi a kannada film is based on the story of Yashodhara Charite' an epic poem written by Janna, a famous 13th century A.D. Kannada poet. This Janna's epic poem is recreated and reinterpreted in this film with appropriate changes without diviating original essence of the story.

title: JUVENiLE
overview: Juvenile highlights the harsh reality of bad parenting and its irreversible impact on a child’s future. Influenced at a young age, a minor slips into alcoholism, revealing how neglect and poor guidance can turn innocence into addiction.

title: Vaathiyar Kuppam
overview: The story is whether MP and his younger brother MLA, who are supporting the opening of a company in north indian association Vathiyar Kuppam, a village called Vathiyar Kuppam in Thoothukudi district, along with the protagonist Khalid and Antony Dasan, went into the field and restored Vathiyar Kuppam.

title: Dohra
overview: "Dohra" is a gripping hindi short film that follows Kavita, a woman who finds herself trapped in an unusual and unsettling situation. As she navigates through the layers of reality, she begins to question everything she knows. Is it fate, a dream, or something much deeper?

title: Leopard Dynasty – The Rise of Rana
overview: Jhalana’s refuge, India's urban leopard habitat, is controlled by the strong and experienced Bahadur. But his dominance is being challenged – by his son, Rana! Once a quiet youngster, Rana has grown into an ambitious young male. But in the animal kingdom, power is not inherited – it is fought for with strength and persistence. Rana is not content with just securing his place; he wants more. To fulfill his ambitions, he forms a bond with one of his father's females, and what begins as a simple interaction soon turns into a powerful partnership. The aging Bahadur has held his territory for six years and will not tolerate his son's claim. Rana faces a decision: retreat or fight. But Rana follows his instincts.

title: Not A Biopic
overview: The typical love letter to cinema.

title: Butcher
overview: Two rival meat shops stand opposite each other - one struggling, the other always crowded. The Butcher’s meat tastes unbelievably good. As customers flock to his shop, one question lingers - what makes it so delicious?

title: Ghor
overview: When the life of a troubled man is turned upside down because of his actions, the impending doom of his time begins to tick.

title: I don't know about your fever
overview: A person brings their partner to a doctor to treat an unknown itching fever. Two men come to see the doctor, one of them suffering from insomnia. Both patients meet at the urinal.

title: Oru Onnonnara Ottam
overview: Set in a small, vibrant village, Oru Onnonnara Ottam follows the hilarious journey of three youngsters running a struggling event management business. When their warehouse owner demands overdue rent, they finally find hope in a cousin’s upcoming wedding — but things take a wild turn when the bride suddenly elopes !

title: Ishq Manzoor
overview: Ishq Manzoor Is A Journey Of Love , Acceptance And Self-Discovery

title: Vahali
overview: Priya, a modern girl is brought up in an orthodox household. As she strives to break free from her traditional family, she falls in love.

title: Gangster Alla Prankster
overview: Arjun, an unemployed guy, starts a YouTube Channel named WEBMASTER and Pranks people, recording and uploading to YouTube. While pranking, he falls into his own trap.

title: Better Half Chi Love Story
overview: After his controlling wife's accidental death, Ajay thinks he's finally free - until her vengeful spirit possesses half his body, forcing him into a terrifying battle for control of his own life.

title: Phantom : The Rise and the Fall
overview: Set in a world where friendships are tested by temptation and betrayal, this story follows characters entangled in the underbelly of crime, addiction, and fleeting youth and through the lens of nostalgia, the film explores how innocence is lost and morality blurred when the ghosts of the past haunt the present.

title: ELIZA
overview: The Movie Starts with a flashback where beautiful visuals of a mother feeding her daughter Shifting to present day there are two youngsters ‘ Sandeep ’ and ‘ Melvin ’ who have a brotherly relationship. Melvin is in love with ‘ Eliza ’ whom he met 2 months back online. He is requesting ‘ Sandeep ’ to accompany him to meet his love forthe first time

title: Eerie
overview: A gripping psychological crime thriller that keeps you questioning every word and every silence. Watch till the end-because the truth has a way of coming out.

title: Murugesan +2
overview: Murugesan+2 is a darkly comic tale about Murugesan, a truck driver leading a secret double life with two families. When he is presumed dead after a severe accident, a promised settlement sparks a bitter feud between his wives and their families, each scheming for control of the money. Just as the battle turns vicious, Murugesan returns alive, only to become a burden to those who once mourned him. Faced with betrayal and greed, Murugesan and his disillusioned sons walk away, leaving behind a biting satire on family, loyalty, and the corrupting power of money.

title: Raktha Kashmira
overview: In Bengaluru, a stunt artist runs a Stunt Training School for orphaned children, treating them as his own family. His life is brightened by Ramya, the heroine, whose love adds depth to the story.  Meanwhile, terrorists plan a bomb blast. Children from the school stumble upon the plot and are kidnapped to Kashmir, prompting the hero and heroine to race to save them.

title: Moppala
overview: The life of a Theyyam exponent and his grandson, who is the child of an inter-caste marriage, is topsy-turvy due to caste hierarchy and prejudices. Devanandan, the grandson who is very much passionate about Theyyam, is not allowed to perform the art by the diehard followers of caste systems. So Devanandan leaves the scene wearing the attires and makeup of Theyyam.

title: Entanglement
overview: A couple struggles to make sense of the past, and their vastly different versions of the bizarre event that made their relationship spin out of control.

title: UNAKKU PIDITHA ENNAI
overview: Rajan and Rachel were teenage lovers — wild, intense, and heartbreakingly toxic.  What started as love quickly turned into something destructive, leaving behind wounds that time couldn’t fully heal.  Years later, Rachel returns to Chennai. Unexpected. Unannounced.  Rajan, weighed down by life and memories, is no longer the boy she knew. He’s stuck — numb, lost, and living in the shadows of what was.  She hasn’t come to fix the past.  But her presence brings it all back — every word, every silence.  And with it, a quiet, aching question:  “If we met now… softer, older, quieter… would you still choose me?”  ‘Unnaku Piditha Ennai’ is a tender heartbreak story about the kind of love that arrives too early…  and the unspoken longing that remains long after it’s gone.

title: Sauda Khara Khara
overview: Three roommates form a scam company, Sauda Khara Khara, to con the city, but it backfires, leading to a series of hilarious blunders and drama!

title: Rakshasa
overview: A father battles a relentless force threatening his child, trapped in a cycle of protecting them from an unknown, terrifying entity.

title: Tapes Of Kannimedu
overview: When Arjun, a whistleblowing journalist exiled to work as a radio jockey in an isolated town, discovers a serial killer is on the loose, he becomes the police’s only stand-in while the remaining officers leave to bring backup—forcing him to confront a buried 20-year-old truth as the night unfolds.

title: Seven Minutes
overview: 7 Minutes – A Short Film  In just seven minutes, a lifetime can change. A boy carries a love he never dares to speak, holding it close through the years. When fate finally gives him a chance, it’s already slipping away. What follows is a journey through silent emotions, unspoken words, and the haunting weight of “what could have been.”  A debut film crafted with love, passion, and the belief that some stories are meant to be felt more than told.

title: KISS-KA CALL?
overview: When mysterious calls disrupt Rocky's ordinary life, he's drawn into a cat-and-mouse game with a sinister force. As the calls escalate, Rocky's grip on reality falters and his darkest secrets begin to surface. Can he unravel the mystery behind the calls before it's too late or will the unknown caller destroy him forever?

title: Naav Kay Tuze?
overview: A short story of Mansi, a college passout student, who finds a file abandoned at a bus stop.

title: ALT
overview: The plan of 3 Thieves to loot 10 million cash intercepts with A Lady leaving the town after a murder to do something secret, which all ends up to a mysterious end.

title: Look at the Sky
overview: A teenager feeling loneliness

title: Rajdhani Punjab
overview: A story of when the drug mafia targets Chandigarh as a hub, plotting to exploit the son of anti-drug leader Yograj Singh to seize control.

title: Scent of Nocturnal Flowers
overview: Phool Gari (Scent of Nocturnal Flowers) explores the quiet transformation of a liminal space beside Barasat railway station, shifting from a night flower market to a morning auto stand. As metro construction slowly encroaches, swallowing the space they call their own, the film follows the occupants’ rhythms, their delicate balance between labour and survival, and their struggle for legitimacy within a formal space.

title: A Song of Midnight
overview: A thriller student short film from Prague Film School by Aditya K. A misfit young man breaks into a widowed old man’s house — but what he finds inside will change everything.

overview: Portrays a couple form Kerala who lost their house during harsh winter days while trying settle down in Delhi, building a bond amid challenges in a strange city.

overview: "OKA BRUNDAVANAM" follows Maha, Raja Vikram, and Nainika as they unite to fulfill a mother's dream, uncover a Christmas mystery, and embark on a journey of self-discovery, unity, and the magic of granting wishes.

title: jaggo aayi aa
overview: A former vengeful youth transforms into a spiritual leader as he confronts corruption threatening his village. Facing personal demons and systemic oppression, he leads farmers in their fight for justice.

title: Vallamai
overview: Vallamai is a Tamil movie starring Premgi Amaren, Divya Darshini and Deepa Shankar in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Karuppaiyaa Murugan.

title: Chhoti Gold
overview: An absurd, surreal look at the lives of two people and the way their lives turn out after meeting each other.

title: Eternal Quill
overview: A solitary man unravels as the voices in his head and a haunting black feather drag him toward an unavoidable fate

title: Punjabi Aa Gaye Oye
overview: A man is left responsible for raising four young boys after their parents are involved in a tragic accident, though the man's past threatens to catch up with him.

title: Our Little Worlds of Desires
overview: An unknown being wakes up scared and wishes for a sunflower in a world without sun.

title: Backdoor
overview: A faustian deal, four souls and the time they’ve bargained. Sand runs out. Moth to a flame, they return to raise their chips. The gamemaster weaves their fates into a single cruel game. A rigged deal, a cursed flop; only a backdoor can save them now.

title: Rise
overview: At a state basketball trial, Safi's fate rests in the hands of the formidable coach Yudhisthir. Their identical pasts but contrasting choices ignite a fierce battle - will Safi become Yudhisthir or Rise as himself?

overview: Akshay finds himself in a hilarious mess when he falls in love with two girls at the same time, without either of them knowing. To make things worse, his strict father is completely against love. Now, Akshay must juggle both sides, hide the truth, and somehow escape the chaos hes created.

title: EGO
overview: Sarakka, a lady don determined to avenge her long-lost enemy, unexpectedly finds herself preparing for the IELTS to catch him, setting off a hilarious and heartwarming ride through pride, power, and pronunciation.

title: A Life Inside Me
overview: In the final months of his life, Sitaram decides to embrace his gender identity, stepping into his true self after years of repression. At the same time, his daughter confronts her own turning point—facing an abusive marriage and an unexpected pregnancy, she seeks a way out and a new beginning. Their parallel journeys unfold with emotional depth, revealing resilience, transformation, and the pursuit of freedom.

title: Saira Khan Case
overview: After a cruel talaq abroad, a resilient mother defies oppressive laws and fights back through India's secular courts-battling for her children, her rights, and her dignity in a powerful journey of justice and courage.

title: Bhamini
overview: The plot of the film traces the journey of Suhita, as an illegal clinical trial of Human Papillomavirus leads to multiple deaths of innocent girls and women. She joins hands with her friend and colleague Kamal as well as special officer Indra, to fight against the breakout.

title: Poonga
overview: Poonga is a Tamil movie written and directed by KP Tanasekar.

title: Chaar Diwaari
overview: Tired of rituals and idol polish, God slips out of the temple one morning to eat street food and ask bigger questions. He meets Sameer, a quiet boy with fading friendships and an open heart. As they ride across Jaipur, what begins as banter becomes a journey into memory, faith, and forgotten art. In the end, God vanishes - leaving behind a canvas, some colors, and a new artist to finish the work

title: Shubhchintak
overview: Novice Meghna and her two accomplices plot to honey trap Sanjay for revenge, facing humorous and moral challenges. Will she let revenge consume her?

title: Flames
overview: Mahesh, a ‘low’ caste migrant farmworker, is forced to go on a run to protect his son who gets accused of a murder.

title: Sarhadein
overview: In Dubai, two roomies—one Indian, one Pakistani—are locked in a fierce but hilarious rivalry. But when a love triangle shakes things up, their bromance goes next level, showing that deep down, they’re all about unity beyond borders.

title: Himuchri
overview: Manoj, the son of retired lineman Balan Pillai, and the girls from three different religious sects who enter his life are the subjects of Himuchri. Manoj learns about this worldly existence, impermanence, the necessity of preserving the soul's purity forever, and the fact that all living things are a part of Brahman from the words of Swamiji, who stands in between.

title: Sangama
overview: A behind-the-scenes look at how a people’s movement against divisive politics takes on an  authoritarian party in power in the Indian Election-2024. Wake-up Karnataka unites with citizens’  groups across India, dramatically shifting conversation from ‘mandir’ (temple) to ‘mudda’ (people’s  problems), making this a closely fought election.

title: Hanji Kaun
overview: Three friends move into a new flat, only to find dead bodies, weird visitors, and nonstop chaos! Mystery meets comedy in this mad, wild ride!

title: Soohe Ve Cheere Waleya
overview: Set in 1990s Punjab, near the India-Pakistan border, Sooba is a well-educated young man who runs a telephone shop yet feels incomplete without his ancestral land.

title: Sheher-E-Lucknow
overview: A docu-film about the city Lucknow where the creators ask their family members important questions they have always wanted answers to, while indulging in tomfoolery around town. The film showcases the differences in the way three different generations perceive Lucknow. An ode to the city, and an attempt to provide solace to the social misfits of the creators' hometown.

title: Rishte Naate
overview: Jass’s business struggles pull him away from Reet, leading her to call his mother for support. But an old friend, family clashes, and chaos soon take over!

title: My Otter Diary
overview: On the banks of the Cauvery River in southern India, wildlife filmmaker Sugandhi Gadadhar studies the behavior of Asian otters. On one of the subcontinent's most dynamic waterways, a conflict has arisen between these small carnivorous mammals and fishermen, whose livelihoods also depend on the river's resources.

title: Private
overview: When an old man and a teenager from different walks of life are brought together by chance, they form an unlikely connection that transforms them both in unexpected ways.

title: Beauty
overview: A moving and suspenseful tale of a father`s unshakable love. When his daughter suddenly goes missing, his world is turned upside down. What begins as a desperate search soon becomes a gripping journey filled with questions of trust, innocence, and the true meaning of unconditional love. A film that belongs to everyone, Beauty explores a parent`s relentless hope and the lengths they will go to for their child.

title: Raagu Kethu
overview: Raagu Kethu is a 2025 Indian Tamil-language film written and directed by Durai Balasundaram. The film stars P. Samuthirakani, Archana Kanthan, and Sandhya Sree in the lead roles. It is produced by Santhi Balasundaram under the banner of Thamizharasan Theaters.

title: Joker
overview: The life of this 3 feet 7 inch dwarf is full of mocks and taunts, yet he hugs his illusions and dreams in a positive manner. It is the only way to enjoy being a joker. His companion was a hen who laid eggs everyday and gave him a golden one. He used to sell it and made his ends meet. Due to financial crisis, he got to work in a marriage party, dressed as a joker. It made his life colorful. Suddenly he gets the news of an ongoing fair where he could find work, but unfortunately he reached there at a wrong time.

title: Maharani
overview: A working mom and her witty housekeeper navigate their complex relationship while managing home and career. Their love-hate dynamic unfolds in this relatable comedy.

title: Chhota Bheem: Dinosaur World
overview: When a scientist has trouble caring for his secret baby dinosaur, he takes Bheem and friends back in time to return the pet to its natural habitat.

title: Chiranjeeva
overview: What happens when one man starts seeing everyone’s future? A hilarious socio-fantasy ride filled with chaos, charm, and twists of fate!

title: White Snow
overview: Set in and around Kargil, a Muslim-dominated town in the Himalayas, where a war was fought between India and Pakistan in 1999, the film tells the story of Amir, whose short film gets banned due to a complaint from a religious leader, and his social media accounts gets blocked. His elderly mother Fatima sets out on an arduous journey in the Himalayan mountains to show the film in villages, which breaks her mentally and physically and brings her close to madness before she becomes a free soul.

title: 18 Heartbeats: Recording Live
overview: Ansh and Kavya chase the theory of 18 Heartbeats, a journey that fades into silence, only to be rediscovered a decade later by a college professor amidst a rising student protest.

title: Unnai Kaanadha Naan
overview: Aadharsh spends the entire day anticipating a call or message from Meghana, growing restless as the silence lingers. When she finally calls late at night, their long-awaited conversation takes a subtle but tense turn. Emotions simmer beneath the surface, and the moment quietly unravels into conflict. As misunderstandings grow, one question remains—can their bond withstand the strain?

title: Brotherhood - A 1984 Short Film
overview: Film about the resistance group called "the brotherhood" in 1984

title: Letters From Bun
overview: Meera, a young professional suspended in the quiet rhythms of her days, finds solace in an unlikely place. Drifting through the isolation of early adulthood, she rediscovers her sense of self—and her connection to the world—after stumbling upon a forgotten schoolmate’s blog.

title: Gulab aur Aaina
overview: Aaina, insecure about her complexion dreams of getting married to a boy who finds her attractive. She comes across Gulab a flamboyant toilet cleaner, who finds her attractive but Aaina's father has chosen someone else for the marriage.

title: GARDEN LIFE
overview: On his nineteenth birthday, a grieving teenager struggles with the guilt of losing his parents in a tragic car accident exactly one year ago. The lightning strike that caused the crash left him with a strange affliction, he can no longer fully touch the world, phasing through everything he tries to hold onto. Haunted by memories, trapped in a body that feels like a prison, and unable to find peace, he turns to the only escape left: stepping out of his intangible existence into the storm.

title: The Pulse Beneath the Steel
overview: Once the beating heart of Beijing’s steel industry, Shougang was a leviathan forged from iron and fire. Its blast furnaces once echoed with labour and ambition, embodying the raw force of China’s industrial might. Today, these same structures are repurposed into spaces of digital innovation and Olympic legacy, marking one of the most ambitious urban transformations in modern China.  This documentary traces the metamorphosis of Shougang Park through three poetic chapters: its industrial past, the deliberate reinvention of its architecture, and its re-emergence as a tech-driven ecosystem. Through immersive visuals and the voices of those who once toiled within its furnaces and those now forging its future, The Pulse Beneath the Steel is more than a portrait of place. It is a meditation on memory and transformation at the heart of a city that bridges heritage and modernity.

title: Beach
overview: Karthick, an orphan raised by a church father, lives in a ladies' hostel under his guardian’s care and works as a bank executive. Amrita, raised by her handicapped brother, struggles with her family’s past debt while working as a salesgirl in Chennai.  A misunderstanding brings Karthick and Amrita together, leading to a blossoming romance. As Amrita gradually overcomes her fears and confesses her love, their lives take a dark turn. A gang of ruthless teenagers lurking on the beach targets them, attacking Karthick and abducting Amrita.  Can Karthick save Amrita? What unfolds next is a gripping tale of survival, courage, and fate.

title: Roohrangi
overview: A queer voyage along the labyrinths of dreams, archives and lived histories, Roohrangi navigates the real and the imaginary – traversing the filmmaker’s encounters in a gay-cruising forest-reserve as he retraces the memory of his grandfather’s leucoderma-ridden face. A face on whose white-and-brown patches, he saw a forest of miraculous trees.

title: Sea of Love
overview: Ratheesh develops strong romantic feelings for his neighbour, Jumaila, but she ends up rejecting him. Things take a turn when Jumaila's sexuality is uncovered.

title: Hidden Tremors
overview: Set against the serene yet fragile landscape of Kanjirappally, Hidden Tremors is a deeply personal and emotionally resonant portrait of a community in transition. As frequent landslides and subtle seismic shifts threaten both land and life, a quieter crisis unfolds within a family struggling to hold on — to land, to memory, and to each other. Through evocative performances, the film captures the emotional depth of separation, resilience, and longing.

title: Dasettante Cycle
overview: A security guard's mundane life transforms when unexpected events affect his family, leading him through a series of incidents that challenge his perspectives on society.

title: Bare Voice
overview: This documentary celebrates legendary Bengali singer-songwriter Kabir Suman and his enduring muse, Kolkata. While showcasing a formidable body of Suman's timeless songs, which also construct the narrative of his life, the film demonstrates why he might just be world's greatest unsung singer-songwriter and how easily genius too can slip through the cracks of history.

title: Cristina Kathirvelan
overview: Kathirvelan is in love with Cristina . Both are give their documents to the witnesses for the registered marriage of the sister of the rowdy. In it, the hero and heroine who gave the documents to the witnesses receive a wrong marriage certificate as if they were married. The heroine Cristina is engaged to marry a stranger. Kathir fights and join.

title: Gamblers
overview: Players gather at a hidden casino to compete for a 100 crore prize. As they play, their secret agendas surface, transforming the game into a lethal competition.

overview: Two assassins are assigned to kill the son of a reputed producer.  Guns and Betrayal survive the Rivalry.

overview: Upcoming Kannada Comedy Film Starring Nagabhusan

overview: A man is caught in an unexpected love triangle involving his childhood friend and a warm-hearted stranger.

overview: Convinced he’s dying, a hypochondriac is pulled into life by a free-spirited woman who shows him that the true danger is learning how to live.

title: Iravin Vizhigal
overview: This World is Sleeping in the Darkness of Websites.in Such a Situation, the Direction of One's Life Changes...i Can't Bear It. The Story is What He Wakes Up Like the Eyes of the Night to Correct This World That is Sleeping on the Web in That Anger.

title: Podi Enna Vittu Enaku Enna Kavala
overview: "Podi Enna Vittu Enaku Enna Kavala" is a Tamil motivational song addressing love failure, inspiring men to embrace resilience after heartbreak. Crafted entirely by multitalented artist Ashoksaravanan, the track highlights his versatility as he single-handedly composed its melody, penned empowering lyrics, and produced its instrumental arrangements. Beyond music, he likely directed the accompanying visuals (e.g., music video) and managed the project’s execution, funding, and release. This end-to-end creative control underscores his dedication to delivering a message of perseverance, blending artistry and logistics to inspire listeners through a unified vision of strength and renewal.

title: McGuffin
overview: A private detective starts to lose himself as he chases clues for a unique case- To find McGuffin.

title: CrowShit
overview: Two Strangers sharing the moments of hope and stays being strangers itself.

title: Taron Paar
overview: Two lovers, separated in childhood by borders, now search for each other across India and Pakistan. Will fate reunite them?

title: Dreams Such As Ours
overview: Kartik & Aman’s relationship is tested when one of them has a fling which leads to a domestic spat. Kartik’s parents’ relationship breaks apart when Damodar and Vasudha have a tiff. Will these two couples ever be able to resolve their differences? Will their relationships stand the test of time? Kuch Sapney Apne is a sensitive heartwarming film about relationships, queer or not, and what happens when uncomfortable truths challenge relationships.

title: Diljala Raanjha
overview: Left heartbroken, he battles memories that refuse to die and becomes the man the pain creates.

title: Buddha & Me
overview: “Buddha & Me” is a meditative 14-minute documentary by filmmaker Sunil Babbar, exploring the timeless spiritual resonance of Sarnath—the sacred site where the Buddha delivered his first sermon. Through evocative visuals, reflective narration, and a deeply personal lens, the film weaves together the ancient teachings of the Buddha with the filmmaker’s own inner journey. Set against the tranquil backdrop of Sarnath’s ruins and monastic life, Buddha & Me becomes both a pilgrimage and a quiet dialogue between the self and the enlightened path.
