title: Happy Khush Ho Gaya
overview: A con artist pretends to be the reincarnation of a villager to steal land from his family, but the lie soon results in chaos.

title: Ru Ba Ru
overview: Two sisters, one a rudaali (professional mourner) and the other a nachaniya (dancer), navigate survival, dignity, and womanhood in rural Rajasthan. Facing the caste system, social judgment, and unwanted male attention, they find solace in sisterhood and quiet rebellion.

title: His Story of Itihaas
overview: It is a true story about a physics teacher who stands up against the system to question the wrong and distorted history told to Indians for generations in the schools.

title: Andondittu Kaala
overview: A young boy dreams of becoming a director after witnessing a shooting in his film. Years later, in order to fulfil his dreams, he moves to the city and strives to overcome challenges.

title: Fikar Karo-Na
overview: Dad wants Harry married, but Harry’s here to mess it up! Will we get a wedding or total chaos? Let’s find out!

title: गाजर का हलवा
overview: Set in 1948, a year after independence, Gajar Ka Halwa is a deeply personal tale of love, loss, and the invisible scars of Partition. In the fictional town of Navkot, a father and daughter, Ardaas and Baani, wait for the return of Harman, their wife, and mother, whilst clinging onto hope through letters and a simple recipe that carries memories of home.  But this is no ordinary story. Told through the voice of Laqeer, a personified boundary burdened by the weight of separation, the film explores the quiet aftermath of the Partition- not just the displacement, but the lingering absence, the unanswered letters, the daunting secrets, and the wounds that time cannot heal.  With poetry, music, and unforgettable characters, Gajar Ka Halwa is a poignant reflection on love that lingers- warm, wistful, and bittersweet, just like the first bite of something once familiar yet forever changed.

title: In The Blood
overview: When Imsu, caught between two worlds and two names, challenges the strained love of his mother, a simple dinner spirals into an emotional standoff that ends only when a line is crossed.

title: Green Girl
overview: Amidst a volatile blend of religious strife, suppressed sexualities, and divine sermons in an Indian town, a teenage inter-faith couple—one of whom is innocently entangled in a fundamentalist group, dream an illusive American Dream.

title: Sugar Date
overview: After getting matched on a dating app, Rony and Anaha decided to meet for a dinner date at Rony's house. Will it be a sugar date?

title: A WISH TO REMEMBER
overview: Thomas Britto once a bright, intelligent programmer is now on a hunt to catch two unidentified men who has caused him great harm by stealing his program, leaves him with a medical condition, where does the truth lead him?

title: 30 Days of Autumn
overview: An ambitious young woman on a month-long government assignment in rural Bengal struggles with loneliness as she forms a complex bond with her teenage housekeeper. As their innocent infatuation and aspirations clash with the impermanence of their relationship, their brief connection leaves her profoundly changed.

title: METAMORPHOSIS
overview: Metamorphosis is a deeply personal, bittersweet memoir that peers into the psyche of a student caught in the relentless grind of competitive examinations. Through fragments of memory, confession, and quiet observation, the film unravels the inner battles waged in solitude—the sleepless nights, the weight of expectations, and the silent pain of repeated failures and small triumphs.  As I chart my own journey through this unforgiving landscape, the film becomes more than just a chronicle of preparation. It is an intimate exploration of how these examinations, with all their pressures and promises, reshaped my understanding of hard work, success, and the fleeting nature of this world.  Metamorphosis is not merely about reaching a goal—it is about the transformation that occurs in pursuit of one. It is about the boy who entered this race, and the person who emerged from it, forever changed.

title: The Tale of Kumbhaganj
overview: Set in the peaks of the Kumbhaganj mountain range, relentless treasure hunter Raman risks everything to unearth a mythical treasure. But as his obsession spirals, the real question arises—does materialistic desire corrupt the man, or does the man expose the greed lurking within us all?

title: The Itch
overview: On the morning of her birthday, a teenager’s accidental discovery of pleasure cracks open a world of unspoken desires within her seemingly conservative Indian household, forcing her and her mother onto unexpected paths.

title: Vellapanti
overview: Vellapanti story revolves around four childhood friends who struggle to fulfill their ambitions but each time find themselves in a soup.

title: K.G.N
overview: In British-ruled India, two brothers, one a law-abiding police officer, the other a fiery revolutionary - are torn apart by betrayal and injustice, but must unite to avenge their father's death and free their village from colonial tyranny.

title: Aagakadavana
overview: Three friends desires to start their own medical shop, find issues by chain of troubles, Struggles inside a thorn forest along with strangers to resolve all their issues before they lost their life more than money.

title: Meri Pyari Daadi
overview: A young boy struggling with school and friendships finds strength and guidance through his loving grandmother. Their special bond grows as she helps him overcome life's challenges

title: In Her Silence
overview: A silent woman returns to the same park bench every day, where life and death quietly intersect in a ritual of flowers and waiting.

title: TWERK
overview: A mother, a dancer, and a rebel at heart, Diya lives under the weight of a matriarchal and orthodox household. In a quiet act of defiance, she secretly sneaks out to rediscover the art of dance, igniting a chain of challenges that threaten to unravel her world. As family tensions rise and secrets come to light, Diya must confront her passion, fears, and the true meaning of individuality, proving that resilience can rewrite even the strictest expectations.

title: X & Y
overview: An eager unborn soul, desperate to experience life, pleads with the Creator to send him to Earth. Tasked with a unique mission, he must find his future parents and ensure their union, only then can he be born.

title: Maayakoothu
overview: A writer's tale unravels-a magical and mystical ride through realms unknown.

title: CHHĀYE
overview: The story follows a protagonist grappled by the weight of their previous actions, illustrating that while time moves forward, the "shadow" of one's past is an inseparable companion. This raw, emotional narrative delves into themes of guilt, consequence, and the internal struggle to find peace amidst a history that refuses to fade.

title: Caged (In) and Out
overview: "Caged (In) and Out", by Rishabh Jain, a jarring account of domestic domestic violence in India.  The film produced in-house by JIBS, sheds light on the pervasive issue of domestic violence in India, offering an intimate perspective through the voices of survivors and their families. It also highlights the relentless efforts of grassroots women-led organizations fighting for justice and the urgent need for early gender sensitization in communities.

title: One Fire
overview: ONE FIRE is a new documentary film exploring the mysteries of Theosophy, focusing on Helena Petrovna Blavatsky and her groundbreaking work, The Secret Doctrine. The film traces how Blavatsky's ideas challenged conventional thought and inspired generations of seekers. It also examines the hidden influence of Theosophy - often unknown to many - on modern thought, the arts, music, education, and politics. At the same time, ONE FIRE serves as a meditation on experiencing eternal truths through striking visuals and original music, inviting audiences to engage not only intellectually but also emotionally with Blavatsky's enduring legacy.

title: CHUPPI: AN ECHO MEANT FOR ONE
overview: “Chuppi” is my first short film, a film that delves into the haunting stillness of a mind at war with itself.

title: Vair
overview: Fateh fires a shot—a murder, police chase, and revenge follows. But what’s the real mystery behind it all? Watch ‘Vair’ to uncover the truth!

title: Pelli Kaani Prasad
overview: Caught between tradition and his father's greed, prasad struggles to fulfill his dream of marriage.

title: Moda Moda
overview: A couple wants to name their would-be child "Clouds".

title: Whispers of Wind
overview: In a quiet, open space, a young man sits on a park bench, lost in conversation with someone deeply important to him. As their exchange unfolds, he smiles, he reminisces, and he listens intently—until a single wide shot reveals the haunting truth: he is alone.  Whispers of Wind is a psychological drama that explores love, loss, and the power of memory. Shot in monochrome to enhance its emotional depth, the film captures the delicate balance between reality and illusion, leaving the audience with a lingering sense of melancholy and reflection.

title: The Lasting August
overview: Indo-Pak collaboration animated film directed by Ammar Aziz

title: A Lone Floor
overview: A tormented investigative journalist, haunted by a disturbing video and an unrelenting thumping from the floor above, finds himself trapped in a collapsing psychological maze—where every corridor leads deeper into guilt, fractured identity, and a horrifying truth buried in his own mind.

title: AUSAL
overview: "Ausal" is a hard-hitting social drama that targets the deep-rooted, rusted mindset prevailing in government offices. It narrates the story of public servants who, over time, start believing themselves to be masters rather than servants of the people whose taxes pay for their positions.  The story follows a young RTI activist, Arjun, who sets out not for revenge but to reform a decaying system that wronged his family. Through protests, legal battles, and public awareness drives, Arjun challenges those government employees who misuse their power and neglect their duties.

title: Game of Loans
overview: Over the course of a single day, a jobless compulsive gambler finds his world spiraling out of control when a noise at his door draws him into a dangerous confrontation that blurs the line between debt and survival. The film follows Daniel, a jobless compulsive gambler whose life revolves around the instant gratification of online betting. One seemingly ordinary day, while his wife and child are away, Daniel’s monotonous gambling routine is interrupted by a sharp, unexplained noise at his doorstep. What begins as mild curiosity spirals into a tense and unpredictable encounter, as he is confronted by unexpected visitors who draw him into a dangerous game far beyond the digital realm.

title: Holocaust
overview: When aspiring filmmaker Jeni stumbles upon a secluded bungalow in Kerala, it feels like the perfect setting for her next horror film. But as she explores the eerie property, she discovers a mysterious box, identical to one from her script. What begins as an uncanny coincidence quickly spirals into a living nightmare. Each day brings new horrors, and with only six days remaining, Jeni must unravel the dark secrets buried within the house or become part of its sinister story forever.

title: Date with Saie
overview: An aspiring filmmaker, Raghunath wants to make a film with Marathi superstar Saie Tamhankar as his heroine. What happens when his admiration becomes a dangerous obsession, blurring boundaries?

title: Last Stop Khanda
overview: Kiran, a man secretly in love with his best friend, also named Kiran. When she suffers a heartbreak, he sees his chance to finally confess his feelings.

title: Nafratein
overview: Nafratein depicts the story of Karan, a young rebel, torn between rage and love, as he battles the turmoil within and the world around him.

title: Mad Over Disco
overview: Disco Deewane follows the reunion of Shriprakash, an acclaimed activist filmmaker, and Disco, a vibrant young music producer from a disadvantaged community. The film brings them together years after they parted ways, not as mentor and protégé, but as collaborators tasked with composing a song together.

title: Pade Akasha
overview: The story is inspired by Dr. Sruti Mohapatra, a courageous woman from Odisha in a wheelchair. An IAS qualifier, she lost her job due to disability but never gave up, becoming a powerful social activist and inspiring many with her resilience.

title: The Meeting Point
overview: In the quiet hum of a café, two strangers cross paths - Kabir, a doctor weighed down by unfinished work and unspoken loneliness, and Vaani, an artist carrying fragments of a painful past. Over chai, poetry, and fleeting silences, they stumble into a conversation that feels like a pause from the world - fragile yet transformative. A story about chance encounters and the unspoken ways we heal each other, The Meeting Point captures the beauty of lives brushing against one another, if only for an evening.

title: Absent
overview: What remains when something or someone disappears? A meditation on absence, memory, and the unseen forces that linger beyond perception.

title: Kadukka
overview: In a peaceful village, Two Young best Friends fall for the same Beautiful Girl. What starts as friendship soon turns into a comedy-filled Love war. Each tries to win her heart with charm, tricks, and emotions, but the girl has a surprise of her own is shown in a Comedy Suspense with Fun filled power packed manner.

title: Mithada Maheman
overview: Distraught Aditya finds himself on a road trip with three strangers who offer different perspectives on his life.

title: Dear Lost
overview: Anandhu, a quiet and emotionally withdrawn young man, lives a seemingly peaceful life with his sister. But when an unexpected truth surfaces, their world is turned upside down.

title: The Mirror Room
overview: Trapped in a time loop trying to solve a murder, detective Aarav's mind fractures. Torn between his partners' advice, he must solve the case while confronting a terrifying possibility: he is the most unreliable witness.

title: Guts
overview: A son honors his mothers wish by leads life of an honest cop down a righteous path, where his every moral choice integrity invites relentless adversaries. Can he endure them and uphold justice?

title: Abhanga Tukaram
overview: Abhanga Tukaram based on the Abhanga saga of Saint Tukaram Maharaj A rich collection of saintly literature on the silver screen. Maharashtra has been enriched by the thought of saints. The Abhangagatha of Jagadguru Sant Shrestha Tukaram Maharaj is a very valuable treasure in Marathi literature.

title: Kanya Kumari
overview: Kanyakumari, a funny and heartfelt tale of love set in a village of Srikakulam district...

title: Hasrat (An Uncommon Love Story)
overview: In this twisted love story, old flames and family drama test a couple. Will their love survive, or will they end up facing a heartbreaking fate ?

title: Lahari
overview: A slice-of-life film, 'Lahari' meanders through the lives of two friends: boatman Bhuta and fisherman Dinu, and takes us on their journey of trying to establish indigenous methods of livelihood for survival and to elevate their present situation. In the process, the film depicts the invasion of urban capitalism, superficial and auto-centred, personified by tourists, confronted to a certain authenticity and way of life.

title: In Search of a Hidden Fountain
overview: In an age dominated by convenience, the fountain pen seems a relic of the past. Yet, a devoted few remain loyal to its timeless charm. This documentary delves into their world, uncovering the passion, stories and the nostalgia that keep the ink of tradition flowing.

title: The Writer's Room
overview: What can even go wrong when Mr. G. R Indugopan tries starting his morning productive by finishing his writing assignments, when a self-proclaimed "fan" barges into his workspace, asking unwanted questions !?

overview: Alien Brihaspati is primarily a sci-fi short film and a related musical score about a cosmic adventure, created by AV Anoop and his team

title: Kanthan malai
overview: The film centers on the religious and historical tensions surrounding the Thiruparankundram hill area in Madurai.

title: Veena Saraswathi
overview: "I think Gods, watching me what I become"

overview: Silence and loss shape their world, but love becomes their guide. Suraj and Mukta embark on a journey of healing and rediscovery.

title: Disorder
overview: In a college canteen, two students find themselves caught in a quiet confusion that blurs the line between order and reality.

title: Motu Patlu vs the Ghost House
overview: In Motu Patlu vs. the Ghost House, a builder plans to demolish Furfuri Nagar for an amusement park, so he hires John the Don to scare the residents away with a ghost plot. John and his goons dress as ghosts to steal from and frighten the townspeople, but the friends discover the ruse after seeing a fake ghost and realizing the builder's involvement. To combat the fake ghosts, Dr. Jhatka creates a special "invisibility powder" to turn the tables on John and the builder.

title: All about weddings
overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of a traditional Bengali wedding in Cooch Behar, Biye Fiye Niye is a witty and contemporary exploration of love, friendship, and the evolving institution of marriage. On the surface, it’s a joyous celebration of Sromona, finally ready to marry her charming Delhi-based fiancé, Rohan. But as friends and family from both sides gather in festive excitement, a complex web of tensions and secrets begins to unravel. At the heart of the story lies the quietly collapsing marriage of Sromona’s closest friend Aditi and her husband Ishan, sharply contrasting with the wedding’s outward exuberance. Meanwhile, Rohan’s sister Tisha challenges the illusion of perfection as her probing questions expose emotional fractures beneath the surface. Unfolding over one eventful day, the film navigates messy contemporary relationships with sharp humor, candid emotions, and music—questioning love, identity, and societal expectations.

title: Bloody Mosquito
overview: In the dead of night, a lone mosquito prowls, hungry for blood. It moves like a phantom, lurking in the shadows, striking with precision. Yash, its restless prey, tosses and turns, swatting at the air, frustration boiling into obsession. he hunts through the dim-lit room, eyes darting, breath shallow. The mosquito stays just out of reach, its eerie buzz echoing like a cruel laugh.Minutes drag, paranoia creeps in. Who is truly the hunter? Who is the hunted? Then-BZZZZ-one final move. A slap. Silence. But in the darkness... something still lingers.

title: Ek Raadha Ek Meera
overview: When Krishna's love for Saanvi goes unreciprocated, he moves to Slovenia for university. Saanvi eventually realises she has feelings for him, but he about to get married.

overview: Sindhionism Presents Byo Cha Khape is a Sindhi comedy-drama where a harmless lie by two friends spirals into unexpected twists of romance, debt, and peril. At its heart, it's a story of friendship and the enduring belief that truth always triumphs.

title: Irudhi Muyarchi
overview: Irudhi Muyarchi is a Tamil movie starring Ranjith and Meghali Meenakshi in prominent roles. It is written and directed by Venkat Janaa.

overview: A young man makes a phone call late at night  not to reconnect, but to let go. What begins as a voicemail turns into a quiet monologue about love, memory, and the version of someone we carry long after they’re gone.

overview: At a Goa restaurant, Anvi meets a naval officer for arranged marriage talks. Though beautiful and from a wealthy family, she hides a secret - her heart belongs to another. She declines his proposal.

overview: Fleeing the cops, Sachin hides in a chawl room but finds a mad old man plotting his wife's murder. Trapped, he must outsmart a killer who's been planning it for decades.

But when his girlfriend and then he himself go missing the truth begins to unfeld Victims are being brainwashed by a mysterious system to worship an unknown idel Whos behind it and why?

overview: Homeless and broken in Bengaluru, a desperate Putanna returns to his rural family that he once stole from and abandoned.

overview: A Gujarati immigrant in Los Angeles balances jobs, schemes, and romance while pursuing his green card, until love and hidden truths clash in a tale of dreams, family, and fresh starts.

overview: A man is left alone in his apartment for a month by his flatmates, not returning his calls or replying back to his messages. Much to his dismay, he is tasked to take care of their friend for a night.

title: Summer breeze
overview: In a city built on imbalance, a rich man and a delivery boy meet just for a moment - that moment reveals a deeper truth about class and capitalism.

title: Majhi Prarthana
overview: Set in British-era rural Maharashtra, Majhi Prarthana – Akalpaniya Prem Katha is a heart-wrenching tale of unimaginable love. Golya and Prarthana’s love blooms like a wildflower amidst thorns and they find solace in each other’s hearts, shining brighter than the stars. But as their love deepens, a dark force rises —an unrelenting shadow of power and betrayal determined to crush their dreams. Will their love withstand the storm and carve its name into history, or will it be lost in the abyss of fate?

title: Stream-Story
overview: In Himachal Pradesh’s Kangra Valley, an ancient network of kuhls – hand-built water channels – carries water. The kohlis, “water masters,” struggle to protect this heritage, custodians of a way of life where water flows alongside folk tales, myths, and local arts.

title: Redlight to Limelight
overview: A group of sex workers and brothel youth form a film production house in the Kalighat redlight area, Kolkata, India. Despite the opposition from the conservative society, they are determined to become filmmakers, resist prostitution among the second generation, survive through the art of cinema, and aspire to transform the redlight area into a professional film colony in the post-pandemic time.

title: Surabhila Sundara Swapnam
overview: Surabhila Sundara Swapnam features the story of a common man leading a life with his wife and friends in a quaint town. With a dream that he needs to fulfill, the man sets out on a journey, owning a land under his name.  How he manages to achieve his dream and what challenges he faces to get there form the entire story.

title: Zaag
overview: Arhan is deeply in love with Samara and proposes to her. However, on their engagement night, Samara catches a glimpse of a darker, more mysterious side of him, causing her to question their relationship and whether she truly knows him. Determined to find clarity, she delves deeper to understand him, only to discover something that completely transforms her view of him and their future together.

title: You in this city, This city inside You
overview: Through a series of unanswered phone calls made by an unnamed narrator, we listen to the dreams, fears, and ambitions of a migrant man working as a cook in Bombay, while witnessing glimpses of daily life unfolding across the city

overview: A tragic car crash leaves a wealthy couple stranded on a remote road. Seeking shelter in a secluded house, they uncover dark secrets and become entangled in a deadly game of murder, deception, and revenge-where nothing is as it seems.

title: Shutter : The Final Chapter
overview: When Prashanth, a 21-year-old with the eerie power to step into photographs and relive the moments within them, finally thinks he’s escaped the chaos of his past, he’s pulled into a new nightmare. A warped dimension ruled by his sinister lookalike. As reality and illusion blur, an assassin named Arjun closes in on him in the real world.  Trapped between timelines, hunted in both worlds and losing control of his own mind, Prashanth must uncover the truth before the shutter closes for good.

title: Affliction
overview: 9-year-old Bittu battles a mysterious fever, an affliction that deepens with an unfamiliar stirring within him as he watches his uncle’s young wife, Kusum, longing for a husband who toils far from home.

title: Chalisa
overview: A journey through Hanuman’s magical life.

title: Itlu Me Yedhava
overview: Srinu, a directionless 30-year-old, falls for perfect neighbor Manaswini. As he transforms himself to win her love, her father gives him one month to prove his worth, but mishaps complicate his journey.

title: Ten Months
overview: Set in the picturesque village of Tiruvala, 'Pathu Maasam' tells the story of the survival of a basic caste laborer named Praseetha. She throws her husband Raghu out of the house under special circumstances and realizes that she is pregnant one of the next few days. This leaves Praseetha conflicted but she does not give up. Raghu, on the other hand, leads a more chaotic life.

overview: An 11-year-old boy, who loves his father more than anything learns that his father had a tough childhood, miraculously gets a chance to travel to past and tries to make his father's childhood happy.

overview: A nostalgic short documentary capturing heartfelt memories of people recalling their very first experience watching a film in a theatre. Each voice shares a personal story of wonder, excitement, and the timeless magic of cinema.

title: Green Blackberries
overview: In a small tribal village in India’s North Eastern Region lives a young schoolgirl—the academically gifted Nishu. Her school consists of one room, housing children from kindergarten to sixth grade. On the day of her final exam, Nishu sets off from home as usual with her elder sister, crossing a river by motorboat. But suddenly disaster strikes. The boat stalls, stuck against a jutting rock. Will Nishu make it to school on time? If not, what will become of her dream of moving with her sister to the city?

title: Forever Running Away
overview: A man is on the run, but who or what is he running away from?

title: New India
overview: In this sharp and unapologetic stand-up special, comedian Kunal Kamra dissects the absurdities of modern-day India with biting satire and fearless political commentary. Tackling topics like hyper-nationalism, media propaganda, and political hypocrisy, Kamra delivers brutally honest punchlines aimed at both leaders and the culture of blind devotion. With viral-worthy bits-including a controversial parody targeting Maharashtra's Deputy CM Eknath Shinde-Kamra walks the line between humor and dissent, sparking both laughter and backlash. Naya Bharat is a bold reflection of a country caught between comedy and chaos.

title: Apna Amitabh
overview: This is a story of a young boy named Vijay. He lives with his family in a small village named Dakita Meerganj. Vijay studies in the 9th standard of a government school. He is a huge fan of Super Star Amitabh Bachchan and always tries to behave like him. He was born in a lower cast family. And Vijay's father Anna Jamadar's profession is to clean toilet of the village. All the villagers tease Vijay by calling him after his father's profession as "Anna Safaiwale ka Beta" (cleaner's son), which he doesn't like. This film is cast cast-based political drama.

title: Soch Toh Parey
overview: A heartfelt story of love that blossoms between two people from completely different backgrounds. As they navigate personal struggles and societal resistance, their connection deepens into something unshakable. Together, they prove that love knows no boundaries and can truly transform lives forever.

title: Food and Music
overview: floating images, abstractions, memories. silhouettes of a life lived in Jawaharlal Nehru University

title: 1098 Ten, Nine, Eight: A Countdown to Infinity
overview: Childline receives a distressing complaint about a +2 student, who is of mixed Bengali and Malayali Dalit heritage, being expelled from a government school in a rural village without any apparent reason. Upon investigating, the Childline team exposes a web of social, political, and racial secrets, revealing that institutions and individuals meant to be role models are culpable. As the team digs deeper, they uncover the shocking truth behind the student's expulsion, leaving them stunned and disturbed.

title: Punha Shivaji raje Bhosale
overview: 'Punha Shivajiraje Bhosle' is a gripping socio-political drama that delivers a powerful message about the state of modern-day Maharashtra, framed by a profound spiritual awakening. The film begins with a chilling prologue in the heart of rural India: the suicide of a struggling farmer, crushed under debt and betrayal. This devastating tragedy leaves behind a young, fiercely determined girl named Rakhma, whose world is shattered, but whose spirit refuses to break.

title: Francis: Chapter 1
overview: Francis' father raises his voice for an important issue and ends up being killed by those involved in the issue. In this situation, Francis keeps himself away from everything, thinking that his sister's life is more important than avenging the people who killed his father. One day, his sister's husband gets into trouble with the gang. To save him, Francis turns into a complete beast and takes revenge on all those who caused his father's death.

title: Hijra
overview: This film sheds light on the fascinating and often neglected topic of the Hijra community in India, which has been a part of the subcontinent for over 4,000 years. Despite being revered and celebrated in religious and spiritual ceremonies, this community continues to face abuse, discrimination, and violence. Our film seeks to explore the dimension of evil that resides within our minds and how it reflects onto the perceptions of the Hijra community. For us, this film is very special, as it is a product of our personal experiences and the desire to showcase the struggle and bliss of the third gender. We aim to tell a story that is engaging, sensitive, and respectful. Our team is excited to bring this project to life, and we hope that it will contribute to a greater understanding and appreciation of the Hijra community.

title: Kadhipatta
overview: KADHIPATTA Lalit and Meeras love story was once admired across their college campus. title: Badaa Karara Pudna
overview: Badaa Karara Pudna follows the journey of six spirited sisters who reunite for an unexpected challenge. What begins as a nostalgic attempt to relive their youthful days soon turns into an emotional rollercoaster as old wounds resurface, egos clash, and differences threaten to break them apart. With its blend of emotion, humor, and celebration, the film captures the essence of tradition, the power of togetherness and stands as a true ode to womanhood.

title: Slight Change Of Plans
overview: A sticky note. A smile. A plan. And a tiny little "ting" that changes everything

title: Manidham
overview: Manidham is an Emotional and Thought-provoking Dramathat Challenges Viewers to Reflect on Their Own Lives and the Impact of Their Choices.He Film Follows Krishnaraj, a Middle-aged Schoolteacher and Devoted Family Man,whose Sudden Death Forces Him to Confront the True Consequences of His Life Decisions, Even as His Restless Spiritremains Bound to His Home.

title: Denmo - Himalayan Brown Bear
overview: In the rarefied heights of the western Himalayas, an ancient creature that has featured in folklore and fever dreams for centuries, still prowls. The Brown Bear, or Ursus arctos isabellinus, was here before human settlements, villages, or electrified and militarized border fences arrived. Yet, today humans and the bears find themselves caught in an uneasy truce, a hostility over territory that doesn’t bode well for either species. Niazul Hassan Khan is a young wildlife scholar, a local who has known displacement from a troubled home too. He has returned to his community in Drass, Kargil to understand the Brown Bear, and broker peace between the animals and his people. As climate change hastens the glacial melt, and shortens winters, wreaking havoc on mountain communities, Niaz and his guide trek through the mountains searching for answers and a lasting possibility of survival for the land, its people, and the bear.

title: Volatile: Birds of a Feather
overview: In a quiet forest, a lonely dove mourning her lost eggs befriends a stray kitten, yet as the laws of nature threaten to separate them, their unlikely bond transcends species and sorrow.

title: Timeless India Resurgent India
overview: Timeless India Resurgent India is a Documentary film.  Indian civilization has a rich and long history, regarded as one of the longest among the world’s great civilizations. Despite this, recent experiences of foreign rule have caused some loss of pride among Indians, especially among the urban elite.

title: Ram Abdullah Antony
overview: School studenty Antonys mother works as a beedi maker and dies of cancer due to her work. Gurumoorthy,a rowdy in the village,comes to run the beedi factory. So Antony and his friends Ram and Abdullah join forces to demand the closure of the beedi factory.

title: Nimagondu Sihi Suddi
overview: Arjun wakes up with severe stomach pain and is rushed to the hospital, only to be told he's going into labour. Dazed and confused, he passes out but later wakes up at home, dismissing the incident as a dream. To his shock, he discovers a baby in his house and a cesarean scar on his body. Panicked, Arjun calls his best friend DD, and together they embark on a chaotic journey to uncover the truth behind Arjun's male pregnancy.

title: Vaibhavam
overview: Vaibhav, a righteous young man with entrepreneurial dreams, finds himself entwined in a profound mosaic of love, family, and friendships.

title: I, Poppy
overview: The divergent paths of poppy farmer Vardibai and her activist son Mangilal intertwine in this powerful documentary about a Dalit family’s resistance against systemic oppression.

title: Dreadful Redraft
overview: A disturbed mind spirals through memories and regret, where reality itself becomes the greatest illusion.

title: ECHOES OF SILENCE
overview: In a quiet room where days blur together, Karthik drifts between pills, memories, and the ghost of a girl he couldn’t save. What begins as a routine step toward healing slowly bends into something stranger, sessions that feel too vivid, a doctor who seems to know too much, and a mind slipping through the cracks of its own creation. Echoes of Silence pulls the viewer into a soft, dreamlike spiral where reality fades at the edges, and every whisper asks the same haunting question: what do you run from when the thing chasing you is yourself?

title: Rasmalai
overview: Things get a bit tense in a conventional Indian middle class household, when the youngest member feels unseen. Guddi (the daughter’s name) feels crushed when Papa fails to acknowledge her achievements. Her silent revolution shifts the dynamics of the system, as the conversations become short and the family dinners turn cold. “Rasmalai” questions society’s conventions about the role of the father in the family and the child’s development.

title: Beli Hoo
overview: The Fragrance of Kindness is a film about a young mother, Asha whose dreams of a happy married life are shattered as her husband is alcoholic and unemployed. With two young children to raise she is forced to fend for herself in rural Karnataka. She learns to drive an ambulance and conducts funerals of unclaimed, abandoned and decomposed bodies. The social stigma, the inhuman treatment from family and society and the painful reality of burying her sister from suicide bring into focus Asha's grit and compassion.

title: Nee illa Tum Ninne Nuvvu
overview: Ashoksaravanan's Nee Illa Tum Ninne Nuvvu is a groundbreaking multilingual breakup anthem that transcends linguistic boundaries, weaving together Tamil, English, Hindi, Malayalam, and Telugu into a soul-stirring musical tapestry. The song explores the raw, universal pain of lost love-capturing the emptiness, betrayal, and lingering sorrow that follows a shattered relationship. A rare fusion of South Indian melodies, Western grooves, and contemporary rhythms, the track blends Tamil soul, Hindi emotional depth, Telugu passion, Malayalam melancholy, and English lyrical vulnerability. Entirely self-created, Ashoksaravanan composes, produces, performs, and even handles the technical aspects-making it a true one-man musical revolution.—IMDb

The film explores relationships, romance and unexpected twists in an entertaining blend of humour, drama and heart. Performances especially by the lead pair are highlighted as the film’s strongest aspect.

title: Eighth Hill - A Sacred Revolution: Tirupati's Dream without Plastic
overview: Deep in the sacred Tirumala Hills, where millions walk in devotion, one man walks with a different purpose.  This documentary introduces Shivaji Paleti - an unsung hero who has dedicated his life to protect the hills from plastic pollution. With bare hands and endless patience, he cleans, he preserves, and he teaches what true devotion towards Mother Earth means. His perseverance never faded away despite numerous hardships. A true modern-day warrior who led the "Plastic Free Tirupati" movement with an example, turning personal conviction into a collective awakening.  The "Eighth Hill" stands as a reflection of our own atrocities. An unsettling mirror showing how what we dismiss as a single piece of trash can grow into a mountain of consequence. Through Shivaji’s story, this film explores not just environmental preservation, but the deeper meaning of responsibility, faith, and humanity’s bond with nature.

title: The Candidate
overview: "The Candidate" is a sports drama about a university chess player (Taishan) defending his spot in the team against a higher rated junior opponent (Schwaas). Taishan must rise above mind games, challenge the arrogant Schwaas and prepare for a final, dramatic showdown that will determine who gets to represent the chess team in university tournaments.

title: Forget Me Not
overview: Forget Me Not is the story of Nikki, who, after the death of her girlfriend, Sara, decides to undergo a procedure that will erase her memories. As Sara’s ghost tries to change her mind, Nikki must choose between her grief and her past.

overview: Abja, a working class, 40 year year old single woman, faces the pivotal decision of using her hard earned savings to freeze her eggs, sparking a journey of self-discovery as she grapples with societal expectations and personal doubts.

overview: This documentary uncovers the dark events of 2024, when, for the first time in India’s history, a sitting Chief Minister and an entire political leadership were jailed without evidence.

Plagued by guilt and loss, the survivor begins to see and talk to the others, as though they never left. As memories blur into haunting visions, the lines between reality and delusion crumble, revealing a chilling truth. A tale of grief, guilt, and the fragile grasp on reality.
