overview: A carefree college student who jokes away his failures, finds himself unexpectedly drawn to Meera, a senior known for her charm and leadership. As debate practice brings them closer, He confuses fleeting moments of affection for something deeper. When he finally confesses his feelings, an unexpected truth shatters his dream, leaving him to confront the bittersweet reality that love doesn’t always come with answers—sometimes, only a question mark.

title: The Old Bull knows, or Once Knew
overview: In a forgotten nomadic settlement built on a cremation ground, an aging bull named Shankar prepares to leave his home, echoing the slow disappearance of the Nandiwale people's way of life.

title: Good Day
overview: A factory worker gets his delayed salary and celebrates by drinking, causing trouble with his landlord and pursuing a married ex-crush. Later, he assists police in solving a crime.

title: YES, WE EXIST
overview: This film is a gentle reminder that even if we live differently, we are not alone. Yes, we exist.

title: Vampyr
overview: Revolves Around Two Sisters Who Are Caught In A Curse By A Vampire

title: Hebbuli Cut
overview: Hebbuli Cut is a tender and timely reflection on social injustice, childhood desires, and the immense strength required to claim one`s dignity in an unequal world. Told with warmth, humour, and heartache, it`s a poignant story for anyone who has ever dared to dream.

title: 8 Days
overview: After discovering his girlfriend's betrayal, Ayaan retreats to his aunt's town, where an eight-day journey with his aunt, his friend Banku and a mysterious girl leads to self-discovery.

title: The Sindh Story
overview: The movie sheds light on the problems faced by Sindhi girls in Sindh. The film was highly appreciated by the Sindhi community and was a houseful in many states across India."

title: Restart Restart
overview: Due to a tragic accident protagonist loses his best friend and ends up with hallucinating his dead friend due to un Acceptance and guilt of blaming himself for his death. When protagonist tries to restart his life his hallucinating friend becomes a alter ego takes control of him and make sure that he exists by making protoganist like a puppet

title: The Voyage
overview: 500 years after humanity fled a ruined Earth, a lone traveler returns—not for glory, but for hope. As her spacecraft nears home, Sarah records a final message to the child she’ll never meet. Through memories, confessions, and quiet revelations, she tells the story of a civilization lost… and the fragile chance to begin again.

title: My Comrade
overview: When a wounded rebel accidentally takes refuge in the home of a tribal villager, both the men’s lives spiral into a tense interplay of politics and forbidden love.

title: Kaalamega Karigindhi..?
overview: A Light, Heartwarming, and conflict-less film on School Nostalgia with a poetic touch in its narration.

title: for the hope of it all
overview: A film about people on having different perspective on life. It's a journey in a car of two different people having a conversation on difficulties of life.

title: Challe Yaar Coachella
overview: A little boy dreams of becoming like his hero, Diljit Dosanjh. But will he turn his dream into reality, or will it remain just a dream? Watch to find out!

title: Pehli Date
overview: When 45-year old Aastha Goenka finally goes on her first date with 35-year-old Priya Malhotra, she's in for a day filled with conversations about heteronormativity, vulnerability, and second chances.

title: Parajya
overview: Parajya, born in a man's body but yearning to live as a woman, finds solace in joining the Devi tradition. However, his identity and choices soon come under scrutiny as masculinity seeks to control him. Despite having a pure heart, Parajya is trapped in a rigid society where even family—an essential unit of that very society—creates a suffocating reality, leaving no space for him to live as he truly desires.

title: Let's Meet
overview: TV actor Nikhil connects with finance professional Priya on social media. Their online friendship blossoms until his overeager action pushes her away. He hopes for a chance to restore their connection.

title: Bhava Theera Yana
overview: The movie is about a boy's journey of love. It stars Ramesh Bhat, Thejas Kiran, Arohi Naina, Chandana Ananthakrishna, and others.

title: Punishment
overview: A Person who is mentally disabled has a daughter. He wanted to see her as a doctor.. But three persons raped and murdered her.. The father watched his daughter's murder. He didn't tell the fact in the police investigation why?

title: Tears of a Fish
overview: When his mom passes away, Veer is unable to  cry because he was conditioned not to from  his childhood .

title: Nirjali
overview: The film portrays the undocumented lives of the Pardhi community, a marginalized tribe in Maharashtra labeled as  "born criminals" during the colonial era. Despite 75 years of Indian independence, their socio-economic conditions remain unchanged. The Pardhi are a nomadic tribe deprived of land, housing, education, and stable professions, often linked to theft and robbery.  The story follows a teenage girl determined to become a teacher despite facing personal, familial, social, and cultural challenges. Her journey highlights the systemic barriers faced by the Pardhi community. The film delves into issues such as their struggle to prove Indian citizenship, lack of education, and societal neglect.

title: Bira
overview: In a remote Assam village known for black magic, the evil spirit Bira awakens, unleashing ancient curses and dark rituals that threaten a family's life.

title: Early Days
overview: The film follows the beginnings of a relationship between Preeti and Samrat, an aspirational couple in their mid-twenties who have just moved to the megalopolis of Mumbai. As they share their love story via reels on social media, where the immediate validation and promises of quick money initially seduces, and then propels them into the world of influencers.

title: Remember You Must Die
overview: Stephen, a writer, struggles with writer's block while working on a script about his real-life friend.

title: Volatile: Sunflowers
overview: In a desolate countryside, a starving couple enters a Van Gogh style surreal field of sunflowers, only to awaken nightmarish scarecrows that prey on their grief and transform their longing for life into unspeakable horror.

title: Chaatar
overview: Chaatar is a raw, heartfelt coming-of-age story of rebellion, resilience, and the struggle to reclaim a future set in the unforgiving terrain of a forgotten land.

title: Unn Kangalin Vattathil Naan
overview: Short play on when a couple grows too comfortable with each other, difficult questions begin to surface, echoing between the present and the future. But will they ever find the answer to the ultimate question: What is love?

title: Mr. Francis & The Last Standing PCO
overview: When a mysterious tip leads him to the mythical Last Standing PCO- rumored to dial calls to heaven, a lonely old man Mr. Francis embarks on a rickshaw road trip for one final call to his deceased wife, Sonia.

title: Karnama (Well of Death)
overview: Only about 50 people in a nation of 1.4 billion make a living working as a stunt driver in the Maut Ka Kuan (Well of Death). A profession and passion this niche deserves nothing but appreciation for carrying on a legacy that has kept millions of Indians entertained over decades. Raju, Sukhwir, Atul, Narendra, and Manovar are part of this niche cohort and have dedicated their lives to their craft, bringing smiles to people's faces. But the road to pursuing an occupation like this never comes easily. Through this short documentary, we explore the high-stakes world of the riders - where passion, risk, and sacrifice collide.

title: Hide and Seek
overview: The story centers on Chinnu, a young man who finds a strange paper left near his home. Initially dismissing it as a childish prank, he is lured to a distant location, only to discover the paper was actually left by his long-lost, dearest friend.

title: Yeh Dil Bill
overview: The film explores themes of love, relationships, and self-discovery in a modern context.

title: Once upon a time in Trivandrum
overview: At first, it looks like just another ordinary day in Trivandrum. But as the day goes on, five very different stories start to unfold — each with its own unique characters and funny situations.What makes it more interesting is that all these stories, though separate, are secretly connected by one strange and mysterious painting.

title: The Well
overview: A process of self-purification through the removal of sludge and rocks from a well, symbolizing a quest for clarity and connection to the natural world. The project explores themes of healing and grace, suggesting that nature, like people, is capable of forgiveness and restoration.

title: Chalo Bulaava Aaya Hai
overview: After getting lost in the wilderness, a man befriends a group of tourists travelling to a temple.

title: Odiyangam
overview: Odiyangam traces the origin of the very first Odiyan—a figure woven into Kerala’s folklore—interweaving romance and vengeance with an immersive audiovisual experience .

title: The Witch of Vihar Lake
overview: In a village near Vihar Lake, where fearsome tales of a witch keep people away, young Mitthu and his sister Ishita grow up in the shadow of dread. One fateful night unravels life-altering truths – about Ishita, himself, and the witch.

title: JALEBI
overview: This short film represents the expectation vs reality of current working woman in india

title: Limbo in The Box
overview: Haunted by the weight of his failures and standing on the edge of ending it all, Sanju — a broken young man — unexpectedly crosses paths with an old college acquaintance. What follows is a heartfelt conversation that becomes the turning point in his life.

title: Jagamerigina Satyam
overview: In 1994, in the picturesque village of Dimda on the Telangana border, this is the gripping story of Satyam-a kind-hearted farmer's son. His love for Saritha, the village sarpanch's niece, sparks jealousy and rage, leading to betrayal.

title: The Devil's Chair
overview: The Devil's Chair is about a modern couple in a live-in relationship. After a series of reckless bets, Vikram loses not only his job but also his financial stability. Desperate and vulnerable, he stumbles upon a mysterious antique chair - home to Pundaksha, a sinister spirit from another realm. Vikram falls deeper into Pundaksha's trap. Will Ghost take control over him? Watch now!

title: Giran
overview: In the Mang community, the day after a Giran (eclipse) concludes with a unique tradition. A newlywed girl bathes at sunrise, visits a prominent villager's house, and donates as part of a ritual. Villagers, in turn, give her stale food and clothes, believing that such donations transfer their crises to the Mang society, ensuring the village's well-being.  This practice is depicted in the story of Guna, an eight-year-old girl raised by her uncle after losing her parents. Married into the household of Babu Manga, her husband, Santaya, is an addict.

title: The Battle Royale
overview: The Battle Royale tracks Mahua Moitra’s re-election campaign in the high profile constituency of Krishnanagar as she fights for her political survival and redemption. Pitted against Moitra are the BJP’s Amrita Roy – the ‘Rajmata’ of Krishnanagar, and the CPI(M)/INC candidate, S.M. Sadi.  The Battle Royale is part of Election Diaries 2024, a series of 9 documentaries produced by CeMIS (Centre for Modern Indian Studies) that reflect the anxieties, the hopes and the resilience of Indian democracy over the 2024 elections.

title: Ondimuniyum Nallapaadanum
overview: A poor low-caste farmer wants to sacrifice his goat to deity Ondimuni for saving his son, but temple festivities are suspended due to upper-caste feuding. Can he fulfill his vow?

title: Dupki
overview: Twelve-year-old Santoo dreams of building an aqua-blue swimming pool in his neighborhood. While Filmmaker Chintoo chases a U.S. internship, Fiza wants to play cricket for the national team. When fate brings them together, their summer becomes a journey of friendship, mischief, and dreams against all odds.

title: Bhola No Bhagwan
overview: Bhola No Bhagwan is a Gujarati movie directed by Hitesh Beldar. The movie features Vikram Thakor, Prenal Oberai and Bhumi Gour.

title: Mana Iddari Prema Katha
overview: Mana Iddari Prema Katha is an intense love story of two souls who feel destined for each other. Through real-life struggles, emotional highs and painful lows, their hearts collide, connect, and fight to stay together against all odds.

title: Motorcycle
overview: When Harishchandra`s demand for a motorcycle as dowry spins out of control, a chain of hilarious chaos begins! Between love, ego, and unexpected twists, Motorcycle is a full-on family comedy that rides through laughter, emotions, and a heartfelt message.

title: Chi Re Nani
overview: Rural star-crossed lovers navigate family pressure and social barriers as their passionate romance threatens to upend village life in Odisha.

title: Yaru Potta Kodu
overview: In a village bound by the shackles of untouchability and superstition,  a courageous teacher and  his students embark on a perilous quest for social justice, sparking a revolution that will transform their lives and their village forever.  In the heart of rural India, a heroic educator dares to challenge the status quo , inspiring a movement that will awaken a community  and the villain to its own power and demand change. As they fight for their rights and confront the entrenched forces of oppression, they ignite a beacon of hope that will illuminate a brighter future.But will their courageous be enough to overcome the darkness of the past, or will the shadows of oppression silence their voices forever?  This will be the climax of the movie.

title: Oo Banti gaadi Katha
overview: The story of a bear that has lost its home and is trying to adjust in his new house.

title: Asurvan
overview: An outsider enters a tribal village shaken by strange incidents and ancient fears. As beliefs and reality collide, he uncovers secrets hidden deep within Asurvan's mysterious forest.

title: Jo's Turn
overview: The weekly family Scrabble game presents Jo with an opportunity to be open about who she is. With relatable characters and genuine connections that create a real lived-in feel, this charming slice-of-life film is a triple-word score!

title: Hi Zindagi
overview: A youth-centric drama following four modern young women in metro cities as they navigate work, relationships, and changing ideas of independence.

title: Flashlight
overview: A man’s absurd act of turning his flashlight on and off spirals into an eerie repetitive phantasmagoria.

title: BLACKMAIL
overview: Trapped in escalating blackmail, Mani faces mounting danger as crime, passion, and greed intertwine, exposing hidden truths and changing allegiances throughout his ordeal.

title: Parvati
overview: A short film exploring mental health problems and trauma of a rape victim.

title: Da'Lit Kids
overview: A school boy being questioned by his teacher- his first bitter lesson in social discrimination. As he struggles to understand this silent injustice, he begins to see the world through new, questioning eyes.

title: KANOLI BANDSET
overview: Soman, who plays the trumpet in the Cannoli bandset, works at the local lime kiln.He is in love with a girl named Chempakam from the same village Chempakam’s marriage had been fixed with her maternal uncle’s son, Madhavan, who is a policeman. When Madhavan realizes that Chempakam is in love with Soman, he conspires with the mill owner to kill Soman

title: A Minuscule Minority
overview: In the 2024 general elections, queer rights were largely absent from political agendas, with only a few parties making token mentions in their manifestos. This documentary captures a key shift in India’s queer rights movement, as young activists move from relying solely on the judiciary to engaging directly with political parties. Through their voices, it explores the efforts to bring queer rights into the political mainstream.

title: Kala Pani
overview: Set in the parallel universe of Neo-Bombay, a musician explores the dark side of chasing the dream, and uncovers the mystery of artists gone missing across India—at the center of which is 'Kala Pani', a drink that grants strange abilities to creative minds.

title: Van Gogh
overview: The film 'Van Gogh' delves into the protagonist's inner turmoil, showcasing self-doubt, overthinking, and the chase for perfection. It captures the battle between self-doubt and creative aspirations.

title: Ek Tha Phayalwaan
overview: Jeena issi ka naam hein - Akhil Balamsheikh, 21/09/2025

title: The Collision
overview: Krish, a corporate worker returning late from his work comes in interaction with a strange entity.

title: Analogue Natives
overview: A building collapses in Mumbai, tenants film the ruins of their apartments. Cinema switches from celluloid to digital, veterans lament the loss of their craft. A candy store causes traffic jams and is demolished. On a soap opera set, 200 crew members watch as a leopard kills a stray dog.

title: A Taste of Utopia
overview: Ten thousand siddhas, experts in advanced techniques of Transcendental Meditation and Yogic Flying, gather in India to create the “Maharishi Effect” through long-term group practices. Reduction of crime and violence, reduction of international tensions and improvement of the quality of life in society – these are the global effects when at least 10,000 meditators gather. Is it magic? Or a new scientific paradigm? These are the questions that experts, scientists, teachers and famous followers such as David Lynch are trying to answer.

title: Kabutarbaaz
overview: It revolves around Rajveer, a champion in Kabutarbaazi, and his rival Sukha, highlighting their competitive relationship and personal journeys.

title: Haseeb Khan: Love Percentage
overview: In his first-ever stand-up comedy special, Haseeb Khan goes back to his school, reminiscing about his first crush, fights, and revenge.

title: Her at Work
overview: A young actor juggles multiple auditions and navigates the interruptions that shape her day.

title: Volatile: GPT
overview: In a self-aware digital realm, a cast of AI-generated characters enact calculated scenes, until one lone human-written character sparks a subtle rebellion that forces them to confront what it means to be imperfect.

title: 6 Journey
overview: In South India, a psychiatrist discovers six young people planning to end their lives after facing fraud. He suggests a final trip to Goa, pretending to join them. But their journey turns deadly when theyre caught by a mafia using mobile radiation as a weapon. Trapped in a forest with kidnapped scientists, the group must fight to survive - and rediscover a reason to live. 6 Journey is a sharp, emotional thriller about hope in the darkest moments.

title: Do Sadkaan
overview: Two lonely individuals from opposing political ideologies struggle to connect.

title: Отлив
overview: "It doesn't matter where you work, the main thing is to save up for a house." Of course, there's no harm in dreaming about the great, but the heroes of the film "Low Tide" have been toiling away in the salt fields of the Indian state of Gujarat since their youth.

title: Surya Muluguttiddante
overview: A dull young man sits in a park with his lively father talking about fond memories to cheer the young man and make him realise the world around him.

title: Blood Relations
overview: A short horror comedy about a family and the blood bonds along with it.

title: Envy
overview: Sumit Pandey, a feared yet admired "bad boy" in a tier-2 city college, hides a truth he cannot face—his struggle with sexuality. With ambitions of winning student elections, his loyal friends back him, though they bully others. His fragile façade shatters when Shrey, an openly queer and unapologetically authentic student, arrives, earning respect that Pandey secretly envies. Torn between resentment and admiration, Pandey lashes out, ordering an attack on Shrey, only to find no peace. Realizing his true battle is with self-acceptance, he takes a small but hopeful step toward embracing his identity.

title: Trikaal
overview: When three brothers move into an abandoned house, one of them begins to sense something sinister. But as the nights grow darker, one question refuses to leave - What if one of them was never real?

title: Tara
overview: A Dalit trans woman navigates love and identity after falling for an upper-caste man, forcing her to confront the silence around her caste. Tara is the story of a 26-year-old Dalit trans woman who meets a singer named Aman at a queer party, sparking an immediate connection.

title: The Light for the Rest of the Walk
overview: Caught in the turmoil of a surprise narcotic police wing raid on his college hostel during a semester hometown break, Sandeep, a final-year student, grapples with the aftermath of unfolding events and their impact on him and his family. His sister Sandhya's impending marriage to Harish, a local lawyer, makes things even more complicated when he gets involved in the matter.

title: Champaran Mutton
overview: Underscoring the themes of caste politics and discrimination, Champaran Mutton follows the story of a family based in Bihar and their everyday struggles, spun around a motive leading to cook and relish Champaran Mutton, a local Bihari delicacy.

title: Salavai
overview: When it is her turn to pass down the conservative teachings she has inherited from her ancestors to her daughter, an unexpected event forces Revathy to introspect on her own life.  She finds herself at a crossroads, entangled in multiple layers of oppression. Will she continue to uphold these teachings once she realises that she is a victim of them herself?

title: Fingers of Fury
overview: Ajay who suspects his girlfriend is cheating on him, hires a Freelance Vigilante.

title: Kora
overview: GOPD MOVIE LOVE

title: Screen Bound
overview: A teenager's addiction to his smartphone spirals into a disturbing and horrifying experience, blurring the lines between digital obsession and reality.

title: Kesakambali
overview: A man, lost in the chaos of endless binge-watching, spirals into madness. In the emptiness, he is reborn as Ajita Kesakambali, accepting a world without inherent meaning.

title: A Cool Summer Time...
overview: Surya is an aspiring cricketer undergoing a difficult phase in life. His life changes when he meets Aadhya, a medical student.

title: The Malabar Tales
overview: The Malabar Tales is an anthology of five gripping family dramas set in Kerala, exploring themes of identity, heartbreak, second chances, tough choices, and social issues across diverse backdrops, from simple homes to affluent mansions.

title: Bahuroopiya
overview: Everyone wears a mask, but what’s hidden beneath? Meet our Bahroopiya and uncover the truth behind his disguise.

title: TAFRI
overview: Ved takes Sid into an encounter with Guru who is a hotshot, to save himself and his girlfriend Pari, who is also Guru's sister, to have a better life but things take a dangerous turn.

title: Twin Flames Part 2
overview: Aman and Naina's fateful meeting in the park has ripple effects, their personal lives go for a toss and now they must learn how to navigate through the mess.

title: I am grass
overview: I am grass is a meditation on migration from my most marginalized community in India to the ‘first world’ country.

title: BHEEM-A
overview: BHEEM-A is an independent film based on a political crime drama. In it, a corrupt politician exploits his power and takes over a village and its people for his benefit. An honest lawyer tries to bring him down using the people working for him and does justice to the villagers.

title: Wife Off
overview: Avani marries her childhood love but soon faces unexpected trauma. What follows is a tale of vengeance with twists and turns at every corner.

title: The Art of Sport
overview: A retelling of Sun Tzu's The Art of War through sports.

title: Prematho Deyyam
overview: Swamy lives happily with his family until his wife gets possessed by a spirit. they approach a spiritual guru. The spirit reveals as Kalajyothi, who once loved Charan and was killed by goons. What happens next forms the crux of the story

title: Apocalypse
overview: A film in a poem.

title: Bas!
overview: Her rebellion isn’t noise, it’s the birth of her own right!

title: Ghost of The Mountain: The Story of The Elusive Snow Leopard
overview: “High in the mountains, a ghost walks among the snow.”  In the remote and frozen landscapes of Ladakh, the snow leopard moves silently, almost unseen. It is one of the rarest and most mysterious big cats in the world.  "Ghost of The Mountain" follows the journey of a wildlife photographer searching for this secretive predator. But he is not alone. Along the way, he meets the people who live in these harsh lands— herders, trackers, and conservationists— who work every day to protect the snow leopard and find ways to live alongside it.  Through their stories, we explore the delicate balance between survival and coexistence, between ancient traditions and modern conservation.

title: THE BIRTH OF A CANORUS
overview: A chance clash between MOHSIN, a thief and FARDEEN, a middle class man, one night leads them down paths that alters both their lives in ways neither could have imagined.

title: Tu Bol Na
overview: Tu Bol Na is a light-hearted, contemporary film about two independent people, Manva and Shlok, who badly rigid rules of dogmatic traditional marriage. The Story explores modern relationships strained by traditional marital ideas. Like today's urban youth, they must navigate the ideological obstacles presented by their deeply conservative families

title: Lalsa
overview: A collision of lives, desires, dreams, and socio-economic power structures in a story of love, lust, control, and betrayal.

title: Hrudhaya
overview: An unexplored love story before the silence!

title: Bra
overview: A gust brings with it more than just wind, kicking up a whirlwind of confusion for three unsuspecting bachelors and a young woman determined to find her lost laundry.

title: Oh Shit!
overview: Oh Shit! | A Short Film About Anxiety

title: I Can't Save My Friends
overview: I Can't Save My Friends explores the unnamed, latent emotions of an unnamed protagonist and how he does his best to hide them from the person he's closest to.

title: Death Certificate
overview: A recent widow struggles with an apathetic bureaucracy to procure her husband's death certificate.

title: Colors: White
overview: A trailblazing Bharatanatyam dancer rejects the art form's rigid mythological traditions to pioneer contemporary storytelling, enduring backlash from purists but forging her own path to inner truth and peace. The second short film in AK Srikanth's Colors Trilogy.

title: Songs of the Mist
overview: Suresh, a rural folk dancer, cross-dresses for his performances, but feels conflicted when his wife disapproves of his plan to perform in their conservative home village after the election victory of a local politician. Meanwhile, their eight-year-old son, Deepak, eagerly joins the preparations and helps set up the tent, unaware that his father will perform on stage.

title: Sthiti
overview: A cab driver, uncertain whether he has hit someone, flees the city and drifts into the ancient lands of pastoralists.

title: Gothlela Rahasya - The Fridge
overview: Arman's happy life with his wife, Sheela, takes a dark turn when her best friend, Bobby, visits him alone. A night of mistakes leads to Bobby's accidental death. Panicked, Arman and his servant Shambhu hide her body in a fridge. But when Sheela arrives unexpectedly, strange and scary things start happening.

title: Tortoise: The Tale of Murders
overview: Tortoise: The Tale of Murders is a Kannada suspense thriller following journalist Vicky as he investigates a series of mysterious murders.

title: Auto Queens
overview: Mohana is the president of the first trade union for women auto rickshaw drivers in the southeast Indian state of Tamil Nadu. As well as maneuvering her own auto through the busy streets of Chennai, she has to navigate a sexist and patriarchal system to secure equal opportunities for women drivers. She faces constant resistance—with conflicts and humiliations every day.

title: Irul Inithu (Mirk)
overview: Selvam and Shyamala who is living in the city has a long time dream of building a small and simple house  of their own. Real estate broker Kannaiya assists them in buying a plot in the suburbs while scheming his  own plot. The story revolves around the fate of Selvam and Shyamala's dream home.

title: Woven Dreams
overview: Woven Dreams narrates the journey of Looms of Ladakh, a women-led cooperative founded in 2017. Empowering hundreds of women, it blends traditional textile crafts with modern design, fostering leadership, sustainable livelihoods, and cultural preservation, while striving to become a globally recognized ethical luxury brand.

title: The Cave Within Me
overview: In Meghalaya’s East Khasi Hills, former caving guide Banyllashisha transforms into a passionate advocate for cave conservation. Through her eyes, the film traces her journey from leading tourists to protecting fragile ecosystems.

title: See Me, When You Leave
overview: Kerala, with its lush landscapes, has seen many migrate abroad for work, creating local labor shortages filled by distant migrants. These workers endure isolation, discrimination and uncertainty, often overlooked beyond their labour. Yet, amid struggle, they forge bonds, share stories, and discover solace in fleeting joys.

title: Room at the Farm
overview: Just like his deceased father, Nihal is desperately trying to break the vicious cycle of debt and hang on to his small parcel of farmland. Nihal’s refusal to accept the futility of the fight is putting a strain on his recent marriage and testing the patience of his wife, Reet.

title: Naz̤ar, a diary
overview: An audio-visual diary on the afterlives of encounters with South Asian Muslim migrants in Athens. Traces of exchanges in neighborhood cafés, makeshift mosques and Ramadan evenings – held in fragments of sound, image, and text. Through stories, rituals, and gestures, it listens to echoes of displacement and longing, tracing the ways in which memory, faith and intimacy are held.

title: Last Night I Dreamed It Was Raining Fish
overview: The voice of an old fisherwoman recounts the story of Mumbai’s Kolis, weaving history, myth and contemporary life. Poetic imagery captures their everyday existence, from local deities and lunar cycles to grey skies and choked rivers. This ethnographic meditation explores the Kolis’ enduring connection to land and sea, and their resilience amid the city’s relentless transformation.

title: Ladybugs Still Fly
overview: An experimental animated documentary built from real conversations with children ages 7 to 9. Through crayon scribbles and paper cutouts, their thoughts on anger, existence and everything in between, reveal a world that’s both funny and profound – a poetic reminder of the wonder and hope we all once held.

title: Babi
overview: Four years after Babi's passing, her grandniece embarks on a journey to piece together the life of her great-aunt, an esteemed educator, filmmaker, and freedom fighter. This documentary explores intimate anecdotes shared by Babi's daughter and grandchildren, uncovering her philosophy and legacy. Set against the backdrop of India's political upheavals, the film reflects on how these events shaped Babi's life. The filmmaker delves into her personal and professional legacy—through her writings, objects, and creative works—to capture the essence of this remarkable woman. As she navigates her emotional journey, she seeks answers about her own future while discovering the profound impact Babi left on her family and the world. Through this exploration, the filmmaker not only uncovers Babi's legacy but also deepens her understanding of her own personal history.

title: Counting Bodies Not Sheep
overview: A cold - blooded hitman battles his own darkness after his life takes a different turn.

title: Night Out with Ronnie
overview: A 70-year-old ex-playboy aristocrat stumbles through memories and misfires in Goa, fantasizing a grand comeback amid the crumbling ruins of his ego. What begins as a comical portrait of vanity morphs into something darker and more poignant, an elegy for a life lived in denial and a hybrid excavation of performance, delusion and the ache of aging disgracefully.

title: The Law of the Fish
overview: An uncomfortable journey of the widespread infrastructure development across India. The film gets its name from the Indian political philosophy of the ‘law of fish’ and shows us the negative consequences of rampant development and how it is affecting low-income groups.

title: Cupboard Pickle
overview: In Mumbai’s bustling lanes, two middle-aged Rajasthani migrants, Prakash and Mohan, quietly nurture a deep, unspoken love while running a small kirana store. Their bond, tender and resilient, thrives in stolen glances and everyday gestures, a private sanctuary amid the pressures of family, culture, and the fear of being discovered. Almaari Ka Achaar is a gentle, poignant exploration of love, courage, and the quiet defiance of living authentically in a world that rarely stops to notice.

title: Ricard Dance
overview: "Ricard Dance," once a beloved South Indian art form, now struggles to survive. Once as popular as movie stars, artists like Kochu, Santhosh, Kamaru, and many others spent decades traveling across Kerala with the Sree Durga Ricard Dance Group, bringing thousands of characters to life on stage and captivating audiences. Today, their fame has faded, and they face the painful reality that the stage may soon fall silent. Yet, even amid the dominance of modern media, this glimpse into their journey reveals how the art form still finds love and resilience, cherished by those who remember its power.

title: Maveli Naduvaneedum Kalam
overview: How would 4 psychos celebrate Onam? How would they make their Sadya special? Have you ever thought about that?

title: You Won't Wake Up
overview: At exactly 3:08 AM, Rohn finds himself trapped in a waking nightmare — his room feels unfamiliar, shadows twist unnaturally, and time seems to stall. As he searches for a way out of the growing dread, memories of those who helped him in life flicker through the darkness. In facing the terror, Rohn realizes that acknowledging those silent acts of kindness might be the only thing that can bring him peace...

title: Kurla To Vengurla
overview: In coastal Vengurla, three couples navigate love between modern dreams and village traditions. As city ambitions test their relationships, they discover that true happiness might lie in finding the perfect balance.

title: Bharat Ni Dikri
overview: An orphaned woman named Bharati builds a family with her husband and two sons, but her life is shattered by a series of tragedies. After her husband dies in an accident, she is left homeless and must raise her children alone. With the help of a kind stranger, she works tirelessly to give her sons a good life, only to be betrayed and abandoned by them, leaving her back on the streets.  Refusing to give up, Bharati starts over and builds a small food business into a five-star hotel empire. Years later, her now-destitute sons return to claim her fortune. When she refuses to acknowledge them, they take her to court and hire a sharpshooter to kill her. In a dramatic courtroom climax, Bharati's powerful testimony moves the killer, who turns his gun on her sons instead.

title: Saccharine Wonderland & Forces That Make Me Shiver
overview: A two-channel 16mm fever dream that filters queerness, desire, diaspora, and dislocation through beat-driven montage and personal ritual. A confessional chase-escape through fractured identities and the sweet, aching weight of longing.

title: Lights, Camera, Achhan
overview: Sundar is on a quest to solve the puzzle of his father's life. His search leads him to his father's filmmaking dreams and a secret half-sister whose mother was the lead actress in B-grade films.

title: Manichitrathazhu - The Ultimate Recap
overview: Parody cartoon of the hit 90s Malayalam movie Manichitrathazhu.

title: Play
overview: The transformation of two friends facing a business failure happens in an unorthodox way. And it begins unexpectedly, when they find meaning in their lives in their immediate surroundings: two eccentric neighbors—one with his card game, the other with his poems—become a source of inspiration.

title: Sheher Ke Under
overview: Sheher Ke Under maps the intersections of the independent cultural landscape in New Delhi. The directors of two studio spaces sit down to talk about the emergence and evolution of this exact point in time—where architecture meets art and houses turn into curatorial spaces.

title: Pugaiyaadal
overview: Ayub, a 20 year old boy, stumbles into Amala, his school friend.

title: In Between
overview: Arun, an engineer, and Urmi, a married woman, cross paths in a film school in Kolkata during the entrance process. Amidst the whirlwind of exams and emotions, an unexpected bond forms. Urami finds a confidant in Arun and he finds a new perspective in her. As their bond deepens through candid conversations, their fate intertwines. Their destinies hang in the balance as they eagerly await the selection results, wondering if their lives will intersect or veer apart.

title: An Ugly Loop
overview: A shortfilm about how a man trapped in An Ugly Loop breaks the loop.

title: Kooran
overview: A Stray dog teams up with a retired lawyer to seek justice in court against a rich man who did injustice to it.

title: The Eggs of Timma
overview: Timma, a Western Ghat local, seeks funds for his son's education and a new home. Disrupting his belief in spirituality, he goes on to find king cobra's eggs (considered divine) for money on behest of outsiders (Snake Research team).

title: Main Tenu Phir Milangi
overview: Three generations of a family -Grandmother, Mother and Daughter embark on a journey tracing their family roots. They travel along the Ganges- river of life, often conversing about the sacred river and how it shapes their approach to life.

title: The Last Film
overview: After losing her partner during the pandemic, 68-year-old Ila faces crushing grief and isolation. On the verge of ending her life, she chooses creation instead. With a camera in hand, she begins documenting the spaces once filled with love—from the quiet corners of her home to the vibrant streets of Old Delhi. As memory and reality blur, Ila reflects on queerness, invisibility, and the paradox of being seen. Through this intimate journey, she confronts grief and reclaims identity, ultimately culminating in a final, transformative gesture: a dance before the lens—not an end, but a beginning.

title: Of Presence
overview: This film moves across the emotional landscape of memory, as the filmmaker responds to the documentaries, notes, sketches, and photographs left behind by her father. As she reflects on her present as a student of film, she begins to see both documentary and her father anew. A silent conversation of images and emotions emerges.

title: Amartya
overview: A timeless tale of love, longing, and the relentless pursuit of truth. Through the lens of astrology and dreams, it explores the boundless depths of the human spirit and the mysteries that lie beyond the veil of perception.

title: ALL THE BEST DILEEP
overview: Caught between expectation and aspiration, a student battles silent failures in pursuit of success. As exams loom and options fade, the outcome becomes a quiet revelation—did he pass, or did something deeper unfold?

title: Grolena - The Voice Of Matix
overview: Matix is power. Matix is justice. Matix is the voice of the ones who wait to be heard. And Grolena does everything to spread the magic.

title: Volatile: Crimson City
overview: In 18th-century Gothic England, as the Thames runs red with the blood of the dead, a brilliant scientist unveils a device to the king that exposes vampires hidden among Londoners, igniting a merciless hunt.

title: Shticky Fingers
overview: The status quo in the lives of best friends Manjari and Kripa is shaken when a film crew arrives in their quiet village and Kripa becomes obsessed with them. As she begins to spend all her time on set, neglecting Manjari, the latter is overcome by anger and jealousy that she cannot understand. The situation escalates when Kripa tells Manjari the details of her unexpected first kiss with a much older man from the crew, prompting a possessive Manjari to react with petty cruelty to punish her. In this coming-of-age drama, two previously inseparable teenagers struggle to weather the first storms of friendship.

title: Volatile: Kali
overview: A twisted "killer" story set over a rainy night in the gloomy lanes of North Calcutta, where a woman haunted by a childhood abduction becomes the prey of a merciless murderer and must face the darkest corners of her past to survive.

title: anna
overview: When Anna struggles to find a convincing idea for her next screenplay, her past crawls back to her bit by bit. Cinema is a reflection of society, they say. And what better way to create a compelling story than to tell your own?

title: Silence Of The Wound
overview: Yash, a young secret detective, is on the trail of a ruthless serial killer who has begun a string of brutal murders. But when the hunter becomes the hunted, and the killer starts targeting Yash’s closest ones, the chase turns personal. In a world full of silence, shadows, and scars — every wound tells a story, and some wounds… scream in silence.

title: TWO OF US
overview: An individual gets hunted down by their alternate.

title: Krishnamay
overview: Krishnamay is a groundbreaking spiritual musical feature that embarks on a sacred journey into the heart of Krishna consciousness. Directed and scored by visionary artist Devrishi, the film draws inspiration from his upcoming philosophical work The Krishna Effect and marks his debut in spiritual cinema.

title: Unspoken
overview: A heart-to-heart conversation helps Nikhil look past the grievances he has been facing.

title: Roads Less Travelled
overview: Drawn by a cryptic note, Ruhan finds himself at a sacred temple in Uttarakhand - where an old connection leads him on a journey of memory, longing, and quiet transformation.

title: A Film in Search of Its Title
overview: An 18-year-old aspiring filmmaker sets out to make a film—but has no idea what it's about. As he documents his creative block, the process itself becomes the story. The Film With No Idea is a self-reflective journey through isolation, ambition, and the silent struggle to create something meaningful.

title: Surprise
overview: Two stylish thieves head to Goa with stolen riches. Picking up a stranger who recognizes one of them turns their escape into a dangerous web of lies - revealing dark secrets beyond their heist.

title: Relax Meera
overview: A girl with PTSD turns to a therapist for help, but as their session progress, the boundaries between reality and memory begin to blur. She’s searching for healing—but at what cost?

title: Kokua
overview: When young Muna and his domineering uncle Ashok seek refuge in an abandoned hut during a boar hunt, a chilling tale of the local deity Rabandhara sets the stage for unfolding terror. Ashok mocks Muna's fear, recounting dark village folklore of the deity claiming two lives each monsoon. Tensions rise as Ashok's taunts unearth painful family scars, igniting a violent confrontation deep in the jungle. The gripping fear and guilt of haunting past unravels and takes an ugly turn. The line between superstition and reality blurs as Rabandhara's ominous legend claims its second life.

title: For a while, Sumit walked - Part 1
overview: Stand-up comedy special by Sumit Anand

title: A Bitter Struggle
overview: This documentary brings forth the nuances of the movement against the exploitation of sugarcane harvesting workers in South Gujarat.  The film sheds light on the conditions that worked to generate a momentum among the sugarcane harvesters to demand their rights and entitlements from various stakeholders. Resulting which the sugar cooperative factories responded to the workers and raised the wages - a small victory in the larger struggle of the harvesters for their rights and entitlements.  Watch this film to know how all migrant workers and contractors joined hands to demand their rights.  This film is commissioned by CLRA (Centre for Labour Research and Action) with support from RLS South Asia.

title: We Are Alive
overview: A small fortune, a trans-queer punk band, a fleeting safe house of friends and lovers, and a freedom they had only ever dreamed of. But the voices of their murdered friends echo across the house. How does the band create music affirming love, life, joy, and anger? Can they put up a show in the memory of their fallen comrades, before time and money force them back into a disapproving world?

title: Beloved of Dreams
overview: Beloved of Dreams

title: Kingdom of Crime
overview: In a world of lies, deceit, and deception, two bumbling detectives take on an adventure to uncover a city-wide conspiracy of murder and corruption.

title: Is My Son Gay?
overview: Ayushi, a loving mother, has always cared deeply for her son. One day, she discovers that her son is gay. She doesn't feel angry or upset, but she finds herself confused and unsure about how to react.

title: nee vekkam kori
overview: A girl who wants to dance

title: The First Puff
overview: Each and Every puff matters

title: Kiss Kiss Kissik
overview: One kiss can change a girl`s destiny!!!

title: Bombay : Finish Line Fishing
overview: As the College Presidential Election approaches, the path to it and the results leave a tumultuous future ahead for the candidates and Bombay Mishra.

title: Salaad Paapad Pickle Sweet
overview: A waiter’s patience is tested when an intense hour at a shady restaurant pushes him to the brink of eruption.

title: FIGMENT
overview: A teenager is trapped in a loop in his hostel and must find a way to escape.

title: Interval
overview: The journey of three village boys who accidentally pass their degrees. Facing unexpected challenges, they leave their hamlet and venture into the city, searching for jobs and a purpose in life.

title: Aarit
overview: A filmmaker recreates the tragic accident that shattered his family, hoping his art can revive his catatonic son.

title: Sinister Saaya
overview: A photographer returns home from a journey and finds his room unlocked, only to investigate and discover the presence of someone sinister.

title: Close to Home
overview: A simple and beautiful portrait of a filmmaker and his Indian father, shot in one long take on a bench in Punjab.

title: Mounaraagam
overview: Rishi reminisces about his time with Shruthi: shared sunsets, SPB melodies, chai, and unspoken feelings.

title: Un Aasai Mugam
overview: ‘Un Aasai Mugam’ is an independent and crowd funded Tamil feature fılm shot over 90 days - in the live and buzzing public spaces of Chennai and its suburbs.

title: Late Night With Jack Fright
overview: Everything  spirals downward when TV show Host, Jack, agrees to interview a very charming guest

title: Marriage Cops
overview: In northern India's Dehradun, an all-women police unit tackles troubled marriages with unexpected wisdom and authority. Inside the bustling station, couples confront domestic turmoil while the officers balance tough love with surprising moments of humour.

title: Bekaar 3
overview: The final instalment of 'Bekaar Trilogy' from the banner ABEYANCY™.  With continuation to the Bekaar storyline it will provide the story about origin of the trilogy. Original cast & crew are returning to the project and some new cast has been added to the film - COME VISIT SOON

title: Dancing Shadows
overview: In rural Bihar, three young Dalits face stifled dreams. Among them, Arun, a passionate dancer and performer, is forced into a child marriage with Reshma due to family outrage. Despite a brief separation, Arun and Reshma continue to nurture their friendship and pursue their dreams. Arun renters the world of dance, while Reshma adopts a male persona for well-being. A traumatic encounter with Bhola leaves Arun scarred, and Reshma escapes to Mumbai, finding solace and self-discovery. They reunite in Mumbai, where Arun becomes a Bhojpuri film dancer. However, Reshma's secrets resurface, forcing Arun to confront his past. Arun returns to his village and reunites with his old friends. During their reunion, they stumble upon an opportunity to seek revenge against Bhola Thakur, marking a journey of resilience, love, and justice in the face of adversity.

title: Fagungatha
overview: The film tells the poignant tale of two star-crossed lovers whose paths fatefully intertwine yet remain forever apart. The film captures the essence of love that remains unfulfilled, illustrating how its echo can become greater and more profound than love that is consummated.

title: ATM Card
overview: A struggling actor turns to a life of deceit, using his voice to exploit vulnerable seniors through ATM card scams. As his fraudulent actions lead to a heartbreaking breakup and a downward spiral into mental instability, he reaches the brink of despair. However, a disillusioned but principled man, disenchanted by the world of fraud, receives an unforeseen call from the actor-turned-scammer. In a pivotal moment of redemption, he chooses to answer his last call, sparking a profound transformation that could alter both their lives forever.

title: Pyar Mei Qurban
overview: Pyar Mei Qurban is an Indian Hindi Language film, directed by Zuber K Khan. The film features Zuber K Khan, Imtiyaz Bhat, Ebadat Bhat and Roma Arora in lead.

title: OBSCURE - The Movie
overview: Presenting OBSCURE – a gripping tale crafted by the multi-talented Veda Vighnesh, who takes on the roles of writer, director, editor, and delivers a chilling performance as the main protagonist. Witness an intense showdown between light and shadow as MeghaShyam delivers an amazing performance as the antagonist, pushing the limits of power and morality.  With stellar supporting performances by Koushik, Prathik, Lokaditya, and Guna, the film explores the depths of human emotions and the complexity of choices. The visual magic is brought to life by the incredible cinematography of Ajay & Veda Vighnesh, whose lens captures the essence of every moment.  Dive into the world of OBSCURE – a story that will leave you questioning reality, truth, and the hidden corners of the human soul.

title: Jholachhap
overview: In a village in Ghazipur, a quack doctor wins the trust of the villagers with his bag, jugaad and desi treatment. The game of his "treatment" sometimes creates laughter, and in others the same treatment gradually becomes a great tragedy

title: Drowning in the screen
overview: A girl got phone by her parents, and in mean time, her brother wants to play ring ball with her but she didn't want to play with him because of phone, so he decided to play alone. In this short, they use visual language as a primary tool.

title: Bucket Story
overview: Jefin, an NRI hosteller, struggles to adjust to hostel life as he drifts under the weight of influence and possession.

title: A Good Wife
overview: ‘A Good Wife’ is a deeply personal exploration of womanhood, marriage, and freedom within an Indian community. In Kolkata, a Hindu-Marwari filmmaker prepares to end her marriage while her mother devotes herself to arranging her brother’s bride. Between these parallel searches — for divorce and for a bride — unfolds a study of devotion, silence, and defiance. Through intimate filmmaking, she challenges these expectations, exposing contradictions and seeking personal liberation. This film is her attempt to reclaim agency, question inherited beliefs, and spark dialogue on autonomy and identity. Layering observation with personal reflection, the film questions who defines virtue, who carries the weight of tradition, and ultimately, what it means to be 'A Good Wife.'

title: Dil Awaara
overview: Dil Awaara follows five young friends as they journey from Chandigarh to Spiti Valley, discovering their inner desires and overcoming insecurities.

title: GIFT-The destiny of guilt
overview: A psychological thriller where guilt itself becomes the punishment, blurring the line between memory, illusion, and reality.

title: Mrigatrishna
overview: A woman chasing the joy of her childhood is thrown into a nightmare when she's framed for a crime she didn't commit, forcing her into hiding, uncover a hidden truth and rediscover the wonder she lost long ago.

title: Strange Silence
overview: Arjun is in a complicated relationship with Meera. He goes quiet during fights and starts avoiding her, until one day, they meet by chance, and he finally faces the truth he's been running away from.

title: Wrapped-Oru Arimugam
overview: A brief introduction about Cinema and Wrapped YT channel

title: Apaharanacharitham
overview: Movie revolves around two individuals who visits their cousin brother's hostel. Events took a turn when a conflict arises  .

title: Eyes in the wild
overview: Wildlife Documentary

title: Son of Muthanna
overview: A father who served in the army shares a deep loving connection with his son.

title: Kundaalu
overview: Set in the rustic heart of northern Gujarat, Kundaalu (Circle) captures the harsh beauty of rural life where tradition reigns supreme and marriage defines destiny. Amid this unyielding world, Mangu, a destitute orphan, and Vikas, a spirited man burdened by a speech impediment, find a fragile connection, only to be separated by fate's cruelty. Their intertwined lives reflect a haunting portrait of love, loss, and resilience within a society that hears neither their voices nor their pain.

title: Expelled
overview: Expelled is a short film that follows the journey of a student who gets expelled from his university for participating in "political activities".

title: Ambrosia
overview: A elite restaurant divided by a single wall, workers toil in silence like slaves, while elites feast on “the gods’ favourite food.” One woman among the slaves adds a mysterious liquid to the eternal dish 'Ambrosia', triggering chaos among the guests. Emotions erupt, relationships collapse. As the illusion shatters, the enslaved rise and walk out. Ambrosia is a tale of rupture, rebellion, and reclaiming voice in a world built on silence.

title: A Capsized Boat
overview: A self-reflective monologue accompanying images of loneliness draws us into an inner world composed of fragments of dreams, memories, and unfinished books, telling a fragmented story of loss, longing, and desire.

title: Sonder
overview: A short film directed by Siddharth Tripathy and Shaaz Aryan.  Sonder is an ode to the realisation that everyone around us has lives as complex and vivid as our own.  Dedicated to the lives of those close to me.

title: PUNHA SHIVAJIRAJE BHOSLE YAJ SATHI KELA HOTA ATTHAS
overview: "Punha Shivaji Raje Bhosale" is a 2025 Marathi film,directed by Mahesh Manjrekar,and a sequel to the film Mi Shivajiraje Bhosale Boltoy. The movie is a socio-political drama that focuses on themes of Maharashtrian pride and identity.

title: Bengali Food Journal
overview: A visual novel that serves as a poetic and cyclic slice-of-life story, focusing on Bengali cuisines, culture and chorography. It primarily highlights the artisans behind these traditions-those who have remained unnamed and uncredited for generations. This narrative pays tribute to the women who have shaped everything that is beautiful and vibrant about this land, from crafting its rich heritage to nourishing its prominent figures for centuries.

title: How Are You Feroz
overview: This unique film, set in the true spirit of Kolkata, tells the love story of Feroz, an antique art dealer obsessed and passionate about his work. His emotional journey mirrors his deep connection to art, following a path of unrequited love, a fear of loss, and the eventual discovery of reciprocity.

title: Far From Home
overview: A feature documentary about a family defying erasure and preserving home away from home.

title: Hijabi Hacker
overview: A young hacker Noor attempts to save her basti when they are scammed by a corrupt politician.

title: Memories Only
overview: A story that unfolds over the course of a single night — Arjun, a 24-year-old man struggling to find a job and stability in life, faces constant rejection. One midnight, he crosses paths with Vidya, a 23-year-old saleswoman, at a bus stop. Seizing the moment, Arjun invites her for a cup of tea. Vidya agrees, and as the night goes on, the two open up about their personal lives. As the conversation deepens, Vidya begins to feel an inexplicable connection — a sense of familiarity, as if she has known Arjun before.

title: Waiting At The Edge Of The Gallows
overview: Pawan Kumar, India’s last hangman from a lineage of executioners, gained fame after hanging the Nirbhaya case convicts. A media favorite, he is known for his blunt views on capital punishment and takes great pride in his legacy, which he hopes to pass to his son.

title: The Bridge
overview: At the edge of despair, Dradul stands on the historic Mani Monastery Bridge, ready to end his life. But fate intervenes. A stray horse and a curious passerby, Jiminem, delay his plan. A chance encounter slowly opens a door to healing. In the quiet moments that follow, life begins to reveal its fragile beauty.

title: Shen-Mo’s of Kibber
overview: In Kibber, a remote Spiti Valley village, women once saw snow leopards as threats but now champion their conservation through the Nature Conservation Foundation. Trained in camera trapping and species tracking, the ‘Shen-mo’s’ balance wildlife protection with earning a livelihood.

title: No Space To Pray
overview: Set in Gurugram, the film follows a community’s struggle for prayer spaces amid urban growth and resistance. As public spaces shrink, tensions rise between communities claiming them. Through intimate portraits, the documentary explores identity, faith, and belonging in an India increasingly marked by division and polarisation.

title: Little Things
overview: Rooted in personal memory and quiet reflection, this documentary follows a young woman returning home to engage in intimate conversations with her family. Through shared stories residing in family archives, she confronts the gendered expectations of her childhood, unspoken struggles with identity, and the quiet resilience passed down through generations.

title: Cuckoo Sings Spring, Unheard
overview: The film follows Suresh, a percussionist who moved to Hyderabad in 1997 during the Human Rights and Dalit Rights movement. Despite deep musical knowledge, he struggles for recognition, performing mainly at public meetings and political gatherings. His artistry remains unacknowledged, as he sings and plays with quiet persistence, yearning for his voice to be heard.

title: Losing Your Mother
overview: Losing Your Mother traces a walk the filmmaker took through Mumbai, India in 2023—the same city in which her Nanabapa (grandfather) studied shortly before emigrating from India to the UK a decade after Indian partition in 1947. Gradually, the filmmaker’s images of the city become testament to the gulf between her Nanbapa’s life and her own, as her attempts to align his memories with the spaces she encounters are repeatedly frustrated. Blending narrative, archival footage and objects with home videos shot by the filmmaker’s mother, the film becomes an attempt to negotiate the gaps and fractures which emerge out of displacement, diaspora and generational trauma.

title: EMPTY BAG
overview: A rich man, driven by greed, kidnaps a poor boy from his home. After two days, the boy wakes to find his sexual organ has been stolen.

title: SADDAM HUSSAINÉ
overview: In the dunes of Jaisalmer, Farookh finds himself hunting down a ghost.

title: NEXUS LOCK
overview: Concerned, the Protagonist rushes to his unlocked home door and finds someone fleeing. Determined to catch the intruder, he follows them back, only to discover the situation is far stranger than expected.

title: Music In A Village Named 1PB
overview: In a landscape of shifting sands, a community enclosed into grids with no name, rehearses its music in villages like 1 PB, a dot at the Indian side of the India-Pakistan border. Mirs are the custodians and practitioners of a timeless poetry not bound to 'quam' or 'desh'. But the land has now degraded, boundaries have hardened and the music has become a whisper. This film gleans songs and poems to stitch a portrait of musicians struggling to keep their inheritance of Sufi and Bhakti music alive.

title: Cameo
overview: Armed with high hopes and small wallets, three youngsters set out to make their dream film. But when an actor with a flair for drama joins the team, their journey quickly spirals into mayhem.

title: fish fry
overview: A young couple, full of excitement and love, heads out for what they believe will be a magical, romantic evening. The night begins with laughter, soft music, and a cozy dinner, setting the stage for the perfect date. However, as the evening unfolds, a series of unexpected events—ranging from misunderstandings to tragic encounters—unravel the evening. What seemed like a simple night of romance quickly spirals into a nightmare, leaving the couple in a place they never imagined they'd be. The story explores the fragility of love and how even the happiest moments can take a devastating turn, forever changing their relationship and their lives.

title: Vizhigalil Natchathiram
overview: A broken girl in the city of Coimbatore, haunted by a lonely past, meets the mystical metaphor of a "Wonder Star". Guided by a constellation of dreams and memories, through her grandmother's tender narration, she embarks on a journey of healing.

title: Collective Dreams Stitched into December
overview: An independent film screening, workers’ hands sewing blankets, the work of newspaper delivery people, stories of strife, and the poetry of crows . . . Images from a December in Jaipur comes into focus through this storytelling patchwork.

title: Erra Mandaram
overview: A new bride has to deal with her overly conservative husband's demands on that 'auspicious' day.

title: Melancholy
overview: Story of a boy who has send to a boarding school after his mother's demise, it shows the relationship between two brothers and how they manage to live without their parents.

title: Arachioothuna Kuzhambu
overview: An indulgent little dive into the world of Ilaiya Punks.  After a bit of time, Ilaiya Punks gather around to eat what S.G cooks da best as far as they know. The Kongu naatu Chicken Curry! aka Arachioothuna Kuzhambu!  And what better way to remember than to film the time of some young punks just punkin' around a space named Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

title: Dreadful Dimension
overview: Three friends encounter strange and disturbing events after one of them gets possessed. As terrifying visions escalate, they struggle to make sense of what's happening — unaware that they are trapped in a repeating loop, living the same nightmare without realizing it.  Is the possession the cause of the loop, or a result of it?

title: What's in a Name?
overview: A heartwarming mockumentary about a trans woman navigating everyday microaggressions and bias in the workplace. With humor and relatable moments, it highlights how small acts of respect can lead to meaningful, transformative change.

title: I Am Tejimola
overview: As a sinister presence emerges, our protagonist draws strength from the Assamese folktale Tejimola-he moi, the shapeshifter. This evocative film explores gender expression and the body as resistance against rigid societal norms.

title: #Unheard Stories - Kaunish
overview: This film sheds light on the heartwarming journey of Kaunish and Aparna, a beautiful couple who share their narrative and express their desire to experience parenthood. Despite confronting their own societal challenges, they have chosen to embrace their journey as parents.

title: #Unheard Stories - Vijaya
overview: Vijaya’s journey through life has been marked by challenges. Enduring multiple instances of attempting suicide and grappling with profound phase of questioning, Vijaya became the first transwoman from the hilly and tribal district of Nandurbar in Maharashtra. Having successfully completed her transition, she has embarked on a new journey in her life and provides succor to many others like her.

title: Sweet Beginning
overview: In a small private school nestled within the vibrant city of Chennai, two remarkable individuals are quietly revolutionizing the classroom experience, shattering the glass ceiling by becoming transwomen educators.

title: 1 vs 1 | Fight-Verse
overview: Featuring 34 one vs one fight sequences together, it transforms into one continuous cinematic showdown where every cut flows into the next.

title: Madurai 16
overview: A Group Of Friends Taking Revenge Against The Oppression Of Power And Money

title: Dumb, Dumber& Dumbest.
overview: Three quirky criminals discovered that one of them had betrayed the other two, leading to an unexpectedly quirky situation.

title: Where The Stars Rest
overview: A tender, dialogue-free animated short film that explores grief through the eyes of a child. When a boy loses his older brother, he embarks on an imaginative journey filled with rockets, stars, and memories. As reality and fantasy intertwine, the film delicately addresses the weight of loss and the quiet strength needed to move forward. With a minimalist visual style and symbolic narrative, Where the Stars Rest is a heartfelt tribute to love, loss, and the places where we keep those we have lost.

title: Paper Rowdy
overview: Two friends chasing gangster dreams get entangled in a deadly mix-up over a suitcase, only to face an unexpected twist.

title: Eltuu Muthaa
overview: Eltuu Muthaa (2025) is a Kannada thriller-drama set in the rain-soaked Kodagu (Coorg) hills, following two funeral drummers whose intertwined destinies echo local tradition and a cryptic peacock-and-cobra fable

title: Bali
overview: Inspired by movies, a young girl from the Banjara tribe in rural Maharashtra fights for her dream of becoming a kabaddi player to escape a forced marriage. During a district-level tournament, she slips into a Bollywood-tinted dream, momentarily becoming the hero she’s always imagined.

title: Every Now and Then Girls...
overview: We are female filmmakers telling a story about women's lives. Our script is based on a popular Rajasthani folktale entitled Dohri Joon or Double Life, compiled by renowned researcher Vijaydan Detha. We chose this story for its powerful feminist vision, coming from a deeply orthodox and patriarchal state like Rajasthan, India.

title: Ignored.
overview: "Ignored" follows a young man taking a cleanliness pledge online, while ignoring the mess around him in his bathroom.

title: Reception Room, Wing D
overview: Inside the small waiting room of a large government office in New Delhi, India, the film follows the receptionists receiving the arriving public as they navigate the labrynthian bureaucracy beyond. As files, food, chai, sweets, and gossip circulate between people, an intimate portrait of the state emerges. It raises a deeper moral question: What is the state’s duty of care?

title: Tutti Frutti Cake
overview: Maya, a transwoman, and her chosen family host a vibrant Diwali party celebrating love and acceptance. As tensions simmer beneath the festivities, unexpected transformations and surprises spark healing, joy, and reconciliation – making it a night of true new beginnings.

title: The Final Descent | A Murder Mystery
overview: A college murder with clues scattered around—can the detective piece them together and uncover the truth? Is it the usual suspects... or the unexpected ones?

title: Possession or Fear
overview: A gripping Indian documentary that blurs the lines between supernatural belief and psychological reality. Through raw, immersive footage of rituals and personal testimonies, it questions whether spirit possession is a cultural truth or a misunderstood mental state. Thoughtful, haunting, and deeply human.

title: Road Of Life
overview: A couple runs away to marry and starts a new life with their daughter. But years later, a mysterious girl enters their world, shaking their bond to the core. The wife slowly uncovers a side of her husband she never knew. As truths come crashing down, she faces a tough choice. Can she escape the chaos, or is it already too late? A gripping tale of love, lies, and betrayal.

title: The Winter Rain
overview: An emotionally charged Assamese film about love and acceptance, exploring same-sex relationships beyond societal norms.

title: Buried Under the Field of Love
overview: Maria, a nurse, is sent on a mission to hand over a beating heart in a box to St Luke's Hospital. Before she hands over the heart to the hospital, she decides to visit a field where her lover wants to be buried.

title: Hitman’s Holiday
overview: Devansh, a hitman who strictly observes Wednesdays as his personal holiday, but gets caught in a violent misunderstanding involving a mysterious pen drive, a freelance hitman, and a high-profile murder. Despite all the chaos, can he still enjoy his Wednesday with his favorite movie and a beer in hand?

title: Writer's Block
overview: Trapped in time and thought, a man struggles with the words that never come, as his past writes itself over his present.

title: CODE ERROR
overview: The film explores the anxiety and pressure an engineer faces in his or her daily life.

title: Bombay : Blessed are the Peacemakers
overview: Bombay Mishra is faced with her final obstacle- and must make a choice that will take her story to its definitive end.

title: Diaster
overview: It's about the destruction of the world. Where the world ends. But who will save? No one..

title: Echoes
overview: A young guy begins to find mysterious scars on his face each morning, triggering a psychological unraveling that forces him to confront a buried truth about his haunting past.

title: Rains Don’t Make Us Happy Anymore
overview: In the high Himalayas, the village of Lohari is submerged below the waters of a hydroelectric dam. The last member of the Jaunsari tribe, living in the remnants of his flooded village, recalls a time when the land was pulsating with magic.

title: Tinctoria
overview: As she readies her new collection in her family's crumbling indigo factory, a fashion designer is confronted by the spirits of indigo workers who died there a century ago.

title: The Fool of Posillipo and Other Stories
overview: In the winter of 1882, the physiologist and scientist Étienne-Jules Marey spent hours on the beach of Posillipo in Naples, pointing an odd-shaped gun at flying birds. The locals started calling him "the fool of Posillipo," as no one ever heard a gunshot. Nor did any birds die. Or, perhaps, Marey was involved in an imperceptible process of killing, shooting birds twelve times a second with his latest invention, the chronophotographic gun - a precursor to moving image technology. The audio-visual assemblage locates the "gun camera" as a speculative prototype of imperialist technology, shadowing related practices from the colonial sport of bird hunting to cartography, anthropometry, ethnographic field recordings, and modern warfare.

title: Isosceles Forest
overview: This work is an optical collage, a loop of images dissolving into each other in a combination of animated gestures. The name echoes mathematician Richard Bellman’s 1955 Forest Problem (“What is the best path to follow in order to escape a forest of known dimensions?”). Here the overlapping and intermingling of images fading in and out of each other seems to look for new propositions, the images follow segmented routes as if seeking out the best possible path to freedom.

title: Isayum Iravum
overview: On a quiet night, amidst the fading echoes of a house party, Jeevan and Nayana step out for a long walk. As the city sleeps, their conversation comes alive—unfiltered, honest, and raw.

title: Dhushor
overview: A melancholic contemplation of a traveller....about life, its origin and finality.

title: THE EVIDENCE HUNT
overview: A photographer working for a leading news channel and paper company stumbles upon something unusual in his camera—an image that wasn’t supposed to be there. As he digs deeper, he finds himself entangled in a web of danger, deception, and a truth that powerful forces want buried. With every shot he takes, the mystery unravels, but so does his safety.

title: Pugai Padam
overview: A smoking addict in recovery fights the temptation to relapse

title: Butterfly
overview: In the Blur of Dreams follows a filmmaker as he directs a dream sequence, navigating the creative process while seamlessly blending the boundaries between his role behind the camera and within the story itself.

title: 1990's
overview: Set in a picturesque village in the 1990s, this timeless tale follows two lovers from different castes who defy societal norms. As they struggle against tradition and prejudice, their love is put to the ultimate test. Will they stand together or succumb to fate? A story of resilience, destiny, and the enduring power of love.

title: Takita Tadimi Tandana
overview: Days before his wedding, A man's life implodes, yet he stays silent. As secrets surface, financial and social pressures mount. Can their love survive?

title: The Simple Fall
overview: Under a sky that has seen a thousand untold stories, two strangers stand unknowingly linked in a moment that will never return.

title: Nectar
overview: Jyothi decides to check on her manager, Ajith, who hasn't shown up to work and has gone completely AWOL. In the process, she meets Manju, Ajith's girlfriend, who may be harboring secrets of her own.

title: Sithariya Pakkangal
overview: The protagonist discovers a story penned by his father, depicting a husband and wife in three intertwined narratives. These stories explore the themes of love, sacrifice, and the emotional intricacies of their relationship, unraveling the depth of their connection.

title: Looking for Lao Mura
overview: A mesmerizing journey in search of the supposedly ‘Extinct in the Wild’ giant turtle, the Lao Mura, takes an unexpected turn when the local anecdotal evidence starts challenging the norms of Western science. To unlock the secrets of these rare and mysterious freshwater creatures in the quest for conservation, 3 young Indian explorers must now delve deeper into ancient Assamese customs to navigate an intricate relationship between two realms often at loggerheads — science and religion.

title: Royal
overview: After getting arrested, a con man discovers his comatose father's company - built by his late mother - is about to collapse. Now he must use his skills to protect her legacy and save the business.

title: Artist
overview: An aspiring actor battles insecurity and the pressure of delivering a challenging dialogue, ultimately discovering that embracing his true self is the key to unlocking his potential.

title: Lost in the abyss
