overview: A matinee draws a young man into desire and fear.

title: Pekamedalu
overview: Young married couple from heartlands face ideological divide. Varalakshmi, grounded homemaker values steady income. Laxman, jobless husband seeks shortcuts for entrepreneurial dreams.

title: Chor Dil
overview: After a man receives the heart of a former gangster in a transplant operation, he finds himself drawn to a life of crime.

title: Byri: Pagam 1
overview: In a small town in Nagercoil, pigeon racing is a matter of pride for hot-headed youngsters and adults. Rajalingam, a young man, whose mother desperately wishes to see as a graduate, gets sucked into this vortex, and earns the enmity of a rowdy-sheeter, putting his life and that of his close friend in danger.

title: Shakhahaari
overview: When the lives of some innocent people start getting intertwined in unforeseen situations they find themselves trapped in a murder mystery. This mysterious butchery infolds in a vegetarian restaurant run by a virtuous Chef Subbanna.

title: Fall
overview: In North Malabar, Mukundan, a local Communist Party secretary as well as a Theyyam artist, grapples with the challenges of ageing and life’s complexities. Yet, he is determined to perform for the upcoming Gulikan Theyyam, marking the onset of the year’s festivities after the tenth day of Thulam, which could probably be his last.

title: Mon Kharap
overview: It is a dark comedy that reflects the current society. Nirban Sen, a psychologist, deals with patients and through them, we see how our everyday problems are plaguing us.

title: Inti Number – 13
overview: An old man and a writer discover supernatural things happening in a villa. Can they find a solution to get rid of the situation?

title: We Love Bad Boys
overview: Three friends embark on a quest to find girlfriends but planning the perfect date takes an unexpected turn, revealing that love's path is filled with surprises.

title: Buddy
overview: Pallavi is an Air Traffic Control officer who suffers a major accident. The doctor along with his crew sends Pallavi into a coma so that he can sell her body parts in Hong Kong. While all this happens, Pallavi's soul enters a teddy bear and reaches the home of a pilot Aditya Ram who shares a past with Pallavi. The rest of the story is as to how the teddy bear and Aditya head to Hong Kong to save the body of Pallavi.  The film is an adaptation of the Tamil film "Teddy".

title: Fairy Folk
overview: Thorny questions of love and sexuality take centre stage in this magical realist drama in which a genderless woodland being crashes into the lives of a jaded couple.

title: Porattu Nadakam
overview: Porattu Nadakam, Which tells the story of a village called Gopalapura in the backdrop of North Malabar. The events unfolding in Gopalapura for 21 days are presented through satire. Art forms like Kothamuriyatam and Porattu Nadakam are the main Background.

title: Level Cross
overview: In a desolate desert, a reclusive gatekeeper offers refuge to a mysterious woman fleeing a dark past, leading to an unraveling of secrets and shattered realities.

title: Fag End
overview: "Fag End" is an astute representation of the metaphorical death of a mother. The movie revolves around a girl named 'Tania', a victim of smoking and alcohol abuse, going through the process of In vitro fertilization. When it comes to alcohol and smoking, an abuser is overlapped with the tendencies of both alcoholism and chain smoking wherein one is subjected to intense cravings, followed by untoward mental as well as physical detention. Things go downhill one morning, as she relapsed the night before and she suffers a miscarriage. Does it not leave us with the raucous screams of the unborn?

title: Binny and Family
overview: Binny's life in London turns upside down when her grandparents visit her and try to insist living her life according to them. Binny and Family throws light on the widening generation gap and that neither generation are being able to understand the other one.

title: Once Upon a Time in Kochi
overview: A young taxi driver inadvertently becomes mixed up with a gang of drug dealers when pursuing an old romance.

title: Bhalle Padharya
overview: Three friends plan a trip to a jungle theme resort for a birthday celebration. They continue on their journey overlooking all the bad omens. Through their journey they meet different characters, leading them to a strange village. A village that lives by the night and disappears by day... a cursed village that's township to ghosts and spirits waiting for their salvation.

title: Return Ticket
overview: Kunal endeavours indefatigably to win his mother's endearment but is stunned to know that he is a byproduct of a gang rape and he resembles one of the assailants. Now spruced up to take revenge against the savages who are now bigtime officials who remain assured that having no traces of a crime of yore can never stop them.

title: Chalaname Chitram
overview: In a surreal afterlife, a young man confronts his memories, regrets, and relationships as he revisits the moments leading up to his untimely death, while his best friend in the living world struggles to come to terms with the role he played in the tragedy, we explore the thin line between guilt and forgiveness, and whether it’s ever too late to make peace with the past.

title: Navra Mazha Navsacha 2
overview: Bhakti and Vacky are once again on a journey to seek blessings at Ganpati Pule but this time because of their daughter Shraddha who makes an unusual and hilarious vow which she forces her fiancé to fulfill as a condition to marry her. With all the adventures and obstacles on their Konkan railway journey, will they be able to fulfill their vow this time as well?

title: No Means No
overview: No Means No is a cross-genre action-packed, teenage musical love story, a courtroom drama that's more like the thrill of a roller-coaster ride as each twist and turn begins to unravel to reach a conclusion that calls out for justice.

title: Haray Khuji Tare
overview: Abir and Sreeporna are childhood friends. They grew up working together with an amateur theatre group. Nilavra, a close friend of Abir, joins the group and falls in love with Sreeporna. Although Abir is also fond of Sreeporna, he fails to express his feelings to her.

title: Travel La Oru Kadhal
overview: Love is same for everyone. But everyone's love experiences are different, so many different love story films have been released in Tamil. In that way, 'Zhagaram' director Krish has made an official announcement about his next film

title: Rakshana
overview: A serial killer targets and murders successful women without leaving any trace. ACP Kiran, a bold and determined police officer, goes beyond the set of rules to follow her gut feeling to bring the killer to justice.

title: Jal Tu Jalaal Tu
overview: A senior employee's life turns on its head after he inadvertedly triggers a laughter spree among overworked factory workers as they race against time to complete an order.

title: Deshakkaran
overview: A man who performed the religious rituals for a village from which he was driven out is asked to return and revive the place's fortunes.

title: Athomugam
overview: Playful act of Martin by installing a spy app in his love of life Leena's phone reveals a mysterious character thereby triggering events that questions love, trust, friendship, technology and unravels the thrilling dark side of human actions.

title: CICADA
overview: Cicada movie is a gripping survival thriller about an unscrupulous man whose journey through the jungle reveals a harsh truth: In the jungle, there is only one law: hunt to satisfy hunger. If the hunt is to serve other desires, the hunter will become the hunted.

title: My Hero
overview: A white American and a Dalit boy guide in Maheshwar bond deeply. Learning of the boy's outcasting for touching an idol, the American helps end discrimination in the boy's village and reunites him with family.

title: Sanju Weds Geetha 2
overview: Sequel to Sanju Weds Geetha (2011).

title: Laandhar
overview: ACP Aravind, an honest and sincere police officer, is assigned with unenviable task of capturing an armed masked killer. Amidst the hunt for the perpetrator, his wife Jaanu goes missing, leaving him racing against time to find her.

title: Oozhi
overview: A contract killer, specializing in honor killings, fails to eliminate a magician, who is the lover of an MLA's daughter. The killer faces shame and pressure from the MLA for his failure. Soon after, the magician is captured. What happens next?

title: Ghost Story 2
overview: Bala is a 20-year-old who has always been lazy. His father Raasikannan live like Korean culture, without worrying about him. Then one day mysterious supernatural activities happened in his house!

title: Fire of Love: RED
overview: A famous novelist Rajveer who gets lost between fiction and reality.

title: Kreem
overview: A neo-noir thriller based on an incredible true story/account. A mysterious girl infiltrates an order, a cult that practices human sacrifice for wealth and power.

title: Shivrayancha Chhava
overview: Aurangzeb wished to turn Burhanpur into the capital city and appointed Bahadur Khan as the Subhedar who made the lives of its residents miserable. Unable to tolerate this, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj raids the city and saves the people from the unjust rule.

title: Finder
overview: A pair of ambitious criminology grads open a private investigation agency with a focus on wrongful convictions. Their latest case leads them to re-examine the conviction of a fisherman accused of murdering a local Councillor. As they dig into the details, they uncover questionable events and circumstances, putting their investigative skills to the test.

title: Siragan
overview: A MLA Come Out of His Home in Search of His Missing Son Later He Meets His Advocate Friend, to Discuss About His Sons Missing, There He Gets Murdered by Someone, This All Happens Because of an Incident Happened Two Years Back. Due to a Small Mistake That Which Leads to a Mystery Crime Event Inside the City.

title: Panjab Files
overview: Set in pre-1947 Punjab, the film explores the sacrifices made by Punjabis in their fight for freedom. It portrays their struggle not only against colonial rule but also to reclaim gurdwaras from British control.

title: Pailam Pilaga
overview: In Kothula Gutta, Shiva dreams beyond his village. When love and fate intertwine, an epic journey of challenges and redemption unfolds.

title: Aranam
overview: The Story is set up in a villageAranthangi, where a zamindar lives with his prodigal son Mayavan. The zamindaradopted two fraternity sons Kathir and Sakthi.Mayavan, who always fights withhis father to register the zameen house to his name, dies unexpectedly. Peoplebelieve that Mayavan's spirit haunt the house.After the death of mayavanzamindar registered the zameen house to his fraternity sons. The same nightzamindar dies suddenly in that house. By the time Kanagu who is close to theZameendar uses some witchcraft tricks to conquer the bungalow.Kathir comes to live in thebungalow with his newly married wife. As they were living happily together someparanormal things happen and questions like what is the reason for thosesupernaturals? What was the cause of zamindar's death? arose.Kathir finds answer to these andmany other unanswered questions along with his younger brother Sakthi, how theyunveil the mystery and recovers from it; is told in a horror thriller genre inan unpredictable form.

title: Viraaji
overview: A stand-up comic, gynecologist, hotel manager, police officer and a drug addict, among others reach an abandoned mental asylum by a mysterious host, who informs them that they would all be dead by dawn for their past sins and proceeds killing. Will they live to see another day?

title: Singappenney
overview: Story of a 15-year-old Thenmozhi who has to fight against several obstacles in her journey to become a national-level athlete.

title: Usha Parinayam
overview: Usha Parinayam story is all about a young girl and the developments ahead of her marriage life and how she handled the pressures and pleasures and also her romantic feelings and youthful exuberance.

title: Love Is Love
overview: Jumping around in time, this wildly campy Bollywood melodrama follows the relationship that develops between Aryan and Ashley, two childhood friends who found their way into one another’s open arms. When their partnership is cut short by an unexpected tragedy, an otherworldly intervention is required to bring perspective and closure to their complicated love affair.

title: Day 1
overview: In the big city of Bengaluru, schools are reopening after 2 years of virtual classes due to COVID-19. A little girl named Sukhi is still asleep without a care in the world however her mother is insistent that she be on time on her first day.

title: Rocket Driver
overview: An autorickshaw driver frequently expresses discontent with life's aspects but harbors an ambitious dream of changing the world, though his actions fail to align with his aspirations.

title: Alyad Palyad
overview: Everyone stays away from the island village for three days every year. It is said that whoever stays behind will get killed by the spirits lurking in the village. What will happen when three friends accidentally get stuck there along with their boatman?

title: Photo
overview: The Indian government announces a nationwide lockdown without proper notice, in the wake of the pandemic. A father who is a daily wager in Bengaluru, and his 10 year-old son, decide to go back to their hometown Raichur, which is 450kms from Bengaluru. And they have to walk all the way due to the lack of transportation. The scorching heat and bad weather shakes their journey as well as both of their lives.

title: Kanakarajyam
overview: The relationship between two people, their complexes and pride.

title: Police Babu 2
overview: Police Babu 2 follows the journey of a cop seeking justice for his father’s death, finding love, navigating the complexities of honesty and corruption, all while balancing his career with family life.

title: Azeem Banatwalla: Minor Celebrity
overview: In his third comedy special, Azeem Banatwalla questions the three 'I's - his identity, his love-but-mostly-hate relationship with Instagram and Impostor syndrome, while also being unsure about his celebrity status, with an occasional poke at today's India.

title: Kartam Bhugtam
overview: The story delves into the ancient truths of astrology and karma, exploring how every action has a certain reaction, echoing the age-old phrase 'as you sow, so shall you reap.

title: Ippadiku Kadhal
overview: A tale about two depressed souls from different regions who come together and find a connection. Their sadness starts to fade away as they spend time together, bringing happiness into their lives. But, of course, life isn't always easy. There's still a bit of baggage that they hold.

title: The Suspect List
overview: The Suspect List is a riveting corporate thriller delving deep into the clandestine world of a prestigious company. The narrative unfolds as the CEO, Vineeth takes charge to unravel the mystery behind alleged misconduct implicating seven senior officials from different departments. As the plot thickens, Vineeth emerges as an unwavering force determined to expose the culprit and decipher their motivations. Through a relentless pursuit of truth, he leads an investigation that peels back the layers of corporate dynamics, revealing a web of relationships, power plays, and hidden agendas.

title: Seedlings
overview: A short by Debraj Naiya.

title: Menu
overview: Unfolds in a single, unbroken shot, a riveting journey delves deep into the lives of two ordinary transgender women as their seemingly ordinary day spirals into a night fraught with complexity and turmoil.

title: The Tour
overview: Film depicts the story of a little child named Tino (Shivam), who comes from an underprivileged fami­ly and lives in a small, remote village in Gujarat, India. The agony of not going on the school trip becomes his inner journey. this is a captivating journey of a poor child.

title: Capture
overview: "Capture" is a visually arresting experimental short film that utilizes a series of juxtaposed (meaning placed close together for comparison) still images to explore the themes of nature, existence, and evolution. This technique creates a sense of tension and invites the viewer to contemplate the relationships between these vast concepts.

title: Aaichya Gavat Marathit Bol
overview: A love story revolving around a young man and his attempts at securing love by speaking nonsensically misspeaking his mother tongue.

title: Vekhi Ja Chhedi Na
overview: Armaan was married to Nikki ,he could see her only but couldn't get close to her.The reason is his elder brother Karma .Now in Nikki InLaw's Nikki is wife of Karma and in front of her parent's she is wife of Armaan. Will they be caught?

title: Blink
overview: Apoorva, a 24-year-old in Bengaluru, conceals his failed MA from his mother. Juggling part-time jobs, he relies on his love interest, Swapna, for support. Apoorva's unique ability to control blinking becomes a curse when a mysterious old man reveals his father's survival.

title: Joymoti Never Left
overview: In 1935, celebrated writer Jyotiprasad Agarwala directed the first Assamese film: Joymoti – a milestone in Indian cinema. Joymoti had a troubled legacy, the film vanished around the time of India's independence, to resurface only partly in the early 70s, with more reels reappearing over time.

title: Ravike Prasanga
overview: Set in a village in Dhakshina Kannada, Sanvi, a beautiful 28-year-old fat girl wants to impress an NRI boy by wearing a saree with a fancy designer blouse. Will the blouse be stitched as per her choice? Will Sanvi get justice in the court?

title: Yo Yo Honey Singh: Famous
overview: He was an ordinary boy with extraordinary dreams. This intimate documentary traces the rise, fall and comeback of Indian rapper Yo Yo Honey Singh.

title: Marivillin Gopurangal
overview: "Marivillin Gopurangal" is an urban drama infused with situational humor, following the lives of Shinto and Sherin, a modern married couple striving to realize their dreams. The arrival of Shinto's brother Rony and his girlfriend Meenakshi brings a transformative journey, exploring family dynamics, expectations, and acceptance. The film weaves rich moments, from falling in love with life to overcoming fears, fostering healing, and celebrating growth. Ultimately, it's a tale of togetherness and the positive evolution of each character.

title: A Fly on the Wall
overview: Follows the final days of Chika Kapadia, given four months to live, who has chosen to end his life through physician-assisted suicide at Dignitas in Switzerland. The filmmakers, tasked with documenting Kapadia’s countdown to death, capture both his journey and their own emotional response.

title: Blue Sunshine
overview: Bhanu, a high school teacher, wants to transition as a trans woman while working for a school in a small town in South India. Bhanu’s parents do not know that she is already taking hormone treatment for the transition. When her parents force a marriage upon her due to their financial situation, Bhanu gains courage under pressure. She starts to live as a woman named Bhanu with her friend Haritha's help. The school administration creates problems by not acknowledging Bhanu as a woman. As Bhanu struggles to find happiness after transition, she meets a student Karthik who is being bullied by his classmates for his feminine demeanor. Unable to withstand the bullying, Karthik retaliates by wearing makeup and nail polish to school. The school administration blames Bhanu for all the problems. How Karthik and Bhanu deal with the problems form the rest of the story.

title: Dear Nanna
overview: A touching tale of a father, Ravi, who hopes his son Surya will take over the family pharmacy. But Surya's passion lies in the culinary arts. How do their conflicting aspirations shape their relationship?

title: Greed
overview: In a high-stakes game of Russian roulette, a mysterious Dealer and a desperate Player confront their darkest desires and past actions, blurring the lines between victory and self-destruction in a gripping battle of wits and wills. Who will win?

title: Rewind
overview: Karthik falls for Shanthi at first sight in a lift. After impressing her, fate takes an unexpected turn. In a bid to win her back, Karthik travels through time to alter events. But does he succeed in his quest for love?

title: Kadakan
overview: Reckless youth Sulfi and rebel father Hyder Ali live in Nilambur when incidents endanger their lives.

title: Mrudhu Bhave Dhruda Kruthye
overview: Shankar Das, with the help of his friends, escapes from his hometown in Kerala to Mumbai seeking refuge from false persecution in a criminal case. After 16 years, he returns back to solve the issues of drinking water shortage and to unveil the truth of his past.

title: Jillu
overview: A trans woman coerced into sex work from a young age longs for dignity and a peaceful life. Her path is marked by systemic violence, police brutality, societal stigma, and romantic betrayal. Featuring real trans women in lead roles, the film presents a raw and compassionate portrait of resilience and the ongoing struggle for justice and recognition.

title: Panchavalsara Padhathi
overview: Revolves around Sanoj who runs the Akshaya Centre in Kalamberi village. All of a sudden, Kalambasura -a local legend- starts appearing infront of the villagers.

title: The UP Files
overview: Inspired by true events, Abhay Singh gets elected as the chief minister of UP and gets to work while facing issues within the state.

title: Game On
overview: A loser enters into a real time game to win which leads him to explore challenges and brings out the hidden secrets from his past.

title: Water Mafia
overview: An inside look at India's vast black market for water, where we understand the modus operandi of the Water Mafia, the scale of the operation, and the different ways in which it affects its victims across Indian cities.

title: Saapala
overview: Uday Rohekar is a renowned playwright, but all his recent plays are flops. At this critical juncture in his career, Uday comes across a perfect script that can get him fame and fortune, if he could only get rid of the real writer.

title: In Retreat
overview: Somewhere between the end of autumn and the start of winter, the absent one returns home to a small town in the mountains. Now in his 50s, always away and late, having missed his brother’s funeral, he lingers at the threshold of the old home - what else can he attain other than delaying one more night of his arrival.

title: Bachelor Party
overview: A man dissatisfied in his marriage is persuaded to attend the bachelor party of an old friend.

title: Kaliyugam Pattanamlo
overview: The story revolves around identical twins, Vijay and Sagar. While Vijay leads a normal life, Sagar exhibits troubling behavior, leading to his placement in a mental rehabilitation center. Years later, Sagar remains unchanged, while Vijay becomes an engineering student.

title: Chhatrapati Sambhaji
overview: Chhatrapati Sambhaji Maharaj, son of Shivaji Maharaj, who grew up without parental love. Sambhaji proved himself a fearless and brave ruler, winning battles and instilling fear in the Mughal Empire.

title: Oru Thavaru Seidhal
overview: Evicted from their flat and desperate for cash, a group of friends, including an aspiring filmmaker, find themselves at Chennai's Koyambedu junction. A chance encounter sparks a risky scheme to earn quick money, but their path is fraught with deception and unforeseen consequences. Did their gamble pay off, or did they fall victim to their own ambitions?

title: Dhoom Dhaam
overview: It is an unusual mix of two love stories: 'Father and Son' and 'Son and a Beautiful girl.

title: The Deaf
overview: Set in the middle of the Covid pandemic in 2020, three lost souls struggle to be heard. Suresh, a young migrant laborer in Mumbai is put into quarantine after he returns to the village to his mother Anibai. Vishnu, a deaf orphan and Anibai's only regular visitor helps her out of misery and visits Suresh at the quarantine centre. He gets in trouble with his uncle over a mistake leading to his expulsion from the village. Anibai is taken to the hospital by the villagers as her apppendix worsens

title: Election
overview: Nadarasan, uninterested in politics, runs for panchayat leader to honor his father. As he delves into the murky world of election politics, he faces violence, rivalry, and betrayals.

title: Rooban
overview: The hero and his wife live in a village lying within a dense forest.Since they are childless several years after their marriage, the village considers them unfortunate and avoids inviting them to any occasions.One day, the hero finds an orphaned baby; he decides to raise him up and brings him home. At the same time, a tiger enters the village. Since the arrival of the baby coincides with that of the tiger, the people get enraged and blame the couple for bringing bad luck to the village.The normalcy of the village is affected.Forest officers enter the village and impose restrictions on the villagers in order to catch the tiger.Some of the villagers who have vowed pilgrimage to Lord Ayyappan await to begin their journey to the temple.The forest officers forbid them from getting out of the village until the tiger is caught.This causes the villagers to become even more furious on the orphaned child.Were the officers successful in catching the tiger?Did the devotees make it to the temple?

title: Vadda Ghar
overview: "Vadda Ghar" is a family drama set against the scenic backdrops of Punjab, India, and British Columbia, Canada. It follows the lives of two brothers and explores the idea that a "Vadda Ghar" (big home) is more about the people than the physical space. Amidst family struggles, the film features two love stories: Baani, a Punjabi actress, finds love with Jasvir, while Deepa and Kelly experience a heartfelt romance. The parents, Samrath and Sukhwinder, navigate raising their sons while holding their relationship together. The film delves into themes of love, sacrifice, and family bonds.

title: Bujji at Anupatti
overview: In a village Uthukuli a girl Durga and her elder brother Saravanan live with their parents. The family lives in a farm house of the landlord Shiva and were farmers for him. One day Durga and Saravanan find a kid on their way to home and taken with them. They named it as Bujji. Drunkard father of the children sold the kid for his drink. Knowing this Durga was upset and eith her urge saravanan and durga start a journey to get back bujji home. On their way they met Dharshini an orphan girl living as a maid with one family. Later she becomes an acquaintance with them, The trio identified the whereabouts of the kid but need money to get it back. Mean while Shiva came to know the children are missing from home. The journey of Shiva searching the children and the journey of Children saving a kid are the rest of the plot.

title: Konjam Pesinaal Yenna
overview: Sanjana's feelings for her childhood crush Ajay reawaken through virtual interactions. They bond over phone calls during lockdown, forming a connection without traditional labels, but face hurdles in recognizing their emotions.

title: Jaspal
overview: Two Punjabi brothers are stuck in lives they want to escape. Jaspal dreams of a woman out of his reach, Vicky dreams of emigrating to Canada. Both are trapped by Sanjay, Chandigarh's Police Chief.

title: Alaap
overview: Pablo Majumdar, Aditi Mitra, and Swatilekha Sen working in different IT companies cross paths in the professional sphere where a series of events unfold.

title: Sambavasthalathu Ninnum
overview: Hidden Truth Waiting to be Unveiled...

title: Chandrabanshi
overview: In this modernized version of Mahabharat where five brothers who were separated, unite and avenge the death of their Father.

title: Ajay Gadu
overview: Ajay Gadu is a Telugu romantic action entertainer movie directed by Team A. The movie casts Ajay Kumar Kathurvar, Shweta Mehta, and Bhanu Sri in the main lead roles. The music was composed by Karthik Kodakandla, Manizena, Sumanth Babu & Pratheik while the cinematography was done by Ajay Nag and the film is produced by Ajay Kumar Kathurvar, Chandana Koppisetti under Ajay Kumar Productions banner.

title: In, out and about
overview: an exploration of queerness and  fear of illness through personal and shared experiences, reflecting on how they shape the body and identity.

title: Gu
overview: Gu follows the fearless eight-year-old Minna on her first visit to her dads ancestral home where she becomes enthralled by the legend of Gulikan, a spectral presence rumored to appear anytime, day or night.  When her cousin Paru falls under the grip of an evil entity, Minna and her cousins embark on a courageous mission to banish the malevolent force

title: Incident
overview: A police inspector gets stuck deep inside a forest with a wounded leg but later realizes that he's part of a much bigger conspiracy.

title: Thozhar Cheguevara
overview: An innocent boy hailing from a village is struck by an unfortunate incident, which webs him in conflicts that endanger his life and his community under threat. His idyllic life is shattered, deftly turning his world upside down. A bounty is announced on the boy's name to kill him on the same night. Whether he can recoup and overcome the labyrinth of conflicts forms the crux of the story

title: Ondu Sarala Prema Kathe
overview: Athishay is a young man who wants to become a music director. Anu is a kind hearted and caring woman. When it comes to love, being a musician Athishay dreams of a woman who matches the rhythm of his heartbeat, and Anu is waiting for a person who is genuine & wishes good for others without expecting anything in return. In a twist of fate, Athisay and Anu get married to each other. However, they do not lose hope and continue their quest for true love.

title: Drame Aale
overview: A group of theatre performers travel to London and put on a production they hope will repair cultural divides between India and Pakistan.

title: Dhil Raja
overview: The clash between a middle-class family and wealthy, powerful youths escalates dramatically after an unexpected death. The family, now hunted by the powerful, must go to extreme lengths to protect themselves. With nowhere to turn, the ordinary man finds hope in his admiration for Rajini, revealing that even the powerless can become heroes when pushed to their limits.

title: Kabzaa
overview: Amidst the urban transformation driven by progress, bulldozers dismantle 'illegal' settlements, leaving countless lives shattered. In the aftermath of such upheaval, one basti, sacrificed to conceal poverty during the G20 summit, and another basti, abandoned by authorities without alternative housing, illustrate the stark realities of displacement. The film delves into the daily struggles of individuals who persist in the rubble of their former homes.

title: Mazaiyil Nanaigiren
overview: Jeeva, a wealthy but reckless Christian, falls for Aishwarya, an ambitious Brahmin girl focused on her U.S. education, but she rejects him. Fate changes when Jeeva befriends Aishwarya’s sister, Abhi, who praises him to Aishwarya, causing her to reconsider. Eventually, Aishwarya, torn between her dreams and feelings, decides to confess her love to Jeeva.

title: Ladies Bar
overview: Amar opens a bar exclusively for women named Ladies Bar. A social worker named Sudhakar fights against this bar deeming it harmful to their culture. Will the bar open and run successfully?

title: Vishesham
overview: Set in the background of the densely crowded city of Cochin. A city filled with the advertisements of fertility clinics. Flavoured with humour Vishesham conveys the story of today's world of fertility treatments.

title: Aliya Basu Gayab Hai
overview: Ex-convicts Deepak Kumar and Vikram Singh abduct Aliya Basu, a rich man's daughter for ransom. But, Vikram is unaware that Deepak has a different plan.

title: Daaru Na Peenda Hove
overview: The life of a directionless alcoholic is positively disrupted when his estranged daughter re-enters his life.

title: Kamthaan
overview: A small-time thief makes the robbery of a lifetime when he accidentally breaks into the house of the newly appointed Police Inspector.

title: Raavsaheb
overview: In tribal India, a man's conflict with nature escalates, sparking a gripping quest for justice amidst the unforgiving wilderness.

title: Maruthi Nagar Subramanyam
overview: A father and son's life changes dramatically after their bank account is mysteriously credited with a large amount of money.

title: Ee Varam Satyam Gurinchi
overview: Film Director Vamsy tells us a story about his fellow Filmmaker E.V.V. Sathyanarayana

title: Murphy
overview: MURPHY, starring Prabhu Mundkur, Roshini Prakash and Ila Veermalla,It is an  ode to the beauty and the struggle of bringing in the essence of familial bonds, friendship and  above all love in the era of dispassion.

title: Manorajyam
overview: Manu Keraleeyan, a Melbourne businessman, falls for a Malayali girl. His friend Bluetooth Ravi flirts online, while another friend's wife elopes with a guy she met online. Testing his wife's loyalty triggers a chain reaction that transforms his life.

title: Kudumba Sthreeyum Kunjadum
overview: A police officer pursues a gang of thieves. Meanwhile a husband returns from overseas with his wife, leading to marital complexities.

title: Sathamindri Mutham Tha
overview: This is a mystery thriller involving the hero, a killer for hire and the heroine. The heroine is involved in a hit and run case and is rescued by the hero. She becomes amnesiac and he takes her home and keeps her with him. Her husband lodges a complaint with the police that his wife is missing. There is a vengeful Inspector of police who wants to kill the hero he being a killer. This then becomes a story of conflict and entanglement between the characters. What happens to the hero, the heroine who suffers in amnesia, her husband and the policeman gets resolved in the climax.

title: Appu
overview: Elephant calf Appu undertakes perilous journey across ocean and treacherous forest to save father from poachers' grip, aided by loyal dog Tiger and runaway child Neena, uncovering his extraordinary abilities.

title: Tantra
overview: A timid girl named Rekha possesses an extraordinary power to perceive spirits. When she encounters a malevolent tantric, she's drawn into unraveling dark occult mysteries, putting her life at risk.

title: Kurukku
overview: Inspector Sajan is tasked with investigating a complex double murder of a couple. However, dubious evidence and witnesses make it difficult for him to solve the case.

title: Narrator
overview: A Lonely Teenager decides to take a psychological challenge which may lead to the dark past which he is unaware of.

title: Pune Highway
overview: Three friends who have grown up together in the same building in Mumbai are affected, in different ways, by a dead body found 200 kms away in a lake. As they fight for their friendship, they can't escape the ugly truth racing towards them.

title: Monsoon Walk
overview: In a remote village of the Sayhadri mountains, a 75-year-old woman embarks on a journey to fetch medicines for her grandson on a heavy monsoon day.

title: Drinker Sai
overview: Heartbroken and spiraling into alcoholism, a jilted lover desperately pursues his former muse, unwilling to accept their relationship's end.

title: Jagat
overview: When a 12-year-old boy goes missing on his way to school, things don't seem what they appear to Police Sub-Inspector Jagat Pandya. As he digs deeper, the one thing he has to keep is his patience. A tiny detail leads him to the sinister truth he wasn't prepared for.

title: Putul
overview: Written, directed and produced by Indira Dhar Mukherjee.

title: In the Name of Fire
overview: In the remote outskirts of Manorva village, Rukhiya, Phekan, and their son Karimana live on society's margins, enveloped by the haunting melodies of Kirtan prayers. Phekan, a humble laborer, struggles against poverty, while resilient Rukhiya tenderly nourishes their child despite scarce resources.

title: Dump Yard
overview: Amidst the chaos of planning his son's birthday, Sandesh's phone, crucial for an investor call, gets accidentally thrown away. In his quest to retrieve it, he discovers unexpected emotional depths.

title: Mor Chhainha Bhuinya 2
overview: Two brothers Uday and Kartik grow up together in Chhattisgarh with differences in their ideologies but with love for each other in their hearts. One day, they find themselves against each other. What will win - their love or their ideology?

title: Ananya
overview: The movie revolves around the girl called Ananya, who comes from great orthodox family, Even though she comes from a great family. The Antagonist of the film is also from her family where he abuses Ananya from the childhood.

title: Krishnam Pranaya Sakhi
overview: Krishna, a business tycoon, meets Pranaya, an orphan who runs an orphanage. Krishna, worried that his socio-economic status may separate him from Pranaya, pretends to be a driver and becomes employed by Pranaya. Pranaya soon learns about Krishna's identity, but she later accepts his love.

title: Kaalam Darrr - Short Film
overview: Ever thought about getting rid of the worst parts of your life to find peace? Meet GoKi (Gopala Krishnan), a frustrated and vexed young man who spends New Year's Day running his uncle's CD shop. Desperate to escape his monotonous life, he stumbles upon a mysterious calendar in a pile of trash. As soon as he tears off a sheet, his life takes an unimaginable turn. Yet, time has a way of binding human lives to reality. This 3-minute (2 mins, 49 secs) mystery comedy Tamil short film depicts how time intricately crafts a profound journey for its protagonist.

title: Vishay Hard
overview: One morning 21 year-old Dolly comes to know that 32 year-old constable Kishor is coming to see her for marriage. Kishor comes and likes her. The Parents decide that the marriage is to be done in the evening only. Dolly gets scared and calls her boyfriend Sandeep, who is stuck in some strange situation. He is totally unemployed. He now plans out to fetch money and elope with her. During all these happenings, his phone gets switched off and he is disconnected from Dolly.

title: The Proof
overview: The story revolves around a trial of a girl's gruesome murder case, the clandestine consequence of which is the notorious drug trafficking scandal and its cover-up. The trial gets over and the verdict of the court in this significant case is also out but in favour of those who indulged in this heinous crime.The acquitted conspirators were about to celebrate their victory. But the story is replete with many nail-biting twists and turns, when the scenes begin to unfold with another girl getting locked up in her own house by her boyfriend for the reasons unknown and the girl happens to be aware of the crucial truth behind the above-said criminal case. She endeavours to extricate herself from the precarious lockdown like situation she is facing inside her locked room and bring the concealed truth to light. Her heart-rending struggle inside the room without food and water and her efforts to get the much-awaited justice to the victim in the climax form the crux of the movie.

title: Kooki
overview: A 16-year-old girl Kooki's beautiful present life and dreamy future are destroyed by a gang rape, and after the incident, the court's verdict against the culprits makes her feel betrayed and not served justice as a victim.

title: Marching in the Dark
overview: In a drought-struck region in India, suffering from climate change and a high suicide rate amongst farmers, a group of resilient women farmers, who recently lost their husbands, is coming together with a local psychologist to learn counselling and help others in grief.

title: Valari
overview: What happens when your past comes back to haunt you in the most supernatural way? And what if you don't even remember it?

title: Palayam PC
overview: A middle-aged police constable, prefers to take night duty at an aid post in Palayam which is relatively risk-free and quite peaceful. Things changed when he was assigned protection duty for the female activist who was under public threat.

title: Ramana Avatara
overview: A jovial guy named Rama Krishna who wants to be a political leader, goes through a series of uncontrollable situations that end up being lessons of life and help him become a true leader.

title: Man Yedyagat Zala
overview: A budding love story of two students in the bloom of their youth set against the backdrop of college.

title: Namastey Sir
overview: Deepak, a 14-year-old boy and his school friends embark on a twisted revengeful journey against their Science teacher infamous in school for beating students mercilessly after he catches Deepak with a love letter and humiliates him.

title: Furteela
overview: A simple, kind-hearted college student falls for a classmate who does not return his affections.

title: Hashtag Tadev Lagnam
overview: Follows an older man and woman navigating their dating lives with only one goal - marrying.

title: Karki Nanu BA, LLB
overview: The film portrays the struggles faced by Muthuraj who gets caught in caste-based discrimination and how his resilience and courage help him challenge deep-rooted societal norms.

title: Kanni
overview: Follows Kalyani, a small-town girl from Maharashtra, India, who, after losing her job, devises a risky plan with her roommates to marry a UK citizen and secure her future. As friendships are tested, and relationships are at stake, Kalyani learns that true success and happiness demands facing inner fears, ultimately realizing that the path to a meaningful life is a journey of resilience rather than shortcuts.

title: Krispy Rishtey
overview: Karan gives in to his Father's wish, breaking up with his child hood crush Natasha and gets married to Anjali. Anjali with all the commitment a traditional Indian girl has, begin to build Karan's world but despite of all her goodness, Karan feels no attachment to her and eventually confess that he doesn't wish to be in this forced marriage. Anjali learns of Natasha and decides to step off calling her trust worthy friend Vinod. In the tale of relationships, trust, devotion and sacrifices all the four characters finally gets to achieve what was right for them.

title: Nilgiris- A Shared Wilderness
overview: A land of sacred peaks and secret creatures, lost in the mists of time, somewhere between folklore and magic. This is a story of India's very first UNESCO Biosphere Reserve - the Nilgiris - one of Asia's most intensively studied areas.

title: Ettum Varai Ettu
overview: Poomani wins in national level running race and gets a chance to participate in Olympic. She appears in connections with a murder case on her way to the Olympic. At the end she is proven innocent and participate in the Olympic Games and wins a gold medal in the running race.

title: Shanti Appartment - Flat No. 203
overview: When a murder occurs, the police investigation casts suspicion on those present, leading to a quest to uncover the actual murderer among them. The revelation profoundly impacts the relationships and lives of a family as they navigate the truth about the perpetrator in their midst.

title: Jai Ganesh
overview: In the unforgiving shadows of sympathy, Ganesh Gangadharan, a paraplegic designer, wrestles with his inner demons, striving for a semblance of normalcy.

title: Nogor Baul Kotha
overview: Abhilash aspires to be a musician, but his life takes an unexpected turn when he falls in love with the singer of a rival band and gets caught up in the glitz and glamour of city life.

title: Metamorphosis
overview: Every worm has an opportunity to transform itself into a colorful butterfly at least once in its lifetime. But the road to transformation	is painful and	full of consequences. Will the worm decide to continue existing as a worm, or will it break its cocoon and finally bloom into a beautiful butterfly, which forms the genesis of Roopanthara?

title: Bai Ga
overview: When Dhanush asks God why Dhanush and Aboli's life is not going well, he realizes that he has not treated his wives properly in the last five lives. God gives him a chance to correct his mistake by bringing his wives from the previous five births into this birth and punishes Dhanush to find out the desire of each of them and fulfill it.

title: Samarthya
overview: Krishna and Megha, who fall in love at first sight, get married and live happily till Megha goes missing. A lookout for Megha eventually uncovers the devastating truth behind the case that leads to Krishna's Samarthya.

title: Shesh Rokkha
overview: Rupsha meets Troyee and Abhi in London when she goes there to complete her post-graduation. She goes from being a tenant to a friend very soon. But life's drama seems to put their friendship to the test.

title: Haye Bibiye Kithe Fas Gaye
overview: A builder from Punjab travels to Britain and unknowingly moves into a house haunted by a family of ghosts.

title: The Miranda Brothers
overview: An orphan rescued from trash becomes devoted to his elder brother in a Goan suburb run by a drug gang, both growing to be star footballers - till suspicious death of their mother threatens to tear them apart.

title: phoools (the film)
overview: "Phoools" dives into an artist's obsession with the simplest of shapes - a few ovals rotated around a circle, universally agreed to be called a flower. As he starts seeing this pattern everywhere, from drain covers to textiles, his perception shifts. The line between observer and observed blurs, reality melts into imagination.

title: Gatham
overview: Sreeyansh, a troubled student, battles the shadows of his past while adapting to a new life in a college hostel. When eerie encounters and terrifying visions begin to blur the line between reality and delusion. His past resurfaces in unexpected ways, Sreeyansh must confront his darkest secrets and unravel the mystery before it consumes him entirely.

title: Majnoo
overview: The film Majnoo is a Triangle Love Story of Majnoo, Preet and Mahi. Preet and Mahi fell in love with Majnoo and twists and turns come up when Mahi comes into the life of Preet and Majnoo. Who will become Majnoo's lover and partner.

title: Local Kung Fu 3
overview: Fresh of earning his yellow belt, a wannabe don Bonzo, is humiliated when two skilled brothers cut his hair during a fight. Seeking revenge, he turns to Dulu and Tansen for help. As tension rises, Dulu and Tansen manage to knock out one of the brothers. The story culminates in a dramatic showdown, where honor, identity, and redemption are fiercely fought over.

title: Poyyamozhi
overview: Jayson is a runaway who is guided through the woods by an older man named Chachan.  However, the dynamic between them changes from a guide and a traveller to a hunter and his prey. The story takes a dark turn when Jayson discovers Chachan's true, vengeful intentions, leading to a shocking confrontation.

title: Roti Kapda Romance
overview: Childhood pals scattered worldwide reconnect after years apart. Together, they road trip across India to Goa, one friend determined to confront his ex who broke his heart and show her the mistake she made.

title: Typical
overview: Peter, struggling with the aftermath of a bruise experience faces emotional trouble when his friend accuses him of indifference, dismissing the situation as 'typical'.

title: Nocturnes
overview: In the dense forests of the Eastern Himalayas, moths are whispering something to us. In the dark of night, two curious observers shine a light on this secret universe.

title: A Terrible Beauty
overview: What makes a body human? This science-fiction fable shot in China foreshows the rise of AI. Time behaves fluidly as we travel into the near future in the company of an unusual pair: Blue and her friend, a mannequin named Lucy.

title: Hazaar Vela Sholay Pahilela Manoos
overview: The Man Who Has Watched Sholay A Thousand Times

title: Fear and Furniture
overview: The fear of a 13 year old when he is subjected to his first responsibility.

title: Kudi Haryane Val Di
overview: Attempting to impress a woman whose family is passionate about wrestling, a man accidentally bluffs his way into a coaching job.

title: Chennaiyil Vaanam Megamootathudan Kaanapadum
overview: Chennaiyil Vaanam Megamootathudan Kaanapadum movie is a thriller drama, a story narrated from an ayyanar aruvaal's point of view from a coconut shop during a cyclone time. will the city be saved? will the aruvaal reach back the shop?

title: Golden Love
overview: Golden Love is a tender and heartwarming short film that explores the enduring bond between an elderly couple, Amos and Anna, and their mischievous yet lovable cat. Set against the quiet rhythms of their everyday life, the film beautifully captures moments of love, nostalgia, and the unspoken connection that binds them together.

title: Vaar Tahevaar
overview: Preetal and Shubh represent today's generation mindset. They are not very keen on starting their own families; they are focused on earning money and achieving their goals, but getting married is not a priority for them. But their families, determined to change Preetal and Shubh's mindsets, convince them to attend the grand Holi festival and the wedding of Shiv and Shivani, who are madly in love with each other (presenting the madness of love) and embody the joy and fulfillment of traditional family values.

title: Taylor's Version
overview: Two men realise they're grappling with their love lives by pretending to understand Taylor Swift.

title: Pagalariyaan
overview: Wolf is in the process of eloping with his girlfriend Akshara while the gangster Silent is frantically searching for his sister who has eloped with her boyfriend, a dubious character who is looking to sell her off.

title: The Lost Girl
overview: "The Lost Girl" follows 5-year-old Suhani separated during the 1984 Sikh riots, surviving 15 years with strangers. Memories haunt her until she escapes, embarking on a journey to find her true identity and family.

title: Jeevi
overview: Four friends reel in a strange, otherworldly creature while fishing. One sees profit, another devotion, a third seeks answers, and their clashing intentions set off a chain of unforeseen consequences

title: Dhairyam Sarvatra Sadhanam
overview: To protect the existence of his father, Dravid decides to go against Matsya and Arya. Will he be successful?

title: Girl Friends
overview: Five female transgender friends in Kerala, Rosa, Janaki, Nandhana, Uma, and Benila, with different sexual orientations, upholds their identities, assert ownership of bodies, challenge societal, familial restrictions and expectations.

title: Six Nine Five
overview: Based on Ram janambhumi Struggle. Historical drama concerning the birth of Rama.

title: Duniya
overview: Three reckless orphans-Jay, Sid, and Kamesh-spiral into drugs and crime, crossing a brutal gang and assaulting a girl. On the run, they meet a mysterious woman and hide at a farmhouse. But a masked killer begins a violent game of revenge-one that ends with a shocking reveal that shatters everything they believed.

title: Luv You Shankar
overview: An eight year old boy contemplates his relationship with Lord Shiva (the incarnation of Lord Vishnu) in the sacred city of Banaras.

title: Deception - trust no one, Believe nothing
overview: When Alakananda returns home from work, they're met with a series of eerie and unexplained events that shatter their sense of security. As the mysterious occurrences escalate, she begin to question her own sanity and the truth about her life. The lines between reality and paranoia blur, and the Main character Alakananda is forced to confront the darkest corners of her own psyche. But what if the truth is more sinister than they ever imagined? 'Deception' is a gripping mystery thriller that keeps you guessing until the very end."

title: Mutta Kallan
overview: Britto, a skinny young man striving to get fit, relies on eggs for his protein boost. But when his eggs mysteriously start disappearing, suspicions rise among his four housemates. As frustration builds, Britto is determined to catch the culprit behind the missing eggs.

title: The Taste of Summer
overview: A girl who's recently returned to her hometown conjures up memories about what she's been missing as a storm descends upon a hot summer afternoon.

title: Operation Laila
overview: Surya, a sincere police officer, has a twin brother, Ravi, who becomes a beloved Drill Master at a school. Ravi falls in love with teacher Anjali. They encounter a ghost named Laila, seeking revenge for her murder. As Laila targets the school's staff, Surya must stop her or risk losing more lives.

title: Holy Curse
overview: Teenage Radha is on a trip to self-discovery. Only the journey is involuntary as they're forced by their family to be cured of the perceived deviances; a conversion therapy of sorts.

title: Sarangadhariya
overview: Krishna's family deals with sons' unemployment, daughter's marriage prospects. A hidden secret emerges, challenging their unity. They navigate this crisis while reflecting societal issues.

title: Charam
overview: Vishwasam, athale ellam.

title: Abbabba
overview: Remake of the Malayalam film Adi Kapyare Kootamani

title: Jugalbandhi
overview: A mother, a couple, and a visually impaired person, where all of them will focus on their hunt for finance.

title: A Passenger in Love
overview: An introverted guy randomly asks a girl out at the Delhi train station on a day date. They spent the entire day getting to know each other. One is keeping a secret and the other longs for love. Will destiny intervene?

title: Lemons Are Not Sour
overview: A young girl’s world transforms when her mother decides to remarry, setting off a profound journey of self-discovery, sacrifice, and the intricate interplay of love and familial bonds.

title: Seventy Eight
overview: The film "ATATTOR" evolves around Mahesh, a man burdened by guilt and internal conflict as he tries to escape the shadows of his past. His journey takes place, just one day before mahalaya (দেবীপক্ষের সূচনা) where external chaos mirrors his inner turmoil. Mahesh encounters Abhaya, a calm yet intense figure who pushes him to confronts his darkest fears and regrets. Abhaya serves as a symbolic figure of confrontation and resolution, forcing Mahesh to face the moral consequences of his actions.  The backdrop of Durga Puja, combined with ongoing protests, serves to highlight themes of justice, redemption, and the eternal battle between light and darkness. Mahesh's struggle is portrayed as a silent war within himself, representing the fall of his inner demons.

title: Telisinavallu
overview: Chaitra Loves her family and her family believes in superstitions. As they prepare for a Ritualistic-Cult Suicide, one person intrudes: The young man who loved Chaitra.

title: The Moon
overview: Under the glow of a full moon, a romantic and a cynic argue about its beauty. But as the banter turns heated, things become personal, deepening the mystery of their connection.

title: Jajabara 2.0
overview: When two strangers meet by a fluke they open up about their criminal past. While one retains the crime, the other seeks redemption.

title: We Are Faheem & Karun
overview: Karun, a young security officer from South India, is stationed in Gurez, a remote village in Kashmir. One day, a charming man named Faheem comes to the check post and meets Karun. This marks the beginning of a romance, which, from the outset, is doomed – Faheem, bound by the societal taboos surrounding homosexuality in the context of his religion, cannot live openly, while Karun, due to the constraints of his profession, must also hide his true self. The film explores the intersection of love, identity, and repression in a region steeped in conflict.

title: BOSS
overview: A story about a girl of the 21st century who wants to build her world.

title: Rudraa
overview: Rudra, a reckless youth, spirals into darkness after a fake love leads to a girl’s tragic death. Haunted by family strife and addiction, he finds hope post-rehab with Amrita, enduring loss and discovering resilience and true love.

title: Country's Funeral
overview: As per tradition, young man shaves his head after death, but whose death is he mourning about?

title: Hi Anokhi Gaath
overview: A young aspiring dancer's father forces her to marry a stoic, yet understanding man. Then begins a sweet-and-sour relationship with her husband. But when he comes to know she loves another man, he strives to bring her and her lover close, shaking the foundation of their marriage.

title: Dhonima
overview: Dhanam, a middle aged house maid, finds a puppy on her way back from work. She decides to keep the puppy as a companion for her son Dravid, an eight year old child who suffers from partial deafness. Dhanam is working hard to do surgery for Dravid’s illness. Dhanam’s husband Kotti is a construction worker and a drunkard never bothers about the family well-being. So how the dog’s presence in their life makes life changing moments is the crux of the film

title: Iravin kangal
overview: It's a tale of two friends, artificial intelligence Iris and IT professional Victor.  Victor works in Bangalore & his wife is working in dubai. Being married yet lonely, made him like one of his office colleague Preethi. At the same time Victor was annoyed & surprised by his new gadget Iris. Iris is an Artificial Intelligence gadget (like Amazon Alexa).Victor asks Preethi out for dinner & it ends up with one night stand. Knowing this, enraged Preethi's boyfriend enters Victor's house to fight with him, but was killed accidentally.  Now the oversmart gadget Iris helps Victor to hide the body. The rest of the story is like a roller coaster ride with unexpected twists & turns. Is Iris smart enough to save Victor?

title: Light House
overview: The Movie is a Crime Thriller for the Adage "Revenge is a Dish That Tastes Best When Served Cold". The Protagonist is a Man Seeking Vengeance For the Murder of His Lover in a Cold and Calculated Manner. It Depicts the Greed for Wealth and Carnal Urges Which Knows No Boundaries.

title: Pambattam
overview: An efficient police officer and his son’s lives are gravely impacted when the former is appointed to investigate the mysteries surrounding a palace that's believed to be haunted by the spirit of a former queen. Will they be able to get to the bottom of it all and also manage to safeguard each other from trouble?

title: Sundaram Master
overview: Social studies teacher Sundar is sent to an isolated mountainous village in search of a valuable item and to convince the locals to  join his constituency. However, things quickly go awry.

title: Padikkada Pakkangal
overview: In Yercaud, a heroine visiting for a shoot clashes with a fake reporter who confesses to blackmailing women. Seeking revenge for her sister's murder, she takes evidence from him, kills him, and delivers it to the police. The evidence implicates many in similar crimes, leading to a government crackdown.

title: Political War
overview: Set against the backdrop of an election, corrupt politicians stir up religious conflicts in this Hindi language drama.

title: My Home
overview: A heart-wrenching tale of love, loss, and longing—a story of four women waiting for the return of Mohan, a migrant worker and the family's sole breadwinner. Over the years, their lives are defined by hope, yearning, and dreams that seem increasingly out of reach.

title: Venus: Try Flap
overview: In the bustling, mist-laden Silicon City of 2028, Shukra stumbles upon a mysterious bag of oranges. What seems like a trivial discovery quickly spirals into an unexpected journey, which pulls him deeper into a web of unlikely encounters.

title: Katra Thaliya
overview: "Angamuthu, a rural village boy with dreams of going abroad, falls head over heels for Ananthi, a trainee at the village elementary school. His mischievous friend Vanaraj keeps teasing him and insists he should confess his love to her. So, Angamuthu plans to pop the question on her way back to the bus. Meanwhile, Seemathanni, the village's self-proclaimed Romeo, forcibly marries poor Kiruthika while Angamuthu waits to propose to Ananthi. Inspired by Seemathanni's bold (and questionable) move and Vanaraj's encouragement, Angamuthu decides to practice his own crazy forced marriage plan with Ananthi. Will his wacky plan work? And what on earth happens to Seemathanni and Kiruthika after their chaotic union? Dive into the comedic chaos of the short film 'Katra Thaliya' to find out!"

title: Tike Tike Achihna Tu
overview: Can a woman juggle the love of two men and still get acceptance from society?

title: Unn Sawali
overview: Pranay doesn't want to get married and Aanvi on the other hand doesn't want to get married too but she cannot tell that to her mother so they both unwillingly say yes to their marriage for their parent's sake. Two strangers get engaged and their journey to find love in each other's heart begins.

title: Ade (On a Sunday)
overview: In 2002, eight-year-old Ade and his older friend Abu skip Sunday school for a day of fun and antics. Their escapades leads them down an unexpected path, thrusting them into their first encounter with the complexities of the adult world.

title: Bibi Rajni
overview: A ruler craving a male heir renounces God and threatens those of his subjects who do not follow him, including his youngest daughter.

title: Sur Lagu De
overview: Follows an old, lower middle-class couple who look after their grandchildren due to their parents' death. But as their grandson is diagnosed with leukemia, they go through tumultuous trials and tribulations to earn money and make sure their grandchild is saved.

title: Nasibpura
overview: Strange murders are happening in Nasibpura, just like 20 years ago. Will the police solve this dark mystery?

title: Hari Ka Om
overview: Hari Prasad and his son Om are separated because of ideological differences. When Hari suffers a heart attack one morning and announces that he is going to die in six days, his wish to take his last breath at Kashi (Varanasi) with his elder son Om sets them on a destined journey to heal their dysfunctional relationship.

title: Chivaraku Migiledi
overview: A black and white film that takes place on a Sunday in the drunk town of Hanmakonda.

title: Karmi Aapo Apni
overview: A Sikh man's experiences of racism abroad compel him to seek a resolution to the caste discrimination in his own community.

title: Secret Home
overview: The lives of four protagonists get entangled in a gruesome incident, involving a typical home with 'uncomfortable' secrets. As aftermaths unfold, their grey shades get exposed.

title: Inverse
overview: This story looks at the time between the beginning and the end of your life, over time, behind time, and ahead of time, at the same time.

title: Market Mahalakshmi
overview: A young man pursues a relationship with an independent street vendor. Despite their differences, he tries various ways to convince her to marry him.

title: Bal Naren
overview: Naren, a 14-year-old boy, takes up the role of spreading awareness about the importance of cleanliness when coronavirus hits the country. Will he be able to save his village from the deadly virus?

title: Headhunting to Beatboxing
overview: The story of a tribe in the far North East of India engulfed in the depths of violence and bloodshed, and resurrects itself through the healing power of music and emerges through a musical renaissance.

title: The Heist
overview: Ex-FATF agent Ananya meets master con artist Neel through the Dark Web. They form an unlikely team to conduct a heist to loot a billionaire fugitive of his ill-gotten money and disrupt his smuggling network.

title: Sedin Kuyasha Chilo
overview: an anthology of three stories based in different eras - the first story is set in the 1940s where a freedom fighter ends up taking refuge at a woman's place after being chased by the cops. The second story is about three childhood friends who have lost touch and reunite after many years. The third story is about a young village boy who comes to the city to pursue his dream and doesn't care for his old parents.

title: AATMA RAAVE
overview: 3 friends play ouija board, spirit game to make a youtube video but one of the friends get terrified and shocked when the spirit comes for true.

title: Troy the Bharat Putra
overview: An abandoned dog in the border area of Poonch, Kashmir was found by the childless couple Major Bharat Kumar Reddy of Indian Army and his wife Nandini Srinivasan Reddy. Major Bharat who is the big fan of the movie TROY, so Nandini named him Troy. The four legged son connected with Major Bharat by his soul.

title: Viswarupa
overview: Kalki spirals down in his own dilemma revolving around religion & humanity.

title: Lokshahi
overview: It's a story of a naïve girl's personal dilemma over moral action set against the backdrop of strained political drama.

title: Colorphool
overview: An educated young man leaves the hustle and bustle of the city for an uneventful life in a village. However, he meets a scientist researching rare flowers and falls in love with her.

title: Gahvara
overview: To fulfill his grandmother's last wish, Farhan makes a new funeral bier (gahvara) to take her body to the burial ground. But the events that happen thereafter change Farhan's life and perspective forever.

title: Alibaba Ani Chalishitale Chor
overview: Doctor and his wife regularly invite a group of close friends for a weekend of partying at their farmhouse. When lights go out on one such occasion, and they hear a sound of a kiss followed by someone getting slapped, everyone is curious about who the perpetrators are. Meanwhile, his senses were gathering sounds from nature, from distant folk melodies, and from every vibration of life. Sometimes he practiced, singing so softly that it was hardly audible beyond his bed. This film takes this single moment of him lying on his sick bed and expands it, where his life of music and contemplation moves like a dream. It is a reverie on the intensely physical, yet invisible, labor behind India's most popular art form. Borrowing Bollywood's grammar to tell the stories of its most marginalized workers, the film raises questions about the price that must be paid to manufacture dreams for a billion people – and who pays.
